items.descriptionText: This pair of brass-framed reading glasses sit comfortably on the face, and seemingly make reading effortless. These glasses, a favorite of arcane researchers from a myriad of academies and universities, grant the user an extra reserve of mental fortitude when they are exhausted. When worn as a magic item, the glasses grant the wearer low-light vision and immunity to magical sleep effects. Furthermore, when the user has exhausted all of their highest level spells per day, they grant a +2 enhancement bonus to the DC and caster level of their spells cast, and a +3 enhancement bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, keen senses

items.name: Arcanist's Encyclopedia
items.descriptionText: This thick leather bound tome shows signs of wear even when brand new, pages seemingly dog-eared in advance, and in spite of its heft, the pages seem to flip so easily that one might think that they turn on their own. By speaking a command word, this 250-page spellbook can be changed into an encyclopedia which contains a library's worth of information on magical traditions. When holding the encyclopedia, you receive a +10 enhancement bonus on Spellcraft checks made to identify spells or magic items as long as it is active. The reader may also search the encyclopedia for knowledge to increase this bonus to +20, but doing so requires an hour of research. Furthermore, three times per day, the encyclopedia may be used either to cast analyze dweomer as a spell-like ability, or take 20 on a Spellcraft check to identify a spell as it is being cast.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, analyze dweomer, memorize page

items.name: Cloak of Energy Absorption
items.descriptionText: This clean white cloak is made of a sturdy, light fabric that repels dust and water. When the wearer casts a spell with the acid, cold, electricity, or fire descriptors, it harnesses a portion of the spell's energy, granting protection against it. Each time you cast a spell of one of the aforementioned descriptors, the cloak changes color (green for acid, blue for cold, yellow for electricity, and red for fire,) and stores one charge per spell level. The cloak can store up to 10 charges for a duration of 10 minutes, with the duration resetting each time the cloak absorbs a charge. Each charge stored in the cloak absorbs 5 points of energy damage that matches the stored type. If the user casts a spell of a differing energy type while a charge is stored, all of the stored charges are lost, and the new number and type of charges are absorbed in their place. As an example, if you cast fireball, the cloak turns red and gains 3 charges of fire absorption. Then, if you cast shocking grasp, the cloak loses those three charges, turns yellow, and gains 1 charge of lightning absorption.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from energy

items.name: Glassteel Helmet
items.descriptionText: These glass domes are magically strengthened and hardened. They are crystal clear and frequently fitted to suits designed to protect the wearer from environmental hazards. The glass of the helmet has hardness 10 and 50 hit points . A creature wearing a glassteel helmet suffers no ill effects from deep water pressure or similar environmental conditions, and gains a +4 bonus to AC against attack rolls made to confirm critical hits. Finally, so long as they do not have the broken condition, glassteel helmets provide total cover against attacks that specifically target the neck or head.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item or Craft Technological Arms and Armor, fabricate

items.name: Greater Gloves of Arcane Striking
items.descriptionText: These leather gloves are made of fine leather, reinforced with chains and rivets of mithral that glow with a faint inner radiance. These gloves function as gloves of arcane striking, and provide the following additional benefits: The wearer's bonus damage granted by the Arcane Strike feat is increased by +2. While the wearer has her Arcane Strike feat active, they gain a bonus to CMD equal to Arcane Strike's damage bonus against disarm attacks, attempts to sunder their wielded weapons, and effects that cause them to lose their grip on their weapons (such as grease ). While the feat is active, the wearer doesn't drop held weapons when panicked or stunned .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Arcane Strike, greater magic weapon

items.name: Gloves of the Battlemage
items.descriptionText: These hardened leather gloves protect the hands from stray blows, yet allow the fingers to remain fully flexible. Whenever the wearer of the gloves of the battlemage casts a spell with a range of touch, they may move up to 10 feet as part of the touch attack made to cast the spell. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, expeditious retreat

items.name: Greater Extraction Scarificator
items.descriptionText: A much more magically potent version of typical bloodletting devices used by doctors and mad alchemists, a greater extraction scarificator can transform the blood of powerful creatures into potent magical tinctures. An extraction scarificator can be used only on a willing or helpless target. When placed against exposed flesh, the extraction scarificator's blades deal 2d4 points of Constitution damage plus 1 Constitution bleed . Three times per day, a greater extraction scarificator can be used to extract and concentrate one of the four bodily humors from its target as well. The humor to be extracted can be adjusted as needed and must be immediately poured into a potion vial or the extracted humor is lost. Potions created with this item are unique in that they replicate spells of a higher level than potions normally can. Extracting a humor takes a variable number of rounds—as soon as the victim has taken a total of 10 points of Constitution damage in all from the bleed effect, the extraction is complete. For 24 hours after extraction, this purified humor has an additional effect, functioning as one of four potions as listed below (all function at caster level 15th). Black Bile: potion of true seeing Blood: potion of heal Phlegm: potion of greater heroism Yellow Bile: potion of transformation
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, greater heroism, heal, transformation, true seeing, vampiric touch

items.name: Headmaster's Monocle
items.descriptionText: This monocle with a golden chain grants the wearer an unmistakable air of authority and intelligence. The monocle confers a +2 enhancement bonus on Sense Motive checks and Diplomacy checks. The monocle may also be used to either motivate one's ally, or browbeat an opponent. As a move action, the wearer may perform one of the two following abilities. Motivate: By making carefully considered and eloquent speech, the wearer of the headmaster's monocle may grant a single ally a +2 competence bonus on weapon attack rolls for a number of rounds equal to your intelligence modifier. As a free action, the recipient of this bonus may add an additional 2d6 precision damage to a single weapon damage roll they make during the duration of this effect. Doing so ends the effect immediately. Browbeat: By sharply and sternly lecturing an enemy, the wearer of the headmaster's monocle may force a single target creature to make a will saving throw with a DC of 10 + your intelligence modifier. Should the target fail this save, they become shaken for a number of rounds equal to your intelligence modifier. As a swift action, you can snap at a creature that has already become shaken by this ability to force them to cower for one round, doing so causes the effect to end after the round the target spends cowering . Both of these modes are mind-affecting, language-dependent effects, including the ability to force the target of a browbeating to cower . Either of these abilities can be used once every 5 rounds, but only one at a time on a single target. If an ally is benefiting from your motivation, you cannot browbeat an enemy, and vice versa.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, grand destiny, debilitating speech

items.name: Ink Bladder
items.descriptionText: This preserved animal bladder mimics the escape mechanism employed by marine creatures. Once per day as a standard action, a submerged holder can squeeze the bladder to create a pressurized blast of dark ink. The bearer moves 90 feet in a straight line, so long as it remains underwater. A cloud of ink fills the wearer's space, providing concealment against attacks made into or through that space for 1 round. The ink bladder has no effect if the bearer is not submerged.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item or Craft Technological Arms and Armor, greater animal aspect

items.name: Klaven's Bane
items.descriptionText: This magical vapor was devised by enemies of the Hegemony to take advantage of the suppressed mental resistance klaven have for those they are designed to obey. Wisps of golden smoke swirl within a tiny bulbous flask of klaven's bane sealed with a crystalline stopper. When opened or shattered the smoke fills a single 5-foot square for 1 round before dissipating. During that time, any creature with the klaven template that has fewer than 4 HD entering or beginning its turn within the smoke is dazed for 1 round (DC 16 Will negates). A klaven dazed by this effect also forgets whatever happened while it is dazed and for 1 round prior to being dazed and takes a -4 penalty on Perception and Sense Motive checks for 1d4 rounds afterwards.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, mass daze, memory lapse

items.name: Orb of Remote Casting
items.descriptionText: This orb made of lavender crystal glows faintly, and gently hovers in place when left alone. When you speak the command word, the orb sheds additional light, and may be thrown up to 20 feet in a given direction, landing in one of the surrounding squares using the same rules as 22 a thrown splash weapon . When the orb is thrown in this manner, it hovers in place for 3 rounds. During this time, the owner may cast spells using the orb as the point of origin instead of the caster, including touch spells and rays, which are cast with a -2 penalty on the attack roll . Furthermore, if the owner is a wizard who has designated the orb as their bonded object, the orb is considered to be in their possession during this time for the purpose of feats and class features relating to bonded objects. Spells cast in this fashion have their casting time increased by one step unless they use the quickened spell metamagic feat . At the end of the 3 rounds, the orb stops glowing entirely and floats black to the owner's possession. It regains the glow after spending 10 continuous minutes in its owner's possession, at which point it may be activated again.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, eldritch conduit

items.name: Air Robe of the Overflowing Spirit
items.descriptionText: This robe shines with a vibrant white sheen, its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on all Acrobatics and Escape Artist checks. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. For every point of spirit consumed by this robe, the wearer gains a 10-foot enhancement bonus to all of their movement speeds for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma modifier. If the wearer possesses the Scholarly Samurai or Wizened Samurai feats, they may use their Intelligence or Wisdom modifier, as appropriate with the feat, rather than their Charisma modifier when determining the effects of the earth and air robes.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, air step

items.name: Earth Robe of the Overflowing Spirit
items.descriptionText: This robe shines with a vibrant golden its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it. The wearer gains a +1 enhancement bonus to their natural armor . Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. For every point of spirit consumed by this robe, the wearer gains a +1 dodge bonus to their Armor Class for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma modifier. If the wearer possesses the Scholarly Samurai or Wizened Samurai feats, they may use their Intelligence or Wisdom modifier, as appropriate with the feat, rather than their Charisma modifier when determining the effects of the earth and air robes.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin

items.name: Fire Robe of the Overflowing Spirit
items.descriptionText: This robe shines with a vibrant orange sheen, its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it. The wearer deals an additional 1 point of fire damage on all attacks. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. For every point of spirit consumed by this robe, the wearer gains a +3 bonus on all damage rolls for 1 round.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, produce flame

items.name: Purity Robe of the Overflowing Spirit
items.descriptionText: This robe shines with a vibrant purple sheen, its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it. The wearer gains a +1 luck bonus on all saving throws, ability checks and skill checks. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain Spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. When these robes consume spirit, the wearer may immediately make a new save against any ongoing mind-affecting effects they are suffering from, with a morale bonus to the save equal to the number of points of spirit consumed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, break enchantment

items.name: Void Robe of the Overflowing Spirit
items.descriptionText: This robe shines with a vibrant silvery sheen its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on all Intimidate checks. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. After consuming spirit, the next attack that the wearer of this robe hits with deals an additional 1d6 negative energy damage for each point of Spirit consumed, and sickens the creature for 1 round if they are currently demoralized.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, vampiric touch

items.name: Water Robe of the Overflowing Spirit
items.descriptionText: This robe shines with a vibrant blue sheen, its cloth constantly moving and flowing, even when there is no air to jostle it. The wearer gains a +1 morale bonus on Fortitude saves. Wearers with the spirit ability can access additional powers when they gain spirit in excess of their normal maximum capacity. When this happens, the robe consumes the extra spirit points, and the wearer may activate the ability as a free action, otherwise the points are wasted. For every point of spirit consumed, the robe restores a number of hit points equal to the number of class levels that the wearer possesses in the class that grants them the Spirit ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds

items.name: Rosary of Intercessions
items.descriptionText: This strand of wooden prayer beads looks simple and unassuming unless in the hands of an oracle, when it flashes in five different colors. Each rosary of intercessions is connected to five different oracle mysteries, which may vary depending on the deity or philosophy it is related to, and contains one revelation from each of these mysteries. Once per day, if it is used by the oracle in an 1-hour prayer ritual in the morning or when she regains her spells, the rosary grants one of its revelations for the next 24 hours. The oracle can use the revelation as if she had it as a normal class feature, even if she doesn't possess the appropriate mystery, but must meet the level requirements (if any) of the revelation itself. If the oracle already has that revelation and the revelation gives an ability with a limited number of uses per day, the oracle can use that ability one additional time per day. The rosary has no effect if worn by a non-oracle, and Use Magic Device doesn't allow a character to gain a revelation from it.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Cost 30,000 gp

args.text: 000 gp

items.name: Shoes of the Mirage
items.descriptionText: These soft, comfortable shoes shimmer curiously when held up to a source of light. When wearing these shoes, the wearer can tap their toes against the ground to activate the effects of the spell blurred movement for up to 10 minutes a day in one minute increments.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, blurred movement

items.name: Teardrop Ioun Stone
items.descriptionText: This stone is capable of increasing the damage dealt by a kineticist's kinetic blast wild talents, with the enhanced element depending upon the color as noted below. The normal variant treats the kineticist as two levels higher for the purpose of using kinetic blasts of the stone's associated element, stacking with other effects that would increase effective kineticist levels for this purpose. Flawed variants act like normal variants, but also double the burn cost to use the kinetic blast, including the cost of infusions and metakinesis, or increase it to 1 when using a kinetic blast that normally would cost 0 burn. Cracked variants instead increase the damage dealt by kinetic blasts associated with them by +1 so long as the blast would normally receive a bonus from the elemental overflow class feature. Composite blasts associated with more than one element can only benefit from one teardrop ioun stone at a time. As long as it is part of an ioun kineticist's ioun cloud, a teardrop ioun stone allows them to use any substance infusion of that stone's element up to 3rd level with their telekinetic blast or ioun blast (for example, a red teardrop ioun stone would allow an ioun kineticist's telekinetic or ioun blast to be used with burning infusion). The ioun kineticist must still possess the infusion to be able to use it with their telekinetic and ioun blasts. The colors of teardrop ioun stones associated with each element are as follows: Element Color Aether Clear Air White Earth Green Fire Red Light Gold Machine Pewter Mind Teal Poison Purple Sound Iridescent Time Silver Water Blue Wood Brown Viscera Pink Void Onyx Resonance +1 circumstance bonus to DC for wild talents of the associated element.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item

items.name: Theorycraft Grimoire
items.descriptionText: This grimoire, bound in dark blue leather, feels slightly electric to the touch, and words and diagrams on its pages shift slightly. A legendary wizard who has made this Spellbook their bonded item may use it to alter the properties of up to three spells which they have prepared from it. When a wizard with the Theorycraft Grimoire is bound to prepares a spell, they can change it in one of three ways: Alter area of effect: If the spell prepared is a line, cone, or circular spread that emanates from the caster, you may alter the shape of the spell to another one of those shapes. This alters the radius or distance of the spell depending on the shape chosen. The length of a line spell is three times as long as the radius of the conical version of that spell, and the cone's radius is twice as long as the radius of its spread version. To use an example, the spell lightning bolt emanates in an 120 ft. line, and thus makes a 40 ft. cone, or 20 ft. spread instead. Alter affected creature type: For spells which target a specific creature type, you may alter it to target one of the following creature types: aberration, animal, fey, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, and vermin . For example, the wizard could alter the spell hold person to become hold aberration, thus targeting aberrations instead of humanoids . Much like the original version of this spell, these may only affect the designated creature type, not both the new type and the original target type. Altering a spell in this way does not bypass any immunities a creature may have to such spells because of its creature types or subtypes. This feature cannot be used to alter any variation of the spell planar binding . Alter elemental properties: A spell which deals or prevents fire, cold, electricity, or acid damage may be changed to deal or prevent the damage of a different one of these energy types. When altering the type of damage dealt, you may choose whether the spell has half of the damage dealt changed, or all of it. If there are multiple types of energy in the spell being altered, you must pick only one to alter. If the effect of a spell allows you to deal damage of a specific type as well as preventing damage of the same type, both effects must still share an energy type. This effect changes the descriptors of the spell to include the new energy type. Spells altered in this way must have the type of alteration chosen when the spell is prepared, as well as the effect of that alteration. Each altered spell may only be altered in one way, but each type of alteration may be chosen more than once.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, adjustable polymorph

items.name: Universal Scabbard
items.descriptionText: This plain steel scabbard functions as a masterwork combat scabbard. In addition, any melee weapon can be placed into this scabbard, transforming one end of it into a hilt as though it was a katana sized for a scabbard of this size. When removed from the scabbard, the weapon regains its original shape. If this scabbard is destroyed, the weapon returns to its original shape.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, mending

items.name: Pirate's Boots
items.descriptionText: These boots are made of finely tooled leather. Benefit: The wearer of these boots gains a +5 competence bonus to Acrobatics (jump), Climb, and Swim checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, jump, spider climb, endure elements

items.name: Cape of the Swashbuckler
items.descriptionText: This stylish piece of clothing never seems to tatter, nor do the colors fade. Benefit: The wearer of this cape gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC and a +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, prestidigitation, eagle's splendor, haste

items.name: Captain's Charm
items.descriptionText: This 4" long oval pendant must be worn by an active ship captain, on the outer most article of clothing, at the lapel level in order to function. It occasionally flashes with a glaring light, similar to sunlight reflected in a mirror. Benefit: The wearer of this pendant gains a +6 enhancement bonus to Charisma and can cast flare 3 times per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor, flare

items.name: Enchanted Masthead
items.descriptionText: These magic figures are mounted on the bow of a ship to provide a variety of magical abilities to the ship. An enchanted masthead must also be ritually bound to the ship before its benefits can be used. Only one masthead can be ritually bound and mounted on any given ship, although a single masthead may certainly have more than one power. Table: Enchanted Masthead Powers d20 Benefit 1-2 Navigation: The captain gains a +4 bonus on all Survival checks to avoid becoming lost . 3-4 Piloting: The pilot/driver gains a +4 bonus on all sailing or driving checks (see Vessels and Vehicles for rules for driving ships.) 5-6 Speed: Acceleration and maximum speed are increased by +10 feet (see Vessels for rules for acceleration and maximum speed.) 7-8 Maneuverability: The ships base CMB and CMD are increased by +4 (see Vessels for rules for making combat maneuvers on a ship.) 9-10 Seaworthiness: The captain gains a +4 bonus on Survival checks to determine or predict weather. 11 Stealth: Ship can be covered by illusionary mist, which reduces the range at which it can be spied by a factor of four. 12 Eagle Eye: Range of lookout's vision is doubled. 13 Pursuit: Once an enemy ship is sighted, the captain constantly knows which direction it is in, for up to nine days. 14 Treasure Finding: The captain gains a +4 bonus on all Navigation checks. 15 Ramming: The ship is treated as if its hardness is 4 greater when ramming other vessels. 16 Stability: The ship gains a +2 stability bonus to its base CMD and to siege engine attack rolls . 17 Fire Protection: Ship gains +4 bonus on saving throws versus fire, takes 1/2 damage from magical fire, gains saving throw DC 10 + 1/die of damage against normal fire, no damage if save is made, half damage if save is failed. 18 Hardness: The ship's hull and decks hardness are increased by 2. 19 Buoyancy: +4 bonus to all Foundering checks. 20 Maintenance: Costs of repairs to the ship are reduced by 50%.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, limited wish

items.name: Cloning Vat
items.descriptionText: This massive metal vat is filled with expensive alchemical components conducive for cloning creatures. Closing vats are usually built within the lab in which they are to be used, and are difficult and time consuming to move once built. Doing so requires discarding the alchemical components stored within it and completely disassembling the vat, requiring a week and reducing its weight to 250 lbs, and for it to be reassembled in a new location and refilled with expensive alchemical reagents, requiring another week and an expenditure of 2,500 gp. With a DC 30 Craft (alchemy) check, the initial reagents can be saved and reused, assuming you have a way to safely store and transport 750 lbs of liquid. When using the clone spell, you can use the vat as an additional focus component for the spell, placing the growing clone within it to reduce the time it takes to grow to 1 month. A cloning vat can only be used to grow a single clone at once. Removing the clone from the vat without a creature's soul inhabiting it immediately destroys the clone . When used with the Seeds of Life forbidden knowledge, the cloning vat can be used to sustain a single clone seed without an investment of essence on the part of the promethean who created it. A cloning vat can only sustain a single clone seed at any one time. A cloning vat can only assist in the growing of clones up to Medium size. Larger cloning vats cost an additional 5,000 gp and have their weight doubled for each size category they can assist in cloning beyond Medium. Using a cloning vat does not replace the material components required to use the clone spell or the Seeds of Life forbidden knowledge.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, clone or the Seeds of Life forbidden knowledge

args.name: the Seeds of Life forbidden knowledge

items.name: Elixir of Fleshsculpting
items.price: varies (least 400 gp, lesser 10,000 gp, greater 75,000 gp, major 200,000 gp)
items.descriptionText: Consuming this murky elixir imbues the drinker's body with the powers of mutagenic change. The drinker falls unconscious for an hour as their body is warped by the magic, altering their form to their desires. After this hour, they awaken, gaining the benefits of a permanent fleshsculpting, as the promethean's fleshsculpting class feature. If they already have a permanent fleshsculpting, this replaces it. The strength of the fleshsculpting granted depends on the potency of this elixir: Least: The drinker alters their appearance. This allows them to change the color of their eyes, skin, or hair, or to adjust their height by plus or minus 6 inches. They can also edit the features of their body, such as changing their facial features, their sex, their voice, rounding or pointing their ears, etc. This ability does not change their weight, so making themselves shorter makes them bulkier, and making themselves taller makes them thinner. This ability can allow the creature to appear as a Different race, sex, or age category for the purposes of Disguise checks, negating those penalties. This fleshsculpting is purely cosmetic, none of the changes provide any mechanical benefits. It can also be combined with an additional non-cosmetic fleshsculpting. Lesser: The drinker gains the benefit of a single fleshsculpting ability that could be granted by a 1st-level fleshsculpter. Greater: The drinker gains the benefit of a single fleshsculpting ability that could be granted by a 5th-level fleshsculpter. Major: The drinker gains the benefit of a single fleshsculpting ability that could be granted by a 13th-level fleshsculpter.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, alter self
items.constructionCostText: varies (least 200 gp, lesser 5,000 gp, greater 37,500 gp, major 100,000 gp)

items.name: Forbidden Tome
items.price: varies (least 6,000 gp, lesser 24,000 gp, greater 54,600 gp)
items.descriptionText: A forbidden tome is a vessel of knowledge useful to prometheans in their research. Only a promethean or another character with access to the forbidden knowledge class feature may utilize a forbidden tome. A forbidden tome is often a tome in name only, they can come in a wide variety of shapes and functions; from a crystal ball that reveals eldritch secrets, a spyglass that shows secret messages on the walls, a book bound in human flesh filled with occult lore, and so on. The more powerful the forbidden tome, the more interesting and unique a form it takes. When you meditate to prepare your veils for the day, you can study a forbidden tome. Doing so allows you to select one of your pieces of forbidden knowledge and treat it as if it were invested with additional essence for all purposes (+1 for least, +2 for lesser, +3 for greater). Forbidden knowledge that cannot be invested with essence does not benefit from a forbidden tome. You can utilize multiple forbidden tomes while preparing your veils, but only one of each type. A single piece of forbidden knowledge can only benefit from one forbidden tome at any time. The benefits of a forbidden tome last until the next time you meditate to shape your veils, and cannot be used to benefit another promethean during this time.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item
items.constructionCostText: varies (least 3,000 gp, lesser 12,000 gp, greater 27,300 gp)

items.name: Animal Totem Headdress
items.descriptionText: This headdress is made from the head and/or pelt of a wolf, bear, buffalo, lion or other great cat, giant eagle or giant snake . The headdress counts as a light helm and provides a +1 deflection bonus to the wearer's AC and a +2 bonus to Intimidate checks. The headdress also confers the following bonuses based on its type: Bear: +1 Strength or Constitution Buffalo: +1 Constitution or Wisdom Wolf: +1 Dexterity or Constitution Lion (or other great cat): +1 Strength or Dexterity Giant eagle: +1 Charisma or Dexterity Giant snake: +1 Dexterity or Wisdom
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bull's strength, bear's endurance, cat's grace, eagle's splendor, shield of faith

items.name: Aqua Vitae
items.descriptionText: This extremely rare holy water is also known as "Water of Life." A dose of aqua vitae has all the effects of a heal spell when drunk by non-evil living creatures, and as a raise dead spell when poured into the mouth of a non-evil dead creature. No living creature can benefit from the effects of aqua vitae more than once in its lifetime. Repeated doses have no effect. If hurled as a grenade-like weapon upon undead of 8 HD or less, aqua vitae acts like a harm spell.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, heal, raise dead

items.name: Banner of the Supernatural Sign
items.aura: moderate abjuration, conjuration, evocation and transmutation
items.descriptionText: These banners are emblazoned with one of the lesser signs described in Chapter 7: Supernatural Signs. The bearer of the banner can call forth the lesser powers of the sign, just as if he himself bore the sign. For example, a banner of the sign of the Great Cross would provide its bearer with two spell-like or special abilities from the lesser sign of the Great Cross's list of powers. The specific powers are determined by the GM, based on the sign's list. However, the bearer's alignment must not be opposed to the sign's alignment (e.g., good vs. evil or law vs. chaos), or the banner will not function. The banner allows each sign power to be used once per day, no matter how many times the bearer picks up the banner, and no matter how many different bearers carry the banner in a single day. If a sign special ability power does not have a listed duration or method of invoking it, such as damage reduction or immunity: disease, etc., it is invoked by the banner bearer as a free action and lasts for 2d6 rounds. The banner may be held in one hand in order to free the other hand. The banner is typically made of a magically hardened wood or iron frame supporting a cloth, silk, or hide banner. The entire banner has 35 hit points and a hardness of 5.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, magic circle against good / evil, shadow conjuration, permanency

items.name: Barbarian Warpaint
items.descriptionText: Barbarian warpaint endows the subject with one of the powers listed below for 30 minutes after applying it. The wearer must select a power immediately after applying the paint, which requires one full minute. One pot of warpaint is sufficient to paint the face of one creature. A pot of warpaint has the ability to endow one of the following powers: Hard to Kill: the wearer is hard to kill. This effect works identically to the Diehard feat. Deadly Striker: The wearer's threat range with a single type of weapon increases by 1. Swift Striker: The wearer can make one extra attack of opportunity each round. Skilled Combatant: The wearer can choose to take a –2 penalty on melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks to gain a +2 dodge bonus to his Armor Class . He can only use this ability when he declares he is making an attack or a full-attack action with a melee weapon. The effects last until his next turn.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bear's endurance, bull's strength, cat's grace

items.name: Shifter's Deadly Gloves
items.descriptionText: These rugged magic gloves are often made of soft leather or fur, stylized with motifs of nature and animals . They are prized by druids, shapeshifters and spellcasters who use transmutation magic to assume alternate forms. The gloves double the threat range of one of the wearer's natural attacks while using wild shape, shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon, or Giant Form abilities, or the beast shape, polymorph, form of the dragon or giant form spells. Each set of gloves is attuned to one specific type of natural attack, such as claws, hooves, bite, gore, slam, etc. The increased threat range benefit doesn't stack with any other effects that expand the threat range of a weapon (such as the keen edge spell or Improved Critical feat). The gloves also make the affected natural attack count as a magic weapon . Note: These gloves can be enchanted to include a bonus to hit and damage, just as if they were a +1 weapon, for example. Add the cost and
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor or Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape, keen edge

items.name: Shifter's Wounding Gloves
items.descriptionText: These magic gloves are made with pointed fingertips and frequently appear bloodstained. The gloves empower one of the wearer's natural attacks with the wounding weapon ability when they are using wild shape, shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon, or Giant Form abilities, or the beast shape, polymorph, form of the dragon or giant form spells. Each set of gloves is attuned to one specific type of natural attack, such as claws, hooves, bite, gore, slam, etc. The bleed damage doesn't stack with any other effects that cause bleeding. The gloves also make the affected natural attack count as a magic weapon . Note: These gloves can be enchanted to include a bonus to hit and damage, just as if they were a +1 weapon, for example. Add the cost and
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor or Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape, bleed

items.name: Snake Scale Cloak
items.descriptionText: These black capes are made of thousands of fine, supple snake scales. The cloak offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +4 resistance bonus on saving throws versus poison and a deflection bonus to AC. Last, it gives a +2 competence bonus on Climb and Stealth checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, delay poison, darkness, shield of faith, spider climb

items.name: Sorcerous Helm
items.descriptionText: These masked helms are usable by sorcerers and wizards . The helms come in a wide variety of shapes and designs, but are always elaborate, fantastic and arcane in appearance. They are typically made of thin gold, copper, brass, bronze or odd metal alloys, are often studded with gems and inlaid with gold and runic symbols. Some feature large curling horns or spikes, or are designed to resemble the heads of wolves, jackals, hawks, snakes or fantastic beasts. Most cover the wearer's face completely and are designed to conceal their identity. Despite being made of metal, they do not interfere with arcane spellcasting, and offer no armor protection due to their delicate and intricate
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, disguise self, eagle's splendor, fox's cunning

items.name: Zombie Elixir
items.descriptionText: This horrid elixir transforms a living or dead creature into a zombie . Living creatures of 8 hit dice or less that drink the elixir must make a DC 16 Fortitude save or enter a nightmarish coma for 24 hours, after which they must make a second save. If they succeed on the second save, they awaken and suffer no more effects other than being both shaken and sickened for a day. If they fail the second save, they die and rise as a mindless zombie at midnight. Such unfortunate victims are under the control of the zombie elixir creator for 24 hours, after which they become uncontrolled. The process can be prevented if a remove curse, break enchantment or dispel evil spell is used on the victim before they are transformed. If the elixir is administered to a dead creature of 8 hit dice or less, it automatically rises as a zombie at midnight and is under the control of the zombie elixir creator for 24 hours.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, animate dead, bestow curse, poison, phantasmal killer (or slay living )

items.name: Aurora Bottle
items.descriptionText: Random electrical charges continuously course along the surface of a stoppered bottle crafted from dark glass containing flecks of iron and other magnetic metals. Dim flashes of light intermittently illuminate the bottle (once every 1d4 hours), emitting light equivalent to a torch for 1d4 minutes. The bottle can be opened once per day. When opened, the bottle releases a geomagnetic storm that creates a dazzling light show in the sky. The luminescent display emits an emanation of dim light in a 1,000-foot radius. The dim light overlaps with the prevailing lighting conditions; thus, the dim light does not counter or negate bright light, normal light, or existing dim light. The emanation also fills the atmosphere with charged ions. All electricity-based spells and effects cast within the emanation deal 1 additional point of electricity damage per die of electricity damage. Creatures healed by electricity damage and those gaining temporary hit points or ability score increases from electricity damage also gain fast healing 2 for as long as they remain within the emanation. The emanation lasts for 10 minutes, and functions only outdoors.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, dancing lights, lightning bolt

items.name: Avalanche Crystal
items.descriptionText: Frost covers the surface of this pea-sized crystal shaped into the likeness of a snowflake. When dropped onto a snow-covered or icy surface and activated as a standard action, the crystal emits a potent ultrasonic wave. Although the momentary pulse deals no damage and has no visible effect, there is a 50% chance the intense vibrations trigger an avalanche when the crystal is dropped onto a spot where conditions are suitable for an avalanche. If the crystal causes an avalanche, the wave of unstable ice and snow begins on the downslope adjacent to the crystal. Therefore, creatures standing on the upslope adjacent to the crystal as well as the crystal itself are unaffected by the avalanche. The crystal cannot be activated again for 24 hours.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, sound burst

items.name: Boots of Winter Travel
items.descriptionText: These supple yet durable leather boots fabricated from sealskin fit snugly around the wearer's feet and ankles. On command three times per day as a standard action, the wearer can transform the boots into ice skates or skis . These custom-fitted ice skates or skis grant the wearer a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to ice skate or ski. They can transform back to their normal form with another such command.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, masterwork transformation

items.name: Frozen Quiver
items.descriptionText: Made from polar bear leather, this item appears to be a typical arrow container capable of holding up to 10 arrows. The outside of the quiver feels cool to the touch, but the space inside the container radiates a constant temperature of 0° Fahrenheit (–17° Celsius). When the quiver's owner reaches into the container, he draws an arrow crafted from solid ice. The arrow has no enhancement bonus, but counts as a magical weapon and deals cold damage for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction and affecting creatures vulnerable to cold. When the wielder scores a critical threat with an arrow drawn from the quiver, he can forego confirming the critical hit and instead subject the target to an effect identical to the icy prison spell (DC 17 Reflex save partial). The quiver replenishes expended arrows at a rate of one per day. If the quiver's contents are fully exhausted, it loses its magical properties forever and becomes a non-magical container. An arrow drawn from its quiver melts 10 minutes later. An arrow exposed to temperatures above the freezing point (32° Fahrenheit, 0° Celsius) melts in 1 round, while an arrow subjected to an open flame or fire damage instantly turns into harmless steam.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, icy prison

items.name: Gloves of Ice Sculpting
items.descriptionText: These sturdy gloves are made from white dragon hide. Up to three times per day on command as a standard action, the wearer can shape ice and snow. This ability duplicates the effects of stone shape, though the wearer can affect only ice and snow, not stone. In addition, the gloves also negate any cold damage the wearer would normally take from hitting an enemy with an unarmed strike, as in the case of the yeti's cold supernatural ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, control water, stone shape

items.name: Map of the Winterlands
items.descriptionText: This vellum map created from reindeer skin is a boon for polar explorers. The map's owner can attune the magical item to himself by keeping it in his possession for 24 consecutive hours. No more than one creature can be attuned to the map at the same time. Therefore, if a new creature acquires the map and attunes himself to the object, the former owner loses his attunement to the map. When the map's owner occupies a square containing ice or snow, once per day he may speak a command word as a standard action to activate the item. When he does so, over the next 10 minutes the map details the 100-mile-radius area centered on the owner. The owner must remain in the same square while the map is being created; otherwise, the daily usage is lost and the map's drawings instantly disappear. The map displays geographical features occupying at least 1,000 contiguous squares such as mountains, hills, bodies of water, and other similar locations normally appearing on a map provided they are also covered in ice or snow contiguous to the square the owner occupies when he activates the map. The map also identifies the locations of man made structures including roads, buildings, and monuments measuring 500 square feet or more that are also adjacent to ice or snow meeting the preceding requirement. In addition, the map also points to the geographical north or south pole corresponding to the owner's location. A minute icon of the owner appears at the spot where the owner activated the map. As the owner moves through the area, the tiny representation tracks his progress along the map. If he travels beyond the map's confines or into an area not covered by ice or snow contiguous to his original location, the icon vanishes and reappears only when the owner activates the map again.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, create treasure map, locate object

items.name: Mink Coat
items.descriptionText: This eponymous outerwear offers the same defense against the elements as an ordinary wool coat and may be substituted for the latter as part of a cold-weather outfit. While this coat offers no added protection against chilly temperatures, the handcrafted garment flaunts the wearer's wealth and social status. If the wearer is a humanoid, the coat allows the wearer simultaneously to attempt a Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate check (made with a separate die roll for each skill check) when the wearer interacts with a fellow humanoid . When doing so, the wearer decides which skill check to use (and one corresponding effect from that skill, such as feinting with a Bluff check or gathering information with a Diplomacy check) after all three dice are rolled, but before the GM announces the results. The skill checks the wearer opts not to use are treated as if they never happened rather than as potential successes or failures. The wearer cannot use this ability more than once in any 24-hour period on the same humanoid . The wearer may also use this ability for influence checks (see "Influence".)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor

items.name: Mukluks of Comfort
items.descriptionText: Made from sealskin, these leather boots repel water, retain warmth, and constantly circulate fresh air to grant the wearer immunity to immersion foot syndrome. Despite the preceding effects, they offer no benefits in cold environments, no resistance to cold, and no immunity to cold.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, control water

items.name: Necklace of Snowflakes
items.descriptionText: A slight chill emanates from this silver necklace that bears a clear, glass pendant. When the wearer grasps the pendant and speaks the command word as a standard action, the item allows the wearer to assume the form of a mound of snow or an ice formation roughly equal in size to the wearer. The wearer determines the exact shape, coloration, and other aesthetic features of the snowy or icy formation when the necklace is activated. Visual and tactile inspection cannot reveal the snow or ice to actually be a magically concealed creature. of course, the wearer's chosen shape and location — such as creating an icy statue in a tropical jungle — may arouse intense suspicion. Nonetheless to all normal tests, the wearer is an ordinary pile of snow or ice, though a detect magic spell locates a faint aura of transmutation magic on the snow or ice. While disguised as snow or ice, the wearer observes everything taking place around him just as if he were in his normal form. The wearer's hit points and save bonuses remain unaffected. His effective Dexterity score is reduced to 0, and he has a speed of 0 feet. All clothing and gear carried or worn changes with him. The wearer can remain in this form for 8 hours. He can dismiss this effect as a free action . The necklace cannot be activated again for 24 hours.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, ice storm

items.name: Orca Tooth
items.descriptionText: When placed into a living creature's mouth (as a standard action provoking attacks of opportunity ), this sharp orca tooth instantly grafts itself into the creature's jaw. The user gains a bite attack as a primary natural attack . This attack deals 1d6 points of piercing damage for a Medium user or 1d4 points of piercing damage for a Small user. The bite attack counts as a magic weapon for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction . The user also gains a swim speed of 40 feet and takes no damage from immersion in cold water, though he may still contract immersion foot syndrome. The user gains the ability to communicate with dolphins, including orcas, as the speak with animals spell and also receives a +5 competence bonus to Handle Animal and wild empathy checks with dolphins . The effects granted by the magical tooth last for 1 hour. Afterward, the tooth immediately disintegrates. Only living creatures gain any benefit from this item.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape I, speak with animals

items.name: Penguin Cloak
items.descriptionText: Layers of penguin feathers and down are stitched into the weave of this heavy wool cloak. Whenever the wearer is adjacent to another living creature, regardless of whether the creature is friend or foe, the cloak grants the wearer cold resistance 5. When the wearer begins his turn adjacent to an ally, the ally gains the benefits of a single teamwork feat the wearer possesses as a free action . The wearer chooses the teamwork feat to bestow to the ally. If the wearer is adjacent to more than one ally, the wearer may grant the benefits of different teamwork feats to each ally, but an ally can never gain the benefits of more than one teamwork feat. The wearer must be part of the group qualifying for a given bonus for his allies to gain the benefit. The allies' positioning and actions must still meet the prerequisites listed in the teamwork feat for either of you to receive the listed bonus. The ally loses the teamwork feat at the beginning of the wearer's next turn, though the wearer can grant the ally the same teamwork feat or a different one if the ally is still adjacent to the wearer at the beginning of the wearer's next turn.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, coordinated effort

items.name: Polar Goggles
items.descriptionText: These goggles boast expertly made lenses crafted from glacial ice fitted into a water-resistant leather frame made from sealskin. The wearer is immune to snow blindness and can see through falling snow or sleet, both magical and normal varieties, without penalty. Whenever the wearer sees a creature with the cold subtype, the goggles instantly identify the creature as well as its special powers and vulnerabilities as if the wearer rolled a natural 20 on the appropriate Knowledge check. However, the wearer must still be trained in the appropriate Knowledge skill to use the preceding ability; otherwise, the wearer cannot identify the creature and gains no useful information from the goggles.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, arcane sight

items.name: Polar Ram
items.descriptionText: This fearsome ram carved from water-resistant wood, covered in pitch, and then sheathed in bronze slices through up to 5-foot-thick ice as easily as a hot knife cuts through butter. The ram weakens ice of greater thickness, but it cannot completely penetrate the frozen material bringing the ship to a complete stop. The ram weighs only 8 pounds and measures 1 foot in length and is 6 inches wide. When the command word is spoken, the ram affixes itself to the ship's bow, automatically adjusting its size to accommodate the ship's dimensions and gives the vessel sufficient berth to safely pass through an ice floe or ice field. Speaking the command word again detaches the ram from the ship and returns it to its normal size and shape. The ram leaves a visible trail of ice-free squares in its immediate wake, though free-floating patches of ice may quickly fill in any gaps. Despite its ability to carve through ice, the magical ram deals no additional damage to objects or creatures it strikes, including icebergs and creatures with the cold subtype. Furthermore, the ram can cuts through ice only when attached to a seafaring vessel and not in its in normal form.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, control water

items.name: Ring of Ice
items.descriptionText: This exquisite ring is sculpted from compacted ice that causes it to emit a dim, bluish hue. The wearer gains a burrow speed of 20 feet, though he can burrow only through ice and snow. The wearer passes through non-magical ice and snow as easily as a fish swims through water. His burrowing leaves no tunnel or hole in his wake, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of his presence.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, earth glide, sleet storm

items.name: Rod of Winter
items.descriptionText: This pale white rod is made from a white dragon's rib. If the head of a rod of winter is planted into a snow-covered or icy surface, and the possessor wills it to scan as a standard action, the rod projects a three-dimensional map of the 60-foot-radius area beneath it just above the corresponding surface. The rod details only the outlines of nonliving features created by water in its solid or liquid forms. The map reveals the depth and volume of the ice, snow, or liquid water in the locale as well as any voids or abscesses in the ice and snow, but it cannot detect the presence of other materials such as earth or stone. For instance, a complex built from wood and stone beneath the ice would appear only as a large void, whereas a network of tunnels and passages carved out of the ice and snow would appear in exacting detail. The map remains for 10 minutes and then disappears. The rod can perform this function three times per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, clairaudience/clairvoyance

items.name: Snow Cloak
items.descriptionText: The wearer of this shaggy, white fur cloak made from polar bear, winter wolf, and yeti hides gains a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks made in terrain covered by ice or snow. In addition, three times per day, the wearer can command the cloak as a standard action to radiate a burst of ultraviolet light. All creatures within 30 feet of the wearer must succeed on a DC 13 Fortitude save or suffer from light sensitivity for the next 1d4 rounds. Creatures already suffering from light sensitivity or light blindness take a –4 penalty on their Fortitude saving throw and are blinded instead on a failed save.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, cat's grace, daylight

items.name: Spyglass of The Polar Mariner
items.descriptionText: Made from exquisite wood with precision crafted glass lenses, astute captains never set sail on the polar seas without this handmade spyglass. Although the spyglass does not increase the owner's visibility range, the spyglass loudly whistles in the owner's hand whenever an iceberg of Small size or larger comes within visual range, even if the spyglass's owner is not actively looking for icebergs or even using the spyglass. If the owner looks through the spyglass, the whistling grows louder as it points to the largest iceberg within visual range. If more than one iceberg is within range, the spyglass points to the large iceberg first. Calibrating the spyglass to view each iceberg requires a full-round action .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, locate object

items.name: Staff of Winter
items.descriptionText: This staff made from the fused vertebrae of a remorhaz's tail has an ivory coloration and is topped by a small sphere of ice. It allows use of the following spells. Moguls (1 charge) Slalom skier (1 charge) Wall of snow (2 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, moguls, slalom skier, wall of snow

items.name: Whale Blubber
items.descriptionText: This plum-sized morsel of partially frozen whale skin and blubber is commonly known as muktuk in many circles. When a living creature eats whale blubber (as a standard action provoking attacks of opportunity ), the fatty meat provides enough caloric intake to satisfy a Medium creature's food requirements for 24 hours. Within 1d4 rounds after consuming the item, thick blubber appears beneath the creature's skin, granting the creature DR 5/piercing or slashing, but imposing a –2 penalty to Dexterity . The added layer of insulation warms the eater as if he were affected by an endure elements spell. In addition, the eater can hold his breath for a number of minutes equal to 4 times his Constitution score before he risks drowning. Once eaten, the effects granted by whale blubber last for 24 hours. Only living creatures gain any benefit from this item.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, endure elements

items.name: Boots of the Waves
items.descriptionText: These calf-high boots are decorated with glyphs inscribed in Aquan. The wearer gains a a +5 competence bonus to Acrobatics checks made to maintain footing or balance on unsteady or slippery terrain (such as the rain-slicked deck of a ship) but grants no bonus on Acrobatics checks for jumping, falling, or moving through threatened areas. In addition, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus to Swim checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item

items.name: Captain's Horn
items.descriptionText: The captain's horn is a set of ten earrings that are generally worn by a captain and up to nine of his crew members. The earrings allow the wearers to communicate telepathically with one another (as the spell telepathic bond ), the master earring alone granting the power to send a message to all the others at once. A wearer can only communicate with other wearers so long as he is not more than 60 ft. away from a ship and can only communicate with those who themselves are also not more than 60 ft. away from the same ship.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, telepathic bond

items.name: Rainbow Feather Cloak
items.descriptionText: This brightly colored half cloak is woven of countless feathers. Complex and beautiful patterns are comprised of blue, green, orange, red, and yellow parrot feathers that never fade, even in the sun. Quite often, only important personages such as kings, nobles, priests, and shamans own these cloaks due to the painstaking labor and magical abilities woven into them. A person wearing one of these cloaks is under a permanent feather fall effect. In addition, the wearer may tear out a feather from the cloak and use it as a feather token . The effect of the feathe r is dictated by the color of the feather torn from the cloak. Blue feathers produce the effect of a compass token . Green feathers produce the effect of a swan boat token, though the craft created appears as a raft instead of a swan boat. Orange feathers produce the effect of a bird token . Red feathers produce the effect of a vine token . Yellow feathers produce the effect of a tree token . Each cloak can produce two vine token effects, two swan boat token effects, three bird token effects, three tree token effects and five compass token effects.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, feather fall, major creation

items.name: Zombie Drums
items.descriptionText: These two conga drums are made of deep black, well-burnished wood and covered at the top with tightly laced goatskin. Favored by necromancers and shamans that haunt the waterways and jungles in untamed lands, these magical drums can speed or slow the very heartbeat of those that hear it, or cause even intelligent undead to march to the beat of the skilled drummer. When the two drums are played at a fast and frenetic tempo and the player makes a DC 15 Perform (percussion) check, all creatures within 30 feet of the drummer are under the effect of a haste spell until the percussionist stops playing or 10 rounds have passed, whichever comes first. When the two drums are played at a slow tempo and the player makes a DC 15 Perform (percussion) check, all creatures within 30 feet of the drummer, except for the drummer himself, are under the effect of a slow spell. The DC to save against this effect is DC 14 + 1 for every 5points by which the Perform (percussion) check exceeds 15. This lasts until the percussionist stops playing or 10 rounds have passed, whichever comes first. The haste and slow effects can be used a total of three times each day. A truly skilled percussionist can use these drums once per day to produce an effect as the spell control undead with a DC 25 Perform (percussion) check. This can only affect undead creatures within 50 feet of the drums. Undead may make a Will save, DC 20 + 1 for every 5 points by which the check exceeds 25. This lasts until the percussionist stops playing or 10 minutes have passed, whichever comes first. Setting up the drums and beginning to play requires a full round action. If a percussionist attempts to activate the drums with a Perform (percussion) check and fails, that attempt is still used for the day. Using the drums to control undead requires all the power the drums can summon for the day – no haste or slow effects can be attempted after an attempt has been made to control undead . If a haste or slow effect has already been used within the last 24 hours, no attempt can be used to control undead until 24 hours have passed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, haste, slow, control undead, creator must have 8 ranks in Perform (percussion) skill

items.name: Feather Token
items.descriptionText: Each of these items is a small feather that has a power to suit a special need. The kinds of tokens are described below. Each token is usable once. A particular feather token has no specific features to identify it unless its magic aura is viewed, even tokens with identical powers can be wildly different in appearance. Compass: When this token is dropped into open air, it appears to be caught by an errant breeze and is wafted due north for a period of 1 minute or until it touches any other object. Vines: When this token is touched to a tree, the tree is suddenly choked by long, large vines. The vines grow over the trunk and are anchored firmly, able to support creatures of up to large size with no extra support. Multiple sturdy vines also hang from the tree's branches down to the ground. These can support the weight of creatures of up to Medium size. These vines are rooted in the earth around the tree and are permanent.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, major creation

items.name: Girallon Clutch
items.descriptionText: Four muscular arms with matted fur wrap across the wearer's chest like a bandolier, all four hands meeting just below the heart. The arms obey the wearer's commands, lifting heavy objects, holding objects ready, or grant the abilities of a girallon. As a standard action, the wearer can command one, two, or three of the arms in the following ways: Carry an object weighing up to 30 lbs. Retrieve an item from the wearer's pouch or pack and hold it ready. Drawing this item from the arm is a swift action . Even if the retrieved item is a weapon or shield, the arm holds the item but does not wield it. The arms do not threaten squares, can not attack, nor grant bonuses to AC. Manipulate a simple machine, like a lever or pulley. Grant a +2 bonus to Climb skill checks. Grant a +1 bonus to a combat maneuver check. Which combat maneuver the bonus applies to must be selected when the command is given. The arms can be given the same command, separate commands, or a combination. Although all four arms can be commanded, one must be used to cling to the wearer's body. If the fourth arm is given a command, the girallon clutch loses its grip and falls to the ground, inert.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, animate dead

items.name: Headhunter's Staff
items.descriptionText: This long staff has two shrunken heads tied to the top with leather thongs and feathered fetishes. One head appears to be that of a man, and the other of a woman. Three times per day this staff can be used to produce an effect like the augury spell, with the same restrictions and limitations. This ability has a 75% chance of success. When the response to the bearer's question is "weal," the female head will wail. When the response to the bearer's question is "woe," the male head will shout. When the response to the bearer's question is "weal" or "woe," both heads will cry out, and when the response is nothing, the heads will not do anything.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, augury

items.name: Greater Headhunter's Staff
items.descriptionText: Resembling the headhunter's staff in appearance, this staff can be used to produce an effect as the commune spell cast by a 9th level caster three times per day. These items usually use a god that possesses the Death domain as their source of information. A positive response to the bearer's question will cause the female head to wail, while a negative answer will cause the male head to shout. Both heads on the staff will speak if the answer to the commune is a short phrase or word.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, commune

items.name: Mirror Mask
items.descriptionText: Constructed of a molded two-way mirror, this mask grants the wearer a +2 bonus on Disguise, Intimidate, and Sense Motive skill checks. Due to its reflective surface, the wearer gains a +8 bonus on all saving throws against effects that require sight, such as gazes. Finally, there is a 10% chance that any gaze attack directed against the wearer is reflected back upon the attacking creature.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor, protection from, , spell turning

items.name: Totem Warpaint
items.descriptionText: This warpaint can come in a variety of colors and be applied in any number of designs to a creature's skin or fur. Usually a warrior uses the totem warpaint to help him improve on the skills associated with his totem animal. Once all of the warpaint is applied to a creature, they are under the effect of an aid spell, gaining a +5 competence bonus to a specific skill for a period of three hours. The paint comes in six different varieties: Anaconda: Swim Chameleon: Stealth Eagle: Perception Leopard: Climb Monkey: Acrobatics Tiger: Intimidate This warpaint can be applied to any creature, though in order to use enough of the paint to activate the magic, the creature must be Tiny or larger. Totem warpaint takes 5 minutes to apply correctly.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bull's strength (anaconda, leopard), cat's grace (chameleon, monkey), eagle's splendor (tiger), owls wisdom (eagle)

items.name: Warpaint of Victory
items.descriptionText: This warpaint can come in a variety of colors and be applied in any number of designs to a creature's skin or fur. Once all of the warpaint is applied, they are under the effect of an aid spell, gaining a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear effects, as well as receiving 1d8+3 temporary hit points for a period of three hours. This warpaint can be applied to any creature, though in order to use enough of the paint to activate the magic, the creature must be Tiny or larger. Warpaint of victory takes 5 minutes to apply correctly.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, aid

items.name: Bokrug Egg
items.descriptionText: This clammy iron sphere allows its holder to summon a ghost of Ib once per day on command.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster VIII

items.name: Legendary Brazen Head
items.descriptionText: This half-scale brass bust functions as a minor brazen head except that it can store up to 8 levels of spells and it is a more skilled and potent familiar . A legendary brazen head has 20 ranks in Profession (Yog-Sothothery philosopher), for a bonus of +25. It can only bond with an arcane spellcaster of at least 17th level that has the Improved Familiar feat. Its base saving throw bonuses are each +9. In addition, it can teleport itself once per day. Its familiar spell DCs are 4 higher than the minor brazen head due to higher Wisdom .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item or Improved Familiar, contact other plane, doom, hold person, imbue with spell ability, summon monster II, teleport

items.name: Major Brazen Head
items.descriptionText: This half-scale brass bust functions as a minor brazen head except that it can store up to 4 levels of spells and it is a more skilled and potent familiar . A major brazen head has 15 ranks in Profession (Yog-Sothothery philosopher), for a bonus of +20. It can only bond with an arcane spellcaster of at least 13th level that has the Improved Familiar feat. Its base saving throw bonuses are each +7. Its familiar spell DCs are 4 higher than the minor brazen head due to higher Wisdom .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item or Improved Familiar, contact other plane, doom, hold person, imbue with spell ability, summon monster II

items.name: Minor Brazen Head
items.descriptionText: This half-scale brass bust has a minor, normal, major, and legendary version. It functions as a minor ring of spell storing except it must be held to be used and it holds only 1 spell level. The minor brazen head has 5 ranks in Profession (Yog-Sothothery philosopher), for a bonus of +6. Unlike most intelligent items, the brazen head can use its ego to influence any character who spends at least 24 hours within 100 feet of it. The head maintains this link until claimed by or given to another owner. The head can activate itself normally to cast a spell stored by its spell storing function. A minor brazen head can serve as a spellcaster's familiar if the master has Improved Familiar and an arcane caster level of at least 5th. The head has hardness of 5 which improves instead of natural armor as its bonded spellcaster gains levels. As an intelligent item, it has base saving throw modifiers of +4 for all saving throws and no class skills. The head's ability to deliver touch spells does not allow the head to move. Instead, the head holds the spell until touched by a valid target for the spell, at which point the spell is automatically delivered. When bonded as a familiar, the brazen head can cast the following spells 1/day each— doom (DC 12), hold person (DC 13), summon monster II . A spellcaster with a minor brazen head familiar can cast contact other plane once per week with a command word while in contact with the minor brazen head to ask 6 questions.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item or Improved Familiar, contact other plane, doom, hold person, imbue with spell ability, summon monster II

items.name: Chain of the Deep
items.descriptionText: This strange, green-silver necklace shimmers as if constantly wet. While it is worn, all deep ones and deep one hybrids within 30 feet gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution and a +1 morale bonus on weapon damage rolls.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, desecrate

items.name: Disk of the Hyades
items.descriptionText: This strange, emerald disk is covered in glowing runes. When presented strongly to one or more undead creatures within 45 feet as a standard action, each must succeed at a DC 13 Will save or be unable to attack the wielder or the wielder's apparent allies for as long as the wielder continues to present it as a move action each round. Any undead that succeeds on this saving throw or that is attacked by a protected creature is immune to that disk of the Hyades for 1 day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, command undead

items.name: Flute of the Servitors
items.descriptionText: When used to play even a single note (a standard action ), this musical instrument imprints the rest of an alien melody on the mind of all listeners. Once heard, the melody makes it difficult to concentrate for the rest of the duration (1d6 rounds). No save is allowed against this effect. Listeners suffer a -4 penalty on concentration checks and skill checks and must attempt concentration checks to cast spells (DC 15 + spell level).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, enthrall

items.name: Idol of Cthulhu
items.descriptionText: This small clay sculpture of the great god Cthulhu allows the bearer to cast dream sending of Cthulhu three times per day on command without causing the target any detrimental effects aside from insanity. Once during the duration of dream sending of Cthulhu, an affected target can also cast commune to ask questions of Cthulhu. Additional castings of dream sending of Cthulhu do not worsen this insanity.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, commune, dream sending of Cthulhu

items.name: Lamp of Alhazred
items.descriptionText: This odd stone lantern seems out of place no matter where it is located. When lit in a dark area, the light it casts on any wall reveals visionary windows to other times and places. If no time and place is chosen when the lamp is lit, a random one manifests. The viewed location must have a surface of at least comparable size for the window to appear on. This window is two-way, but does not allow travel. If creatures viewed can traverse the distance on their own, however (such as via teleportation ), they might investigate the lamp's subject. The chosen subject can be in the future or the past and at any location, although the location is accurate only to within 100 miles and the time is accurate only to within 10 years. The lamp can be used once per hour by burning 1 pint of oil. Extinguishing the lamp closes the window. If fuel remains and the lamp is activated once more, it shows nothing unusual. A new window cannot be opened until the lamp has burned for 1 hour total, using up the entirety of its fuel. Extinguishing the lantern and adding a new pint of oil to refuel it is required before the lantern can open another window.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, greater scrying, foresight, vision

items.name: Leng Glass
items.descriptionText: This thin, strange, jagged piece of glass is about 1 foot long. When any creature looks through the Leng glass, it sees brief glimpses of random other places in the universe and in other planes of existence. A viewer can control the glass for 1 minute with a successful DC 20 Profession (Yog-Sothothery philosopher) skill check. The location viewed is a random one within 1d100-1 miles of the desired location. Once a viewer has successfully controlled the glass, that viewer can't control it again for 1 day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, greater scrying

items.name: Medallion of Y'ha-Nthlei
items.descriptionText: This amulet allows its bearer to breathe underwater and see as if the water was perfectly clear no matter the level of sediment in the water. It also prevents ill effects caused by depth.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, true seeing, water breathing

items.name: Seal of Hydra
items.descriptionText: Anyone attempting to pickpocket the bearer of this seal finds the targeted item immoveable and the bearer is made instantly aware of the attempted theft. If the seal is attached to a chest with a command word, no one can open or steal from the chest without first destroying the seal or by saying a command word. In all other ways, the chest is warded by arcane lock . Attempts to open the warded chest mentally alert the one who activated the seal regardless of distance. The seal and any warded container have at least hardness 20 and 50 hit points .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, alarm, arcane lock

items.name: Silver Key
items.descriptionText: This small, elaborate silver key grants whoever holds it the benefit of the Dreamer feat. If the bearer already has the Dreamer feat, the key allows him to travel to the Dreamlands even if his dream-self is dead. While the bearer uses the key to travel to the Dreamlands, the key vanishes from the dreamer's body and reappears upon the dreamer's awakening. If the bearer of the key dies in the Dreamlands, the silver key ceases to exist.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, dream

items.name: Starstone of Mnar
items.descriptionText: The starstone of Mnar grants a +4 bonus on Will saves against all attacks and spells from aquatic aberrations and other creatures closely associated with the Cthulhu Mythos (GM's discretion) that would inflict any of the following conditions: insanity, madness, confusion, fear, nauseated, and sickened . In order to receive this bonus, the owner must hold the starstone; it is not intended to be worn.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, lesser restoration, remove fear

items.name: Tiara of Mnar
items.descriptionText: This small tiara always glistens like it's just been polished. When worn, the wearer is immune to fatigue and exhaustion . Each time the tiara prevents the wearer from becoming fatigued or exhausted, it stores 1 fatigue point (for fatigued ) or 2 fatigue points (for exhausted ). When the tiara is removed, the wearer becomes fatigued if the tiara had exactly 1 fatigue point stored, or exhausted if it had 2 or more points stored. For every point beyond 2 stored, the wearer takes 1d6 points of damage. A successful Fortitude saving throw against DC 10 + number of stored fatigue points reduces the damage by half.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, ray of exhaustion

items.name: Crystal of Arcane Assimilation
items.descriptionText: This beautiful gem changes color to compliment any weapon it is attached to and moves about the item until it finds a esthetically pleasing position and then fuses with the item. If a special ritual is preformed, (requiring 8 hours) the weapon the crystal has attached to can absorb half the total gold piece value of any magical weapon that is part of the ritual.
