This haute accessory is especially appealing to vampiric nobility, and unfortunately many ladies and gentlemen unknowingly endanger their lives trying to copy the latest courtly trend. Any liquid dispensed from this bottle attracts undead within 100 miles. Undead creatures within range receive a Will save (DC 15) or are drawn irresistibly toward the scent, which lingers on the skin for 24 hours after application. The perfume's wearer receives no bonus to command any undead beckoned by the perfume . Though this item is usually the result of failure to create eau de attrait by an inexperienced crafter, darker souls occasionally gift eau de pourriture to a rival, intending discomfort at best and assassination at worst.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Cursed Item, detect undead, suggestion

items.name: Elemental Heart (Minor Artifact)
items.descriptionText: This pulsing heart seems to beat with all of the elements in sync, flaring up with different elements depending on its wielder. The bright core of the heart always seems to swirl with unearthly power, a weak heat emanating from the heart when held by someone in tune with the elements. When held by a kineticist, they gain a +2 to attack and damage rolls with their kinetic blast, a +3 to the DC of all wild talents, and no longer take damage from accepting burn, instead channeling it into the elemental heart. A hand holding an elemental heart is considered free for the purpose of gathering energy and other kineticist class abilities. Once the elemental heart has taken 300 damage in this way, it glows black and will not provide any benefit to that kineticist for 1 year. As a full round action, any kineticist who holds the elemental heart can permanently change either their primary element or one of their expanded elements into a different element. If they do, all wild talents with the previous element must be changed to ones fitting their new element, possibly causing the loss of archetypes or changes to other wild talents. If used in this way, it grows black as though it had accepted 300 points of damage through burn. DESTRUCTION An elemental heart can be destroyed if it is swallowed by an ancient or older dragon, spending a week inside of the creature's stomach as its powers are drained into the great beast. Once it has been absorbed, the dragon who devoured it advances 1 age category, making them very popular for dragons of all kinds. With the plethora of options made available to kineticists, it can be difficult to decide how one wants to build a kineticist if they don't already have some ideas in mind. The following sample characters show a few ways one can build a kineticist Npc, whether as an ally to guide players or a villain for them to conquer.

items.name: Emerald of Growth
items.descriptionText: An emerald of growth is a perfect gem, as big as a human fist, favored by elves and druids, who use it to mend the ravages of men and monsters upon nature. When someone looks through the gem, all plants within the watched area grow at double rate for 24 hours. Plant creatures seen through the emerald of growth gain the Advanced simple template for the same period. This includes creatures temporarily transformed into plants by magic. Alternatively, the emerald can be shattered to summon a single treant, as summon nature's ally VI. The treant is under the control of the creature that broke the gem and doesn't possess the animate trees ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, plant growth, summon nature's ally VI

items.name: Energizing
items.descriptionText: A set of armor with this quality is riddled with thin crystalline tubes that appear as ornate piping; these are able to sap the power of a kineticist's abilities. As an immediate action when the wearer is affected by a wild talent for which they are a target, they can activate the armor to convert the kinetic energy, receiving a number of temporary hit points equal to twice the wild talent's level. The wearer can only use this effect a number of times equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1), and these temporary hit points do not stack with each other, lasting up to 1 hour or until lost. Anyone targeting a creature wearing armor with this quality with a wild talent can accept an additional 1 point of burn to prevent the target from using this effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, internal buffer class feature

items.name: False Friend Gloves
items.descriptionText: These fine silk gloves can cast charm person once per day as a touch attack (DC 12), often as a handshake. The first attack made against anyone charmed by the wearer of these gloves receives a +5 circumstance bonus on the attack and damage roll. If the wearer possesses the dual identity class feature, they can attune the false friend gloves to themselves over 24 hours, increasing the DC to 10 + 1/2 their character level + their Charisma modifier. Stronger gloves exist which allow the wearer to instead use charm monster . Gloves with additional uses of charm person or charm monster can be made (up to 5 uses), reach additional use adding +1,000 gp to the price of the false friends gloves (+3,000 gp for additional uses of charm monster ).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, charm person, true strike

items.name: Famine Blade
items.descriptionText: These serrated daggers are forged of dark steel with a strange, oily sheen. Its obsidian hilt is encrusted with three blood-red garnets. This +1 unholy dagger enables its wielder to cast ghoul hunger as a legendary cleric of 5th level once per day. When famine pierces a creature's flesh, it acquires a taste for its target and gains the bane ability, granting the weapon an additional +2 enhancement bonus and an extra 2d6 points of damage when attacking that creature until the creature is slain. This ability is only useable once per day. The Princess of Pestilence is said to gift these blades to her most devout followers, urging them to tantalize the living with a taste of her relentless hunger. There are rumors of a more powerful version of this blade sometimes wielded by the goddess herself.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ghoul hunger, summon monster I

items.name: Flawed Facade
items.descriptionText: The item's apparent value is increased by 1d10 x 100 gp and the DC of Appraise checks to determine the item's true value is increased by 5. The creator can apply this curse more than once to the same item, up to a maximum number of once per 2 caster levels. Its effects stack.
items.constructionRequirementsText: bestow curse, disguise self

items.name: Focusing Glove
items.descriptionText: This light white glove seems to shine like a prism whenever used, flashing brilliantly in a rainbow of colors before dulling once again. A focusing glove is made with a special ability (such as distance or frost ) that can be applied to the user's kinetic blast as though it was a weapon being held in one's hand. Using a focusing glove requires the wearer to increase the total burn cost of their blast by an amount equal to the bonus of the special ability being applied to the blast. Any additional damage the special ability would do is the same as the type done by the kinetic blast unless the special ability specifies a damage type. A focusing glove can only have one special ability from the following list: +1: breaking, compassionate, corrosive, cunning, distance *, distracting, flaming, frost, ghost touch, huntsman, limning *, merciful, planar, seeking *, shock, sniping, thundering, veering +2: anarchic, axiomatic, corrosive burst, cyclonic*, designating (lesser)*, distracting (greater), flaming burst, holy, icy burst, phase locking, igniting, shattering, shocking burst, sniping (improved), stalking, unholy A focusing glove uses up the wearer's entire hands slot. The wearer cannot not use another item (even another focusing glove) that also uses the hands slot except for a conduit glove. *This special ability can only be applied to a ranged blast that requires an attack roll .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, kineticist 8th

args.text: kineticist 8th

items.name: Forgetful Sap
items.descriptionText: This smallish blackjack of matte-finish leather is a +1 deceptive sap that can wipe away the memories of a creature struck by it. A hit with a forgetful sap affects the target as memory lapse (DC 12). The save DC of this effect is increased by 2 if the target is unaware of the attacker and by 2 on a confirmed critical hit; these increases stack if both apply. Once the target fails its save, further hits do not further erase its memory. However, as a standard action the wielder of a forgetful sap can make a melee touch attack against a creature wearing light or no armor and with a natural armor bonus to AC of +5 or less. This attack deals no damage but affects the target as memory lapse, as noted above.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, memory lapse, misdirection

effects.condition: against a creature wearing light or no armor and with a natural armor bonus to A

items.name: Funereal Shroud
items.descriptionText: This sable cloak is embroidered with glistening, magical thread woven into intricate patterns: 10 golden threads, 20 silver threads, 30 copper threads, and 40 jet black threads. The threads' functions are as follows: Golden: blasphemy (DC 20) Silver: slay living (DC 20, 12d6+13) Copper: animate dead Jet black: deeper darkness The cloak may be used once per round. The cloak has the following magical properties when activated. Black feathers grow from the collar of this cloak when undead creatures are within 20 feet. The effects of the spell desecrate effect the area with the cloak as the center of the radius. The wearer may command any weapon she wields to become an unholy weapon. This is in addition to any abilities the weapon may already have (unless the weapon already is an unholy weapon). The cloak provides the benefits of magic circle against good . This protection does not stack with similar protection from other sources. Once all its magical threads have unraveled, the cloak loses its powers and the threads turn into worthless dust.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, detect undead, animate dead, deeper darkness, magic circle against good, slay living, blasphemy

items.name: Gavel of Secular Damnation
items.aura: faint conjuration, moderate evocation, strong abjuration
items.descriptionText: This +3 axiomatic merciful warhammer can be used to pound out a hasty sentence, knocking a foe miles deep into the ground to be confined in a personal prison of obscurity. Once per day, when the wielder critically hits a foe, he can cause the foe to suffer imprisonment . If the target succeeds at a Will save against this effect (DC 23), the target is instead knocked several feet into the ground, effectively buried alive in a pit of dirt. Any creature buried alive in this way is trapped and can't move and begins to suffocate. Creatures outside of the pit can dig out the buried creature. Each 5-foot cube of dirt weighs 3,000 pounds, and a creature can move 5 times her maximum load worth of dirt per minute, or 10 times her maximum load if she has a shovel or other appropriate tool. Once all squares of dirt above a creature's head have been removed, the creature can breathe, and can escape with a DC 15 Strength or Escape Artist check. A standing Medium creature typically has its head buried under 5 feet of earth (3,000 pounds). For a Small creature, this is increased to roughly 7 feet of earth (4,200 pounds). If the creature was prone when it was buried, its head is buried under the full 10 feet of earth (6,000 pounds).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure light wounds, imprisonment, order's wrath

items.name: Gloves of Paired Weapons
items.descriptionText: These sleek fingerless gloves seem to glow with power when the wearer holds two weapons, causing both weapons to faintly glow with power. When wielding two weapons, as long as at least 1 of them has a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls, both wielded weapons benefit from this enhancement bonus . The wearer can designate their unarmed strikes as a second weapon for this effect as long as they are only wielding one weapon. Gloves that can transfer larger enhancement bonuses can be found, although they are far more rare.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, magic weapon

items.name: Golden Fleece (Lesser Artifact)
items.descriptionText: The golden fleece was taken from a glorious celestial ram and has incredible healing powers. The fleece constantly sheds light, and if exposed to bright light for at least 1 minute it catches and returns that radiance as daylight for an equal amount of time to the duration it spent in bright light. If placed upon a wounded creature for 1 minute, the creature gains the benefit of heal and greater restoration . A creature affected by an enchantment, curse, or petrification may instead be affected as break enchantment and heal . It also has the power to raise the dead if placed over a corpse for 8 hours, bringing the target back to life as resurrection, though the target cannot have been dead for longer than three days. A mythic creature using the golden fleece can expend one or more uses of mythic power to enhance its effects to the mythic versions of these spells, treating its mythic rank or tier as its mythic rank for the purpose of qualifying for augmented mythic versions. A mythic creature also can expend one use of mythic power while holding the golden fleece to cause it to glow as daylight for 1 hour per mythic rank or tier even if it was not exposed to bright light. The golden fleece cannot be used more than once per day, and no creature can benefit from its healing powers more than three times. Any further use of the golden fleece has no effect on that creature. Each time the golden fleece is used, there is a 10% chance that it dissolves into golden light, reappearing 1d100 weeks later in a random location at least 1,000 miles away. DESTRUCTION The golden fleece has the power to revive a dead god, no matter how long it has been dead, but after doing so it fades away to nothingness, its powers forever expended.

items.name: Golden Fleece (Minor Artifact)
items.descriptionText: The golden fleece was taken from a glorious celestial ram and has incredible healing powers. The fleece constantly sheds light, and if exposed to bright light for at least 1 minute it catches and returns that radiance as daylight for an equal amount of time to the duration it spent in bright light. items.name: Golden Gun
items.descriptionText: This long-handled +1 reliable distance seeking human bane thundering pistol is engraved with golden lettering on barrel and grip. The weapon's gilded grip contains an extradimensional space which admits only Tiny or smaller items crafted of gold, melting them into a repository of enchanted molten gold within the weapon. A golden gun can store up to 20 pounds of gold (1000 gp value), and bullets fired by the weapon are sheathed in 1/2 pound of pure gold (25 gp value), increasing their mass and inflicting damage as a weapon one size larger; this effect is identical to and does not stack with gravity bow ). An alchemical paper cartridge coated in gold functions as a metal cartridge and does not increase the gun's misfire chance. Refilling 1/2 pound of gold into the grip's reservoir is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms & Armor, blindness/deafness, clairaudience/clairvoyance, mending, summon monster I, true seeing

items.name: Harlequin's Costume
items.descriptionText: This tight-fitting entertainer's outfit is made of flashy patches of different colors, like the costumes usually worn by court fools and street performers. It confers a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics skill checks and a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class . Once per day, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, cat's grace, freedom of movement

items.name: Healing
items.descriptionText: A healing weapon can deliver restorative energy. When hitting an opponent, the wielder can decide to heal the target instead of harming it. The weapon cures a number of hit points equal to the damage it would have normally inflicted. Constructs and objects are unaffected by this ability; against undead, a healing weapon actually inflicts 1-1/2 times the usual damage. A critical hit with a healing weapon doesn't increase the healing or have a critical hit effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure moderate wounds

items.name: Heaven's Bane
items.descriptionText: This short but heavy staff of ash is capped with a spiked unholy symbol. It can be wielded as a +1 unholy heavy mace, and it also allows use of the following spells: dread bolt (2) (1 charge) magic circle against good (3) (1 charge) vision of hell (3) (1 charge) unholy blight (4) (2 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Staff, dread bolt, magic circle against good, unholy blight, vision of hell

items.name: Helm of Aurora Borealis
items.descriptionText: The helm of aurora borealis is similar to a helm of brilliance, except its spells focus on cold rather than fire. Other aspects of the helm, such as detecting and damaging undead, remain unchanged. The helm has 10 blue topazes that can be used for freezing sphere, 20 aquamarines that can be used for wall of ice, 30 tanzanites that can be used for flurry of snowball, and 40 opals that can be used for daylight . In addition, the wearer gains resistance to cold 30 and his weapons become frost weapons instead of flaming weapons. Note: This item is variant of the helm of brilliance .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, daylight, detect undead, flurry of snowball, freezing sphere, holy ice weapon, protection from energy, wall of ice

items.name: Helm of Darkness
items.descriptionText: The helm of darkness is similar to a helm of brilliance, except it has 10 black diamonds that can be used for umbral strike, 20 jets that can be used for greater invisibility, 30 onyxes that can be used for gloomblind bolts, and 40 black opals that can be used for deeper darkness . In addition, the wearer gains resistance to cold 30 and his weapons become ghost touch weapons instead of flaming weapons. Other aspects of the helm, such as detecting and damaging undead, remain unchanged.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, deeper darkness, detect undead, ghost whip, gloomblind bolts, greater invisibility, umbral strike, protection from energy

items.name: Helm of Death's Proclaimer
items.descriptionText: This great horned helm of black metal and horn is crafted to resemble a monstrous face whose jaws encircle the wearer's face. The wearer gains the continuous benefit similar to deathwatch, and any melee weapon she wields is treated as though it had the heartseeker property. If the wearer is an antipaladin and reduces a target below 0 hit points with a melee attack, she can expend one use of her touch of corruption ability as a swift action targeting that creature. If the target is killed by this attack, the target is treated as killed by a death effect and the wearer of the helm gains the benefit of death knell, with a caster level equal to her antipaladin level. If the wearer kills an opponent with this ability and then makes an Intimidate check before the end of his turn, he gains a +10 profane bonus on that Intimidate check.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, death knell, deathwatch

items.name: Holy Answerer
items.descriptionText: This +2 bastard sword becomes a +2 holy countering bastard sword in the hands of a paladin . A paladin wielding a holy answerer may expend one use of her lay on hands class feature as a swift action to grant her weapon the speed property for 1 round. The extra attack granted by this property can only be used against a creature that damaged her since the end of her previous turn. If that creature confirmed a critical hit against the wielder since the end of her previous turn, the weapon also gains the bane property against that specific creature for 1 round.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace, holy smite

items.name: Holy Chaosbreaker
items.descriptionText: This +2 cold iron warhammer becomes a +3 axiomatic holy cold iron warhammer in the hands of a paladin . A paladin wielding a holy chaosbreaker can use her detect evil and smite evil class features against creatures of chaotic alignment as well as creatures of evil alignment, though the effects do not stack against chaotic evil creatures. She doubles her damage bonus from smiting on her first successful attack against an outsider with the chaotic subtype. If a creature the wielder smites has DR / lawful, a holy chaosbreaker reduces the target's DR / lawful by 1 with each successful hit (or by 3 on a critical hit ). This does not affect any other forms of hardness possessed by the target. When wielding a holy chaosbreaker, a paladin can also channel positive energy in order to damage creatures with the chaotic subtype, as if she had the Alignment Channel feat. In addition, when she confirms a critical hit against a creature with the chaotic subtype she can expend one use of her lay on hands or divine bond ability in order to affect the target as if her weapon had the nullifyingue property, or to attempt to banish the target as if she had cast dispel chaos (DC 17). When wielded by a paladin, this sacred weapon provides spell resistance of 10 + the paladin's class level to the wielder and all adjacent creatures. This spell resistance applies only against polymorph effects, effects with the chaotic descriptor, effects that cause confusion or insanity, or spell-like abilities used by a creature with the chaotic subtype.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, antimagic field, dispel chaos, holy smite, order's wrath

items.name: Holy Defender
items.descriptionText: This +1 defending shortsword becomes a +2 allyingue defending holy shortsword in the hands of a paladin . When a paladin wielding a holy defender uses its allying property to allocate some or all of its enhancement bonus to an ally's weapon, that weapon also gains the defender property. In addition, the wielder can allocate some or all of his bonus on saving throws from his divine grace class feature and his deflection bonus to AC when using smite evil to that ally as well until the beginning of the wielder's next turn. A paladin wielding a holy defender can substitute an aid another action to improve an ally's Armor Class in place of any of her attacks, rather than requiring a standard action . If she aids an ally's Armor Class and that ally is attacked by an evil creature, she can also expend one use of her lay on hands ability as an immediate action to add her Charisma modifier as a sacred bonus to her ally's AC against a single attack.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite, magic weapon, shield or shield of faith

items.name: Holy Dragonslayer
items.descriptionText: This +1 dragon bane lance becomes a +2 holy dragon bane lance in the hands of a paladin . A paladin wielding a holy dragonslayer can use her and smite evil class features against dragons regardless of their alignment . In addition, when she uses her smite evil ability against a dragon she gains a +2 sacred bonus on caster level checks against that dragon and on saving 23 throws against effects created by that dragon . She also gains energy resistance equal to her paladin level against energy of the same type as that dragon's breath weapon, though this effect does not apply if the dragon's breath weapon does not deal hit point damage. When wielding a holy dragonslayer, a paladin can also channel positive energy in order to damage dragons as if they were undead creatures. If the paladin is in the area of a dragon's breath weapon he can channel positive energy as an immediate action, reducing the damage dealt by its breath weapon by an amount equal to the paladin's level plus the damage that would have been cured by the paladin's channeled energy, to a minimum of no damage. This reduction in damage applies to the entire area of the dragon's breath weapon . A holy dragonslayer is very difficult for dragons to destroy. Any attack or effect created by a dragon treats the holy dragonslayer as if it had hardness 25 and as if it had 100 temporary hit points; these hit points must be depleted before applying damage from a dragon's attacks or effects to the actual hit points of the holy dragonslayer. These temporary hit points are replenished at a rate of 5 points per hour but can also be replenished with make whole .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite, make whole, protection from energy, summon monster I

items.name: Holy Liberator
items.aura: moderate abjuration, conjuration, divination, and evocation
items.descriptionText: This +1 merciful ranseur becomes a +2 holy merciful ranseur in the hands of a paladin . If paladin wielding a holy liberator has the aura of courage or aura of resolve class feature, she increases the morale bonus on saving throws she grants to her allies by 2. In addition, the wielder can detect the presence of charms and compulsions as easily as she can detect evil auras when using her detect evil class feature. If the wielder successfully strikes a creature affected by a charm or compulsion effect, she can expend one use of her lay on hands ability to suppress that effect for 10 minutes, as if using suppress charms and compulsions . If she channels positive energy, she may elect to dispel all charms and compulsions in the area (as if using greater dispel magic to perform an area dispel) in lieu of curing or dealing damage; she may choose to exclude harmless compulsions affecting allies from this dispelling . When attacking a creature affected by a charm or compulsion effect, the wielder of a holy liberator can expend one use of her divine bond or smite evil ability to create an effect similar to unwilling shield between the affected creature and the creator of the charm or compulsion (DC 19 Will negates). If the save is failed, the charmed or compelled creature gains a +1 luck bonus on AC and saves, and one-half of any hit point damage dealt to the creature is instead taken by its controller (who takes lethal damage even if the target takes nonlethal damage ).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure light wounds, holy smite, suppress charms and compulsions, unwilling shield

items.name: Holy Lifeblade
items.aura: moderate conjuration, evocation, necromancy, and transmutation
items.descriptionText: This +2 mithral scimitar becomes a +3 holy lifesurge mithral scimitar in the hands of a paladin . A paladin wielding a holy lifeblade can use her detect evil and smite evil class features against undead regardless of their alignment . When a paladin uses her smite evil ability against an undead creature, she can channel her lay on hands ability through her weapon as if it had the conductive property against that creature. In addition, she can channel her lay on hands ability as if using the conductive property against any opponent when she confirms a critical hit . When wielding a holy lifeblade, a paladin is surrounded by a continuous consecrate effect that fills her space and all adjacent squares. If this effect is dispelled, she can renew it as a standard action . If she or another good-aligned spellcaster who shares her patron deity casts consecrate, the effect of that consecrate spell is enhanced within the paladin's space and all adjacent spaces as if the holy lifeblade were an altar or permanent shrine devoted to the paladin's deity. A holy lifeblade can be used in place of a holy symbol as a spell focus for divine conjuration ( healing ) spells and spells that have a harmful effect that specifically applies to undead, such as consecrate, disrupt undead, searing light, and sunbeam, and the holy lifeblade can be used to perform any somatic components required for that spell. In addition, a paladin can expend one use of her smite evil or divine bond class feature or two uses of her lay on hands class feature to empower a paladin spell of one of the above types that she casts, as if using Empower Spell . This does not increase the level of the spell.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Channel Smite, consecrate, cure serious wounds, death ward, disrupt undead, holy smite

items.name: Holy Purifier
items.descriptionText: This +1 keen falchion becomes a +2 keen holy dispelling burstue falchion in the hands of a paladin . A paladin wielding a holy purifier can use her detect evil class feature to detect magic 23 at will, and if she expends one use of her lay on hands ability she can use arcane sight for a number of rounds equal to her paladin level. She can also use her smite evil class feature against any creature capable of casting arcane spells or that has been called or summoned by an arcane spell, regardless of its alignment . When she smites an arcane spellcaster or called or summoned creature, the holy purifier gains the heartseeker weapon property against that creature. When activating the sword's dispelling burst power against the target of her smite evil, the wielder adds her Charisma modifier as a sacred bonus on her caster level check to dispel arcane spells. In addition, if she uses this power to trigger a dispel magic effect, she can expend two uses of her lay on hands ability or one use of her smite evil or divine bond class feature as a free action to cause that dispel magic to take effect as greater dispel magic . If the wielder confirms a critical hit against the target of her smite while the holy purifier is not storing a dispel magic spell, she may spontaneously convert any paladin spell slot of 3rd level or greater into a dispel magic spell and cast it through the holy purifier. When wielding a holy purifier, a paladin radiates spell resistance of 10 + her paladin level; however, this spell resistance applies only against arcane spells or the spells or spell-like abilities of creatures called or summoned by arcane spells. Divine spells and other spell-like abilities bypass this spell resistance .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, arcane sight, detect magic, greater dispel magic, holy smite

items.name: Honeyed Allure
items.descriptionText: A creature handling or examining this object for 1 full round is captivated by it and consumed with a desire to wear or wield it (DC 14 Will negates). She always chooses to employ that item rather than another item that uses the same body slot. If it is a wielded item that does not require both hands to wield, she may use her other hand for anything she wishes and if wielding two weapons may choose which is her primary weapon.
items.constructionRequirementsText: beguiling gift, bestow curse

items.name: Hymenoptera's Hand
items.descriptionText: Five retractable syringes are concealed within the knuckles of this black and yellow striped leather glove. As part of a successful melee touch attack, the wearer of hymenoptera's hand may pierce the targeted creature with one of these syringes as a swift action . The poison or potion stored in the selected syringe is injected into the target creature. In addition, the glove's wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on checks made to craft poisons and can never accidentally poison herself. The wearer can refill one syringe as a standard action . Doing so provokes an attack of opportunity .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, poison use

items.name: Inflexible Fate
items.descriptionText: This item bonds itself to a creature who wears or wields it and cannot be gotten rid of by physical destruction unless its curse is first removed. If destroyed by any means, it reappears intact and undamaged the next time the wearer or wielder is in combat. If a worn item, it reappears on the target, worn in the appropriate body slot; any other item worn in that slot is displaced into a random pocket, pouch, pack, or other container (including extradimensional containers) on the wearer's person. If no suitable space large enough to contain the displaced item exists on the wearer's person, the displaced item falls to the ground in the wearer's space. If the cursed item is a wielded item, whenever the cursed attempts to draw an item of the same type (e.g., weapon, shield, rod, staff, wand, wondrous item) he draws the cursed item appears in his hand instead, even if the cursed weapon has been destroyed, disarmed, dropped, or stolen. Drawing the cursed item uses the normal action required to draw an item of its type. If the cursed item is a weapon and the cursed creature draws two weapons, the cursed weapon is always treated as his primary weapon and he may not make attacks with his secondary weapon unless he first attacks with the cursed weapon.
items.constructionRequirementsText: bestow curse, make whole, teleport

items.name: Inspector's Bullhorn
items.descriptionText: This open-ended trumpet of horn bound with gold is mounted with a small handle to make it easy to carry. It amplifies the wielder's voice, granting all creatures within a 60-foot cone a +10 bonus on Perception checks to hear his voice. The wielder's voice also becomes a stern voice of authority, granting him a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks against creatures in a 60-foot cone when speaking through the bullhorn; this bonus is increased to +10 when making Intimidate checks to temporarily alter a creature's attitude. If the wielder uses a sonic effect within the 60-foot cone toward which he is pointing the bullhorn, the save DC of the effect is increased by 1, and if it deals sonic damage that damage is increased by 1 point per die. Three times per day, the wielder can issue a one-word command to creatures within the 60-foot cone, functioning either as greater command (DC 17) or greater forbid action (DC 17), as chosen by the wielder. Alternatively, the wielder can command all creatures within the cone to show themselves; those that fail their Will save cannot attempt Stealth checks on their next turn, and if already hidden reveal themselves, dismissing invisibility, blink, ethereal jaunt, gaseous form, and similar effects. If already visible, they must use a move action to move towards the wielder. Affected creatures can attempt a new saving throw each round at the end of their turn to end this compulsion to reveal themselves. This is a mind-affecting compulsion .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, fear, greater command, greater forbid action, mass suggestion, shout

items.name: Ironskull Shield
items.descriptionText: This +1 bashing spiked heavy steel shield is worked in the likeness of a howling fiendish skull, crowned with spikes and jagged flanges. When used to make shield bash attacks, the ironskull shield is considered an evil weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction . The eyes of the skull glow red, shedding light as a torch, though the wielder can suppress or reactivate this light as a standard action . Once per day while the eyes are alight, the wielder can unleash a pair of scorching rays; one-half of this damage is considered profane damage that is not subject to fire resistance or immunity . The scorching rays may target one opponent or separate opponents. Using these scorching rays extinguishes the light of the ironskull shield for 1 minute. An antipaladin using his fiendish boon class feature can channel a portion of the fiendish spirit into the ironskull shield adding some or all of the enhancement bonus he is allowed into the shield to increase either its enhancement bonus as a shield or its enhancement bonus as a weapon The enhancement bonus (and any special abilities used in place of the enhancement bonus ) from the fiendish spirit stacks with the enhancement bonus and special abilities of the ironskull shield itself. An ironskull shield bestows one permanent negative level on any good creature attempting to wield it. The negative level remains as long as the shield is in hand and disappears when the shield is no longer wielded. This negative level cannot be overcome in any way (including restoration spells) while the shield is wielded.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, align weapon, bull's strength, scorching ray

items.name: Jester's Cap
items.descriptionText: This is the typical three-pointed, multicolored hat with bells on, worn by court fools. The cap grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Bluff skill checks. In addition, the cap's bells automatically ring if a hostile creature comes nearby, as per the alarm spell. The wearer can silence the bells at will.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, alarm, glibness

items.name: Juror Breastplate
items.descriptionText: This golden +1 breastplate is embossed with the holy symbol of a deity of justice and holds divinatory runes in a secret compartment. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks and can cast augury once per day. When the wearer uses detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, or detect law, at the beginning of her next turn after casting she gains information as if she had concentrated for 3 full rounds. Finally, if the wearer is an legendary inquisitor, she can store 1 use of an instantaneous office ability in the breastplate as if she were wielding a barrister weapon. The legendary inquisitor can then discharge the stored ability by hitting an opponent with an unarmed strike .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, augury

items.name: Jutsu Scroll
items.descriptionText: A jutsu scroll is a ninja trick that has been stored in written form. It functions as a scroll, with the following exceptions. The effective spell level is 1/2 (rounded down, minimum 0) the minimal ninja level required to learn the stored ninja trick. The creator's ninja level functions as the caster level . Deciphering a jutsu scroll requires a read magic spell or a successful Linguistics check (DC 20 + effective spell level). Activating a jutsu scroll requires the user to be a ninja or otherwise have a class feature that grants access to ninja tricks. If the user meets these prerequisites but does not have a ninja level (or level in another class that grants ninja tricks) at least equal to the jutsu scroll's caster level to use the scroll, they must make a special caster level check (DC = jutsu scroll 's caster level +1) using their ninja level to avoid a mishap as per the rules for scrolls . Using a jutsu scroll duplicates the effect of its stored ninja trick. If the ninja trick's duration is something other than instantaneous or permanent, the scroll's user is instead treated as though they know that scroll's ninja trick for ten minutes per caster level. Any non-permanent effects created by the ninja trick fade away at the end of this duration.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Scribe Scroll, creator must know the appropriate ninja trick

items.name: Lava Gem
items.descriptionText: Made from the solidified breath weapon of a ruby dragon, this small ruby can be thrown or used as a sling bullet. It shatters at impact, releasing a small quantity of lava that deals 1d6 points of fire damage.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, lava droplets

items.name: Leaf of the Seasons
items.descriptionText: These leaf–shaped brooches come in four types, dedicated to the deities of seasons. Each is beautifully forged in a different metal. Once per day, on command, a rotating windstorm (see the control winds spell) rises for 1 minute in a 40–feet sphere around the wearer. The wearer can end the wind prematurely if she so desires. Beyond that, the wind carries seasonal storms, depending on the specific leaf worn: Copper (spring): The wind carries a flurry of flower petals, dazzling and dazing with their scent all creatures as long as they stay in the area of effect. Gold (summer): The wind carries heavy rain, reducing visibility to 1d10 x 5 ft. and giving a –2 penalty on attacks to all creatures as long as they stay in the area of effect. Bronze (autumn): Razor–sharp leaves dazzle creatures and inflict them 1d4 points of slashing damage every round they stay in the area of effect. Silver (winter): A snow blizzard reduces visibility to 1d10 x 5 ft. and deals 1d4 points of cold damage to all creatures every round they stay in the area of effect. Targets of a leaf of the seasons can negate its effects with a successful DC 17 Fort save.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Cost 17,640 GP Craft Wondrous Item, control weather
items.constructionCostText: 17,640 GP Craft Wondrous Item, control weather

args.text: 640 GP Craft Wondrous Item

items.name: Leviathan Cross
items.descriptionText: This +1 conductive light crossbow is designed with kinetic powers in mind. It is a solid steel blue weapon with thin conduits carved along the stock; these conduits glow brightly as a kineticist pours their kinetic power into it, usually in a color matching with the blast's elements. If the weapon's conductive property is used to deliver a kinetic blast, the bolt fired can twist and turn along its trajectory as if it was a kinetic blast affected by the snake infusion, except using the weapon's range. Because this affects the crossbow bolt rather than the blast, the kineticist can still apply infusions to the blast as normal. However, some form infusions function differently. If a form infusion creates a line or cone area of effect, then it treats the targeted square as its point of origin and is aimed in the direction the bolt was moving when it hit its target or landed. If a form infusion has an emanation area centered around its user, instead treat it as a burst with the targeted square as its center. Because the leviathan cross is a ranged weapon, its conductive property cannot be used with form infusions which would be part of a melee attack (such as kinetic blade).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, snake infusion

items.name: Lyre of Animals
items.descriptionText: The first specimen of this perfect, ornate golden lyre is said to have been crafted by Orpheus, the greatest bard of Greece and son of Apollo. After Orpheus' death, his lyre was brought to the skies to become a constellation. A lyre of animals grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Perform ( string instruments) checks. A bard with an archetype tied to nature (GM's judgment ) gains a +1 level bonus on his archetype-specific performances' effects while playing the lyre. By succeeding at a DC 15 Perform ( string instruments) check, the bearer can achieve the following effects: calm animals (at will) speak with animals (3/day) summon nature's ally V ( animals only, 1/day).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, calm animals, speak with animals, summon nature's ally V

items.name: Manacles of Silent Penance
items.descriptionText: These seemingly delicate shackles are connected with fine silvery chains whose fragile appearance belies their hardness and effectiveness. As long as the manacles of silent penance remain locked on a target, which requires that the target be pinned or helpless, that target's space is filled with a silence effect that moves with him (no save). This silence is ended if the manacles of silent penance are broken or removed. The manacles have a break DC of 30 and a Disable Device DC of 40, and if attacked they have hardness 20 and 40 hit points . If a paladin places the manacles on an evil creature, she can expend one use of her smite evil ability to reinforce the power of the manacles, increasing their hardness, break DC, Disable Device DC, and the DC of caster level checks to dispel the manacles by an amount equal to her Charisma modifier for 24 hours and granting the manacles temporary hit points equal to twice her paladin level. Any damage dealt to the manacles is deducted first from these temporary hit points; otherwise, they last 24 hours or until expended. Caster level checks to suppress the power of the manacles A creature wearing manacles of silent penance that attempts to speak, break the manacles, or open their lock is wracked with pain, taking 2d6 points of nonlethal damage and becoming sickened for 1d6 rounds. A successful DC 14 Fortitude save halves damage and eliminates the sickened condition. A Manacled creature that is already sickened and fails its save becomes nauseated and sickened for the same duration. If already nauseated, the manacled creature falls unconscious on a failed save.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bestow curse, protection from evil, silence

items.name: Mark of the Authority
items.descriptionText: This brass badge is emblazoned with the motif of a hawk and an olive branch in front of a star. This mark grants the wearer and all allies within 30 feet a +1 competence bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD . In addition, the wearer may cast each of the following spells once per day: bungle (DC 15), memorize page, and unprepared combatant (DC 15).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bungle, heroism, memorize page, and unprepared combatant

items.name: Martial Wraps
items.descriptionText: Coming in a variety of colors, these wraps are meant to be tightly wound around a creature's limbs, securing them in place. A set of martial wraps comes with enough cloth to cover one set of arms and legs, resizing for larger creatures. A creature wearing these wraps on their limbs gains an enhancement bonus of +1 to +5 on attack and damage rolls with unarmed attacks made with limbs covered by the wraps. Alternatively, these wraps can grant melee weapon special abilities, so long as they can be applied to unarmed attacks. See Table 3-8: Melee Weapon Special Abilities in Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Ultimate Equipment for a list of abilities. Special abilities count as additional bonuses for determining the market value of the item, but do not modify attack or damage bonuses. Martial wraps cannot have a modified bonus ( enhancement bonus plus special ability bonus equivalents) higher than +5. Martial wraps do not need to have a +1 enhancement bonus to grant a melee weapon special ability. These wraps can also be infused with metal into the cloth, being treated as a light weapon weight 5 lbs. for determining the cost of doing so. If they are infused with a metal, the wearer treats all unarmed strikes as though they were attacks as though they were made of that material, although they can only be infused with a single material.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, greater magic fang, creator's caster level must be at least three times the amulet's bonus, plus any

args.text: creator's caster level must be at least three times the amulet's bonus

items.name: Mask of the Blood-Drinker
items.descriptionText: An antipaladin can use this ability to stave off the ravages of time. The wearer does not age so long as he damages a sentient creature with his touch of corruption and consumes at least one gallon of blood every 24 hours. If the wearer harms multiple sentient victims with his touch of corruption during a 24-hour period, he becomes younger by a number of days equal to the number of sentient victims afflicted by his touch . The wearer cannot become younger than the base starting age for his race by use of this ability. A wearer killed while wearing a mask of the blood-drinker rises as a non-mindless undead whose CR is no greater than one-half the wearer's Hit Dice (GM's discretion as to type of undead ) as long as he has harmed at least one sentient creature and consumed at least one gallon of blood in the preceding 24 hours. This destroys the mask. An undead antipaladin can maintain the appearance of life and health by using its touch of corruption and consuming blood in the same fashion. An undead creature destroyed while wearing a mask of the blood-drinker rises again 2d4 days after being destroyed—much like the rejuvenation ability of a ghost —so long as at least one sentient creature has suffered the effects of your touch of corruption and you have consumed at least one gallon of blood in the preceding 24 hours. This also destroys the mask.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, false life, lesser age resistance

items.name: Mask of the Comedian
items.descriptionText: This crude wooden mask has a wide open mouth with a buffoonish grin. A creature wearing it speaks in a deep, booming voice that can't be recognized as belonging to the wearer. The mask grants a +3 bonus on Perform (comedy) to the wearer. Three times per day, the wearer can tell a joke that has the effect of a symbol of laughter in a 60-ft. radius.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, glibness, symbol of laughter

items.name: Greater Memory Charm
items.descriptionText: A greater memory charm functions as a lesser memory charm but implants a false memory in place of the creature's true memory of acquiring the item, rather than simply causing her to forget the item's provenance (DC 16 Will negates).
items.constructionRequirementsText: bestow curse, modify memory

items.name: Lesser Memory Charm
items.descriptionText: A creature acquiring this object forgets the person or place from which she acquired it within 1d6 rounds after she no longer has line of sight to that creature or location. A successful DC 14 Will negates this effect; however, for every 24 hours that pass without seeing the creature or location where the items was acquired, a new saving throw is required to avoid forgetting that person or place.
items.constructionRequirementsText: bestow curse, memory lapse

items.name: Mirror of the Simurgh
items.descriptionText: This round, plain polished full-figure silver mirror was created to help both mortals and immortals in their path to enlightenment. Whoever looks in the mirror of the simurgh sees their true soul rather than its physical appearance, and can learn many things about illumination. Each image visible in the mirror shows the creature's alignment, emotion, health and magic aura, and is not fooled by spells and effects that alter auras. A creature seeing its image gains a glimpse of future rewards or punishments caused by its actions. A good creature is elated from this vision, gaining a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks for the next 24 hours. An evil creature is shaken and suffers an equal penalty for the same time; alternatively, it can accept an immediate atonement to change its alignment . A neutral viewer suffers half the penalty (-1 on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks) if it doesn't accept an atonement .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, analyze

items.name: Mundane Glasses
items.descriptionText: A pair of small unassuming glasses that appear to make the wearer appear more ordinary. If the wearer possesses the seamless guise class feature or the Masked Identity feat, the circumstance bonus from that ability increases by 5. The wearer also gains a +5 circumstance bonus to disguise checks made while using a vigilante talent while in their social identity to keep their identity a secret.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, disguise self

items.name: Nightwatch Crossbow
items.descriptionText: This +1 heavy crossbow is crafted from dark ebony wood and has the image of an eye flanked by two crescent moons carved onto each limb. An enchanted piece of circular glass is attached to the bridge of a nightwatch crossbow, allowing the wielder to peer through it while wielding the crossbow and see living creatures up to 120 feet away as though he had darkvision . This negates any attack roll penalties or miss chance from concealment due to darkness, unless it is magical darkness. This does not reveal invisible creatures and the wielder must still succeed at a Perception check to notice hidden creatures, but the nightwatch crossbow negates any bonuses on Stealth checks granted to creatures hidden by dim light or darkness. Once per day, a nightwatch crossbow may fire a bolt that bursts into daylight after it hits a target creature or 5-ft. square. This daylight persists for 50 minutes.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, daylight, faerie fire

items.name: Obsessive Allure
items.descriptionText: This functions as honeyed allure (DC 16 Will negates). In addition, the wearer or wielder of the object becomes paranoid about losing the item and afraid of it being damaged or stolen. He takes elaborate precautions to safeguard it and is extremely suspicious of anyone commenting on his odd behavior or his precious item, responding to them as if targeted with malicious spite (DC 16 Will negates).
items.constructionRequirementsText: beguiling gift, bestow curse, malicious spite

items.name: Parching Parchment
items.descriptionText: This razor-edged sheet of parchment soaks up blood at terrifying speed . A parching parchment functions like a +1 cruel dagger until it scores a successful critical hit, sneak attack, or coup de grace against a living target, at which point the target is affected by the horrid wilting spell (no save, caster level 16th). After this spell effect expires, the parchment becomes a non-magical, bloody sheet of parchment. Alternatively, a parching parchment can function as a scroll of horrid wilting ( caster level 16th)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Scribe Scroll, cause fear, death knell, horrid wilting

items.name: Partisan
items.descriptionText: A partisan weapon is devoted to the cause of a single nation or city-state, infused with the unified power of the citizenry and their devotion to their homeland. If the wielder is a citizen of the attuned nation, city, or state, she gains several benefits. First, the wielder gains a +4 insight bonus on Bluff, Disguise, and Sleight of Hand checks to conceal the weapon from citizens of other nations. On a successful hit against a flat-footed humanoid target of a different nationality, the target must succeed at DC 13 Will save or be shaken for 1 minute. Finally, the wielder receives a +2 bonus to confirm critical hits against humanoid citizens of other nations. The creator of a partisan weapon must be a citizen of the nation to be attuned to the weapon. This nation must be determined at the weapon's creation and cannot be altered.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, weapon of awe, creator must be a citizen of the chosen nation

args.text: creator must be a citizen of the chosen nation

items.name: Phellem Vellum
items.descriptionText: This sheet of magically treated tree bark is as soft and pliant as rawhide, and is covered in druidic script. When pressed against a willing creature's skin (as a move action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity ), the phellum vellum grafts and spreads, granting the creature a +5 bonus to their natural armor class for the next hour. Alternatively, a sheet of phellem vellum can function like a druid scroll of barkskin ( caster level 12th).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Scribe Scroll, barkskin

effects.condition: When pressed against a willing creature's skin (as a move action that does not p

items.name: Phylactery of Heresy
items.descriptionText: This cursed item appears to work like a phylactery of faithfulness, but instead guides the wearer to commit acts that will adversely affect her alignment or cause her to lose favor with her deity.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Cursed Item, detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law

items.name: Pilferer's Gloves
items.descriptionText: These smooth gloves have small pockets on the inside that contain a concealable set of masterwork thieves' tools which are almost impossible to find, granting a +10 bonus on Sleight of Hand or Stealth checks to hide them when being searched. Whenever the wearer attempts a Disable Device or Sleight of Hand check or steal combat maneuver to take an item, open a door, or otherwise disturb an item that has been warded with an alarm, magic mouth, or similar triggered alarm, he is immediately alerted to its presence and can attempt a caster level check (using the caster level of the gloves) as a swift action to dispel that alarm, as dispel magic . If the check fails, he cannot dispel the magical alarm but can attempt to disarm it as if it were a magical trap ( Disable Device DC 25 + spell level). Additionally, whenever the wearer is making a Disable Device check, he may choose to shroud the space he occupies with magical silence that lasts as long as it takes to complete the check, until the beginning of his next turn. He gains a +5 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks made to open a door (or similar aperture) without being noticed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, dispel magic, secret chest, silence

items.name: Plague Stone
items.descriptionText: This dark, wine-colored crystalline stone is approximately 6 inches in diameter and has a small metal loop mounted on the back, suitable for it to be hung by a rope or chain. With a command word, the plague stone can light up as per continual flame with a bright ruby color which can be seen plainly even in daylight; the same word dismisses the continual flame It manifests a moderate divination aura, but has no divination properties.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, continual flame, magic

items.name: Planar Gates Tattoo
items.descriptionText: Thin lines on the face cross vertically over the bearer's eyes, branching out to surround them in intricate swirls. When a kineticist bears this tattoo, the ink glows faintly with their elemental power, and their eyes take on an unsettling shine which flares up to a brilliant light moments before unleashing a kinetic blast. The bearer of this tattoo can use an energy kinetic blast they know by firing their kinetic power through their eyes, allowing them to use them without free hands. Kinetic blasts fired this way are treated as rays for the purpose of effects which affect rays.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Cost 650 gp

items.name: Pressuring
items.price: normal (+1 bonus), improved (+2 bonus), greater (+3 bonus)
items.descriptionText: A pressuring shield drains the energies fueling a creature's mystical abilities. If the user is hit by a hostile extraordinary, spell-like, or supernatural ability which consumes a resource (such as ki, grit, rounds of rage, or burn) or has a certain number of uses per day (such as Stunning Fist or the alchemist's bomb class feature), the attacker is forced to spend or accept 1 additional point of that resource or 1 additional use per day of that ability unless they succeed a Will save (DC = 10 + shield's enhancement bonus ). The DC of this check is increased by 5 for an improved pressuring shield, and by 10 for a greater pressuring shield . If this would reduce a resource or the uses per day of an ability below 0, it instead reduces it to 0. This functions even if an ability's resource cost is 0 so long as the cost is defined, and the increase in cost from the pressuring quality occurs after adjustments from abilities which reduce a hostile ability's cost. It does not, however, affect spells.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ki leech

items.name: Pugilist's Robe
items.price: 8,000 GP (MAGIC), 12,000 GP (SILVER OR COLD IRON), 16,000 GP (ADAMANTINE)
items.descriptionText: This stylish robe will alter its appearance to fit the personality of its wearer as well as resizing itself if needed. If a medium or small creature wears this robe, they treat their unarmed strikes as though they were 1 size larger for the purpose of how much damage they deal. They also treat their unarmed strikes as magic for the purpose of penetrating damage reduction . Other robes can be found which allow their wearer to also treat their unarmed strikes as silver, cold iron, or adamantine for the purpose of penetrating damage reduction .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, enlarge person, magic weapon
items.constructionCostText: 4,000 GP (MAGIC), 6,000 GP (COLD IRON OR SILVER), 8,000 GP (ADAMANTINE)

items.name: Quickchange Studded Leather
items.descriptionText: Putting on this suit of +2 studded leather is pure ease and comfort. With the merest of effort, the armor conforms itself to the wearer by adjusting itself to the wearer's limbs, pulling its own straps, fastening its own buckles, and cinching itself for effortless fit. Likewise, when it's time to remove the armor, it all but jumps off the wearer. By speaking a command word, the straps loosen, knots unravel, and the entire suit comes sliding off. A suit of quickchange studded leather reduces the amount of time to don the armor to 5 rounds and only 1 round to don hastily. With a command word, removing the armor is 1 move action . The wearer may choose to remove a suit of quickchange studded leather as part of making an Escape Artist check. This does not require a separate action and grants the wearer a +10 circumstance bonus on a single Escape Artist check to escape bonds, a grapple, or a trap .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, grease

items.name: Rapping Wrapping
items.descriptionText: When this sheet of wrapping paper is manually pressed against a locked door, box, or chest, the target is affected by the knock spell ( caster level 12th). Whether the spell succeeds or not, the rapping wrapping is destroyed after being used in this way. Alternatively, a sheet of rapping wrapping can function like a scroll of knock ( caster level 12th).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Scribe Scroll, knock

items.name: Ratty Robes
items.descriptionText: These tattered brown robes are threadbare and worn, causing the wearer to appear inoffensive, non-threatening, and unworthy of notice, granting a +5 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand checks. In addition, ratty robes inure the wearer to the filth of the alleys and sewers, granting him a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against disease and ingested or inhaled poisons (including stinking cloud and similar effects). Rats (including dire rats and rat swarms ) recognize the wearer as a kindred creature and do not attack the wearer unless magically controlled. In addition, once per day as an immediate action the wearer can polymorph into a rat swarm himself. All equipment is merged into his form. If he triggers this ability in response to an attack with a piercing or slashing weapon, he takes half damage from that attack and ignores additional damage from critical hits or precision-based damage. He does not gain immunity to effects that affect only a single target when activating this transformation, but thereafter he gains the swarm traits and special attacks of a rat swarm, and can remain in this form for up to 10 minutes or dismiss the effect as a standard action . When resuming his normal form, the wearer may choose the square in which his body reappears. If any portion of his swarm form is separated by a physical barrier from the rest at the time he resumes his normal form, those rats shrivel and die when the wearer resumes his normal form and the wearer takes 1d4 points of Constitution damage for each square of rats that perishes in this way.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape II, summon swarm

effects.condition: against disease and ingested or inhaled poisons (including stinking cloud and si

items.name: Reduction Harness
items.descriptionText: Made of intricately woven copper and silver depicting a mighty beast being reduced to a small cub, this harness can only be worn by a drake with a charge or an animal companion . Upon being activated with a command word, the wearer's size is reduced to Tiny, remaining so indefinitely until the command word is spoken again.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, reduce person

items.name: Regenerating (Armor Quality)
items.descriptionText: A suit of regenerating armor self-repairs, becoming whole again even after being reduced to mere shreds. Whenever an armor with this quality is damaged, unless it is completely destroyed, it regains 1d6+1 hit points per hour after the fight ends, up to a maximum of 10d6+10. Other magic properties of the armor that may have been lost are restored as well.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, greater make whole

items.name: Ring of Condensing Explosions
items.descriptionText: Those who wear this ring can use a weak telekinetic force to draw the fragments of a splash weapon back toward their point of origin. Those wearing a ring of condensing explosions can apply the effects of the Concentrated Splash feat to all splash weapons (including alchemists ' bombs) 3 times per day, but no more often than once every 2 hours. There are two advanced forms of the ring of condensing explosions which focus on particular forms of splash weapons: alchemical and kinetic. An alchemical ring of condensing explosions can only be used with bombs created with the bomb class feature, but the wearer can do so at will, once per round. A kinetic ring of condensing explosions can only be used with kinetic blasts affected by the kinetic bomb infusion or an infusion for which kinetic bomb is a prerequisite, but its wearer can do so a number of times per day equal to their kineticist level plus their Constitution modifier, and can do so once per round. The effects of these advanced forms do not stack with those of a normal ring of condensing explosions, instead causing the normal ring to become inert.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Cost 4,250 gp (normal), 6,500 gp (alchemical), 6,500 gp (kinetic) Forge Ring, Concentrated Splash, bomb class feature or kinetic bomb infusion, telekinesis or basic telekinesis wild talent
items.constructionCostText: 4,250 gp (normal), 6,500 gp (alchemical), 6,500 gp (kinetic) Forge Ring, Concentrated Splash, bomb class feature or kinetic bomb infusion, telekinesis or basic telekinesis wild talent

items.name: Ring of Elemental Strength
items.descriptionText: This simple pale stone sits atop a plain steel band, flickering every so often with unknown power. When worn by a creature who possesses a kinetic blast, add 1 damage of the same type their simple blast deals for each of its damage dice. A composite ring of elemental strength can augment a creature's composite blasts as well as their simple blasts.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Cost 2,500 gp (simple), 5,000 gp (composite) Forge Ring, kineticist 10th
