000 gp (composite) Forge Ring
kineticist 10th

items.name: Ring of Stammering
items.descriptionText: Delicately carved letters and symbols spell out the alphabets of four languages around the inside of this silver ring. The wearer gains the ability to read and understand the four languages whose alphabets are inscribed on the ring. This item functions similarly to a ring of eloquence, save for one embarrassing flaw. The wearer cannot speak the languages granted by the ring, and attempts to find the words to express herself in any language are characterized by stuttering, stammering, and slurring words together, incurring a –2 penalty to Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Perform (oratory) checks. Also, if the wearer is deafened and attempts to cast a spell with a verbal component, the chance of spell failure is increased to 30%.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Cursed Item, comprehend languages, fumbletongue

items.name: Ring of the Treacherous Advisor
items.descriptionText: A finely wrought snake is entwined around this platinum ring. When the wearer of a ring of the treacherous advisor is targeted with a spell that would reveal alignment, the wearer's alignment appears to match that of the caster of the revealing spell. By speaking a command word, the tiny snake on the ring opens its mouth and allows the wearer to lie freely, even under the effects of spells such as discern lies or zone of truth, for no longer than 1 hour per day. Once the hour of time is up, or if the ring is deactivated, the snake's mouth closes.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring,

items.name: Robe of Burn Conversion
items.descriptionText: This nondescript white robe hangs low on the wearer, appearing ordinary and a bit plain. The garment only shows its true nature upon the wearer accepting burn, flashing a deep vibrant red before fading back into its plain white hue. If the wearer accepts burn, they are instantly granted temporary hit points equal to 1/2 the amount of damage they suffered from accepting burn (minimum 1). Temporary hit points from this item stack with those gained from itself and wild talents and last for 24 hours or until lost, whichever comes first.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, kineticist 15th, force ward

args.text: kineticist 15th

items.name: Robe of Elemental Resistance
items.descriptionText: Appearing to be a plain white robe at first, when worn by someone with kinetic powers, it fills with elemental runes matching that of its bearer. When worn by a creature who possesses the elemental overflow class feature, they gain a resistance bonus to all of their saving throws equal to the bonus to attack rolls they gain from that class feature while it is active. This bonus is limited by the strength of the robe, and versions exist that allow greater resistance bonuses to saving throws.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, kineticist of a level at least three times the bonus of the robe

args.text: kineticist of a level at least three times the bonus of the robe

items.name: Rod of Major Hexes
items.descriptionText: A rod of major hexes is identical to a rod of hexes of its same name, but affects both normal and major hexes (not grand hexes).
items.constructionRequirementsText: for abrupt)
items.constructionCostText: 27,500 gp (grasping, interminable), 81,250 gp (voracious), 135,000 gp (potent), 188,750 gp (abrupt) Craft Rod, appropriate feat ( Reach Spell for grasping, Extend Spell for interminable, Split Hex for voracious, Maximize Spell for potent, Quicken

items.name: Roofrunner's Buckler
items.descriptionText: This +1 buckler has patchwork coloring and has a slight flare around its edges. By setting a roofrunner buckler down and speaking a command word, a creature weighing no more than 500 lbs. may step onto the buckler and, as a move action, hover across ground or open air, moving no more than 30 feet in one direction before it stops. The rider may stop the buckler and deactivate it as a free action before it reaches 30 feet, but once it moves 30 feet, it deactivates automatically and goes to the ground. Any creature on the buckler when it deactivates falls, unless affected by feather fall or other similar precaution. A roofrunner buckler must start on solid ground to be activated. A creature fighting while riding the buckler is unsteady, taking a -2 penalty to attack and damage rolls and AC. Casting a spell while riding the buckler requires a successful concentration check. The buckler cannot change directions mid-air; it must be deactivated and reactivated to pick a new direction.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, floating disk

items.name: Ruby Diamond of Eala
items.descriptionText: This fist-sized uncut gem looks like a human heart. One half is ruby-red with white flecks; the other is diamond-white with red flecks. Five times per day when the gem is held in one hand, a spellcaster can use this item as an additional focus component when casting a spell that deals cold or fire damage, converting up to half the spell's cold damage to fire damage or vice versa, as if using the Elemental Spell metamagic feat . Unlike the feat, this does not alter the casting time or spell level of the spell. In addition, when held, the gem provides the bearer resistance 20 against cold and fire. At will as a free action, the bearer can command the ruby diamond of Eala to glow as brightly as a torch with either red or white flame, manipulate this light as if it were dancing lights, or snuff this light.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Elemental Spell, resist energy

items.name: Saboteur Spell Gem
items.descriptionText: This tiny, unassuming jewel is designed to interfere with magical implements. Using a magic item that has a saboteur's spell gem attached immediately triggers the gem, subjecting the item to dispel magic . After discharging the spell, the gem crumbles into a non-magical powder. Saboteur's spell gems trigger when attached to an item that is actively used or items that require activation, such as a magic weapon or boots of teleportation . The price of a saboteur's spell gem is equal to the creator's caster level (minimum 5) x 100 gp. Attaching the gem to an item requires a standard action . Anyone inspecting the item can detect the gem by succeeding at a Perception or Spellcraft check versus your opposed Disable Device check. If the gem's caster level is equal to or lesser than the attached item, the gem's magical aura is completely suppressed as per magic aura (DC 11). Multiple gems may be attached to the same item, though their combined caster level determines whether their auras are suppressed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, dispel magic, magic

items.name: Saddle of Shared Smiting
items.descriptionText: When this saddle is placed on a creature and that creature is ridden by creature with the good subtype or an aura of good (such as a paladin or good-aligned cleric of a good-aligned deity), all of the mount's natural weapons are considered good-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction . In addition, if the rider is a paladin and uses her smite evil class feature while mounted, her mount gains the benefits of smite evil against the same target, though any numeric bonuses granted by the smite are halved. Numeric bonuses are based on the paladin's level and Charisma score, not the mount's. If the paladin dismounts or is dismounted, the benefits of smite evil persist until the end of the paladin's next turn and then end if the paladin has not remounted by that time. If the paladin remounts the creature, the smite evil benefits continue for as long as they remain in effect on the paladin. A paladin rider may choose to expend two uses of smite evil as part of the same swift action, providing her mount with the full bonuses of her smite evil . If he does this, the mount does not lose these benefits if the paladin dismounts; the benefits persist until the target of the smite is slain or until the paladin chooses to smite a different target.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bless weapon

items.name: Santa's Bottomless Sack (Minor Artifact)
items.descriptionText: Whether it appears empty or full, this huge sack's weight doesn't change, allowing even a child to carry it. It functions as a giant bag of holding, only it can store 8,000 lbs. of stuff and its inner space is 1,600 cubic ft. It also allows its owner to cast major creation by reaching inside with a hand. Lastly, once per day the bottom of the sack can transform into a gate to Santa Claus' sanctum, where he can recover other items newly crafted by his followers. DESTRUCTION Santa's bottomless sack is destroyed if it is filled with toys stolen from good children.

items.name: Santa's List (Minor Artifact)
items.descriptionText: This sealed scroll is divided in three columns, titled " Nice," " Naughty," and " Neither," in an ornate gilded handwriting. Under each column there is space for a hundred names. If the owner speaks aloud the true name of a living creature, that name appears on the list under one of the columns, depending on the creature's alignment with respect to good and evil. If a dead creature's name or a false name is spoken, nothing appears on the list. Every time the scroll is rolled and unrolled again, all the names written on it disappear. DESTRUCTION Santa's list is destroyed if 100 names of evil creature's are written by hand in the "Nice" column, and 100 names of good creatures in the "Naughty" column.

items.name: Santa's Sleigh (Major Artifact)
items.descriptionText: Santa's sleigh appears as a normal wooden snow sleigh, except for its gilded furniture and a glittering golden glow around it. Only Santa Claus or someone with his permission can drive the sleigh and give orders to the 8 awakened reindeer that pull it. The sleigh can travel on every terrain type and even on water without penalties, and flies at its same land speed as per air walk . Every creature yoked to Santa's sleigh receives the effects of air walk . The sleigh's driver, passengers, and the yoked creatures are also constantly protected by endure elements . In addition, every spell or effect affecting the driver or cast by the driver on himself or the sleigh also affects the passengers and every creature pulling it. Santa's sleigh can accommodate 8 Medium creatures (or 16 Small creatures) when it's empty; when Santa's bottomless sack is on board, it only accommodates 2 Medium creatures (or 4 Small creatures), including its driver. The sleigh's bells can be rang three times per day to create the effect of joyful rapture . Lastly, the driver can cast time stop and greater invisibility at will while the sleigh is flying; both spells last as long as the driver wishes. DESTRUCTION Santa's sleigh is destroyed if Santa Claus and his nine reindeer willingly trample on it all at once.

items.name: Scabbard Ring
items.descriptionText: This ring consists of a thin lead wire wrapped in strips of hardened red leather. The scabbard ring allows its wearer to transfer a single one-handed weapon to their forearm in the form of a tattoo. Transforming a weapon to or from tattoo form requires a full-round action . The scabbard ring can only have one weapon in tattoo form at a time. Should the ring be removed while a weapon is in tattoo form, the tattoo will fall over the arm and revert to its original form.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, shrink item

items.name: Scale of Endless Bureaucracy
items.descriptionText: The curious design of this +2 scale mail features rows of interlocking pieces of folded parchment that nonetheless moves with and protects the wearer as a suit of conventional armor. There are 25 scales in the armor that are removable and capable of different effects. Ten of these scales may be removed and unfolded into mundane sheets of paper. When these sheets are pressed against a page with non-magical writing or drawing for 1 minute, however, the scale parchment comes away as a perfect copy of the original. These scales cannot be reused, but they may be refolded and stored in the scale of endless bureaucracy indefinitely. The copied page is immune to wear and aging while stored in the armor. Five scales appear as normal sheets of paper when removed, but they are covered in nonsense writing. The wielder may speak a request to the paper, and the gibberish disappears to reveal the written transcription of the spoken request. The scale must be given and accepted by a living, humanoid creature within 24 hours, at which time the recipient must see the writing (it need not understand it, but an illiterate target or one who doesn't understand the language the letter is written in receives a +2 circumstance bonus on its save) and attempt a Will save (DC 19) or attempt to fulfill the written request as if affected by geas. These scales cannot be reused or replaced once the request is put onto the paper. The remaining ten removable scales have a 50% chance of being any one mundane legal document the wearer desires at a given time. The document is a perfect replica of the appropriate document for the time and region and unlikely to draw suspicion. If suspicion is warranted, such as the wearer behaving suspiciously or an area under closed borders, then the wearer receives a +10 competence bonus to any Bluff check made to convince someone of the document's validity. These scales can be reused and replaced, but not if the wearer gives away or loses the document. For each scale not replaced, the chance to have the correct document needed drops by 5% until all the scales are gone. The wearer of scales of endless bureaucracy has a +10 bonus on any Knowledge or Profession check pertaining directly to government laws or legal matters. Missing scales have no effect on the armor's functionality. If all removable scales are expended, the armor still functions as +2 scale mail and grants the skill bonuses described above.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, beguiling gift, geas/quest, memorize page

items.name: Senator's Stole
items.descriptionText: This richly embroidered velvet stole can be worn loosely over the shoulders or tightly around the wearer's neck, denoting their noble rank and helping them navigate the corridors of power with elan. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy and Knowledge (nobility) checks, and if they converse with a creature for 1 round they can make a Sense Motive check with advantage to discern whether that person is a member of the nobility, even if in disguise. The wearer becomes a master of convoluted verbiage, gaining a +1 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting and against language-dependent effects, such as command and suggestion and increasing the save DC by 1 for such language-dependent effects that they use.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor

items.name: Sewer Suit
items.descriptionText: This supple leather outfit has an array of complex straps, along with a masked hood and boots that seal onto the garment, making the whole of the suit waterproof. If the straps are arranged for maximum protection as a full?round action, the sewer suit functions as +1 leather armor, but it also can be worn more loosely as a simple garment by those not wishing to wear armor. The masked hood of the sewer suit filters out the filth of the sewers and similar environments, granting the wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saves against disease or becoming nauseated or sickened, as well as the exceptional special attacks of swarms, and it allows the wearer to hold his breath for twice the normal amount of time. The slick leathers of the sewer suit are a great boon in moving through tight spaces, as the wearer takes no penalty to AC and on attack rolls when squeezing and can move without impediment through bogs and aquatic terrain ( Swim checks are still required where applicable). The wearer takes no penalty on melee attack rolls in water, and creatures that are partially submerged do not gain a cover bonus to their AC against the wearer's attacks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, grease, remove sickness

items.name: Sharpshooter's Carabine
items.descriptionText: This +1 seeking pepperbox is a long-handled pistol that can be held against the shoulder if desired and is constructed with fold-up sights and enchantments that grant it deadly accuracy . It is especially effective when the wielder does not have a clear shot at the target, granting the wielder a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against targets with cover or concealment . In addition, the wielder can use a move action to steady and brace the sharpshooter's carabine, allowing him to double the range increment and the critical threat range for his next attack, as long as it is completed by the end of his current turn. If the wielder uses a tracer bullet in a sharpshooter's carabine, the duration of the tracer effect is increased to 2d4 rounds.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms & Armor, clairaudience/clairvoyance, keen edge, true strike

items.name: Sheath of Perfect Defense
items.descriptionText: This +1 combat scabbard is treated as being wielded for the purpose of its effects when worn on a creature's hip or back, and grants a +1 shield bonus whenever its wielder makes an iaijutsu slash as long as they have a free hand. This bonus stacks with that provided by the sheath block talent. If an attack would miss this weapon's wielder by an amount equal to or less than the shield bonus provided by this weapon and the sheath block talent, the creature who made that attack takes a -1 circumstance penalty to their AC and CMD for 1 round, being knocked off balance. If the wielder has the master slash class feature, this penalty increases to -2. If the wielder has the divine slash class feature, this penalty increases to -3.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield

items.name: Shield of Intercession
items.descriptionText: This gleaming polished +2 champion heavy steel shield is a boon to paladins who stand in the breach to defend their allies. When the wielder uses the aid another action to improve an adjacent ally's AC, she adds the shield's enhancement bonus to the AC bonus she grants, and this bonus applies to all attacks made by the chosen opponent against her ally until the beginning of the wielder's next turn as long as that ally remains adjacent to her. If the chosen opponent is a creature against whom the wielder has activated her smite evil ability, the sacred bonus to AC from the shield's champion property also applies to her ally. If that ally is successfully attacked by the chosen opponent, as an immediate action the wielder of the shield can intercept a successful attack against her ally as if she possessed the In Harm's Way feat.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, aid, protection from evil

items.name: Singing (Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: Upon command, a singing weapon vibrates and resonates with crystalline tones that deal an extra 1d6 points of sonic damage on a successful hit. The wielder is not harmed by this effect. The effect remains until another command is given.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shout, sonic scream, or sound burst

items.name: Spying Curse
items.descriptionText: As long as this object is held, worn, or carried by a living creature (including in an extradimensional space), the creator can concentrate for 1 minute in order to scry (as scrying ) upon that creature. The target gains no saving throw against this scrying, and the creator can observe him for up to 10 rounds per day. These rounds need not be consecutive. Whenever the creator is scrying on the target, she also learns his direction, distance, and general condition.
items.constructionRequirementsText: bestow curse, scrying, status

items.name: Staff of Asclepius
items.descriptionText: This is a long, rough cudgel with a carved wooden snake wrapped through all its length. It strikes as a +1/+1 merciful quarterstaff and has the following abilities: cure serious wounds (1 charge) remove disease (3 charges) neutralize poison (4 charges) The staff can also be used to cast true resurrection once; doing so destroys it.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, cure serious wounds, neutralize poison, remove disease, true resurrection

items.name: Surcoat of Smiting
items.descriptionText: This padded garment of snowy white is worn over armor, and if worn continuously for 8 hours the symbol of the wearer's deity is magically emblazoned upon the surcoat's breast. This symbol disappears if the surcoat of smiting is worn by a creature that does not follow that deity for at least 1 minute. A Creature whose deity matches that of the symbol emblazoned on the surcoat can cast bull's strength upon herself once per day. If the wearer has the ability to smite evil, she can activate the surcoat's bull's strength power as a free action when she activates her smite evil . While using smite evil, whenever the wearer hits the target of her smite with a melee attack while charging, she deals an additional 1d8 points of damage. If the wearer is able to make more than one attack as part of a charge, this bonus applies only to the first attack that successfully hits. In addition, once per day on any successful melee or ranged attack against a creature she is smiting the wearer can cause the surcoat of smiting to flare with holy power. The target takes an additional 2d6 points of damage, and if the attack is a critical hit the target also becomes shaken for a number of rounds equal to the wearer's Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bull's strength, weapon of awe

items.name: Teeth of the Hydra
items.descriptionText: These enchanted hydra 's teeth can be cast upon the ground as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity . At the beginning of the user's next turn, a group of fighters with the phalanx soldier archetype erupt from the ground; these fighters are otherwise identical to the barbarians summoned by a horn of valhalla . A creature crafting teeth of the hydra may choose what level these fighters will be; if found as treasure, roll randomly to determine which type of horn's effects are duplicaed. If the creature sowing the teeth of the hydra is not proficient with all martial weapons or has a base attack bonus of less than +6, the fighters attack him until slain and then attack the nearest other creatures, including one another. A mythic creature can force these fighters to obey by expending one use of mythic power when sowing the teeth. A mythic creature with proficiency in all martial weapons and a base attack bonus of at least +6 can expend two uses of mythic power when sowing the teeth to grant the warriors the invincible mythic simple template. Teeth of the hydra can be used only once.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster V

items.name: The Golden Fleece Hide (Minor Artifact)
items.descriptionText: The golden fleece hide functions as a +4 impervious hide armor. Its wearer gains a +2 sacred bonus to Charisma and gains Leadership as a bonus feat; if the wearer already has Leadership, he is instead considered to be 2 levels higher for the feat's purpose. In addition, once per day, the armor's wearer can cast heal on himself. DESTRUCTION The golden fleece hide is destroyed if spun and woven into a wool cloth by someone who killed at least three members of their own family.

items.name: Torturing
items.descriptionText: This special ability can only be placed on melee weapons. A torturing weapon deals 1 additional point of non-lethal damage when it hits a creature. For the next 2d6 rounds, the creature takes an additional point of non-lethal damage per round. Multiple hits from a torturing weapon increase the non-lethal damage. Tortured creatures take the non-lethal damage at the start of their turns. The non-lethal damage can be stopped by a successful DC 12 Heal check or through the application of any spell that cures hit point damage. A critical hit does not multiply the non-lethal damage. Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to the non-lethal damage dealt by this weapon.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, touch of fatigue

items.name: Toxic Scabbard
items.descriptionText: This subtle, unremarkable leather sheath is a poisoner's delight. It can accommodate any weapon from the light blade weapon group, and if the wielder places a dose of injury or contact poison into the toxic scabbard, it retains its potency indefinitely until used. The enchantment of the toxic scabbard and any weapon sheathed in it or poison contained within it cannot be detected with divinatory magic unless the caster succeeds on a DC 20 caster level check. As a swift action, the wearer can coat a weapon sheathed in the toxic scabbard with the stored poison; he has no chance of accidentally poisoning himself when doing so. In addition, the wielder may choose to spread the dose of the poison out by not applying a full dose, allowing him to poison his weapon more than once. He must make this choice when triggering the stored poison for the first time. If he chooses to split the poison into two doses, the save DC for each dose is reduced by 2. If he splits the poison into three doses, the save DC for each dose is reduced by 4. A character with at least 5 ranks in Craft (alchemy) and has the poison use class feature can use a toxic scabbard to even greater effect, storing one additional dose of poison in the scabbard for every 5 ranks he has in Craft (alchemy). He can store multiple doses of the same poison or doses of different poisons, and can choose which poison to activate . If he did not place the poisons in the scabbard, he can identify which poisons are stored with a successful DC 20 Craft (alchemy) check. If multiple doses of the same poison are stored, he can trigger multiple doses at once; for each dose after the first, the save DC is increased by 2.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Craft (alchemy) 5 ranks, nondetection, poison

items.name: Tracking Beacon
items.descriptionText: The creator can use locate object upon any device with this enhancement for 5 minutes per day; this duration need not be continuous but must be used in 1-minute increments.
items.constructionRequirementsText: bestow curse, locate object

items.name: Transforming
items.descriptionText: This functions as a wild armor, except it preserves its armor bonus (and any enhancement bonus ) while the wearer is in a different form, whether it is from the wild shape ability, a spell, a spell-like ability, the change shape ability, or another source. While the wearer is in a different shape, the armor cannot be seen.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, polymorph

items.name: Unholy Reaver
items.descriptionText: This +2 bastard sword becomes a +5 unholy bastard sword in the hands of an antipaladin . An antipaladin may also choose to exchange some of the unholy reaver's enhancement bonus to grant the weapon the conductive (+1), cruel (+1), or wounding (+2) properties. Changing the weapon's properties requires an antipaladin to expend one use of his touch of corruption ability; the change is permanent unless changed again. This profane blade provides spell resistance of 5 + the antipaladin's class level to the wielder and to any adjacent creature with the evil subtype or an aura of evil (including antipaladins and some evil clerics ). This spell resistance applies only against effects with the good descriptor or effects created by good-aligned creatures. Whenever an antipaladin slays a good-aligned creature with an unholy reaver, he may expend one use of his touch of corruption as a swift action to affect the target as rest eternal .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed, cause fear, death knell, spectral hand, unholy

items.name: Unspeakable Forbiddance
items.descriptionText: A creature that wears or wields this item is compelled not to speak, write, communicate, or even think the name of the item's creator until the curse is removed. Each time the cursed creature answers a question or provides information or clues or otherwise alludes to the creator's identity, the cursed creature must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or suffer the same ill effects as if she had failed to comply with a geas/quest or mark of justice spell (depending on which spell was used in the item's creation).
items.constructionRequirementsText: bestow curse, geas/quest or mark of justice

items.name: Vambraces of Overflowing Power
items.descriptionText: These bracers are made of a highly flexible metallic substance, covering the wearer's forearms and the tops of their hands. Glass globes line the length of them, the one over the hand being the largest, and decreasing in size up to where the vambraces end at the elbows. If the wearer is under the effects of their blightburn aura, cerebral overflow, elemental overflow, mental overflow, necrotic overflow, overwhelming power, or tainted manifestation class feature, rather than visually displaying their abilities as they normally would (such as an aerokineticist having wind and lightning around them, or water weeping from a hydrokineticist's pores), the glass globes brightly glow with a color or range of colors associated with the kineticist's elemental powers. This glow sheds light as a torch, and the effect can be suppressed in the same manner as elemental overflow could be. In addition, the wearer can apply their bonus to damage rolls granted by born talented, cerebral overflow, elemental overflow, mental overflow, necrotic overflow, overwhelming power, personal resonance, tainted manifestation, or telekinetic blade to attacks made with blasts modified by kinetic blade, kinetic fist, kinetic whip, devastating infusion, and to any other blast that would normally be denied this bonus. The amount of bonus that can be applied is limited by the strength of the vambraces.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, one of the following class features: blightburn

args.name: one of the following class features: blightburn

items.name: Vest of Elemental Defense
items.descriptionText: This ornate vest is littered with elemental runes across the front of it, the back portraying a myriad of symbols relating to each element. When worn by a creature who possesses the elemental overflow class feature, they gain a deflection bonus to their Armor Class equal to the bonus to attack rolls they gain from that class feature while it is active. This bonus is limited by the strength of the vest.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, kineticist of a level at least three times the bonus of the vest

args.text: kineticist of a level at least three times the bonus of the vest

items.name: Whisper Stone
items.descriptionText: This palm-sized gray stone is carved with the ancient Bellianic symbol for peace, but often contain additional hidden messages, bits of prayer, knowledge, and simple advice. The stored message can be accessed with 10 minutes of meditation while a creature traces its fingers along the symbol, causing the message to be whispered into their subconscious. Each stone holds only a single message and each message is as unique as the elder that created it. The messages typically provide some sort of simple but eloquent insight that reveals something of interest about a single subject. The message is never more than a few short sentences (up to 25 words). If the user knows the subject associated with stone, she can listen to it to gain a +4 insight bonus to any Knowledge check made concerning that same subject.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, whispering lore

items.name: White Peacock Crown
items.descriptionText: This ornate headpiece is crafted of white gold, inlaid with lapis lazuli and spangled with dozens of jewels. Similar to a helm of brilliance, this item is bejeweled with enchanted stones that hold magical powers. A newly crafted white peacock crown holds 10 sapphires, 20 emeralds, 30 blue topaz, and 40 pearls. On this crown, one sapphire, three emeralds, four topaz, and six pearls retain their power, the rest having been expended long ago. Sapphire: scintillating pattern Emerald: holy smite (5d8 (10d6 vs. evil outsiders ), DC 18) Blue topaz: zone of truth (DC 16) Pearl: see invisibility Until its jewels are depleted, the white peacock crown has the following magical properties: The wearer can detect shapechangers at will. This functions as detect undead but reveals creatures with the shapechanger subtype. The wearer may command any weapon he wields to become a bane weapon against outsiders with the shapechanger subtype and also suppresses the regeneration of outsiders with the oni subtype. This is in addition to whatever abilities the weapon may already have (unless it already has this property). This command takes 1 round to take effect and lasts 1 minute. The crown provides continuous endure elements . Once all jewels have lost their magic, the crown loses its powers and the gems turn to worthless powder. Removing a jewel destroys it. Unlike a helm of brilliance, the white peacock crown provides no fire resistance and cannot explode as a result of fire damage.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, detect undead, endure elements, holy smite, scintillating pattern, see invisibility, summon monster I, zone of truth

items.name: Wingfire Blade
items.descriptionText: This +2 flaming burst two-bladed sword has the hilt and blades modeled in red and yellow gold, finely wrought to give the impression of two spreaded wings. When used in combat, the blades appear to be wreathed in flame. At will, the wielder of a wingfire blade can begin a spinning and whirling series of jumps, granting himself a +4 dodge bonus on AC. This ability lasts for 20 rounds per day. These rounds need not be consecutive.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, air walk, flame blade

items.name: Witch's Broom (Minor Artifact)
items.descriptionText: This racing broom of flying also functions as a staff of feast and famine and a +3 flying light mace. When flying, it can carry any load. Fire can't destroy the broom; it actually gains +10 fly speed for every 10 minutes it is put on a fire. Lastly, the broom can cast greater invisibility at will and mythic time stop 1/day. In the hands of anyone other than it's creator, it behaves as a broom of animated attack. DESTRUCTION The broom falls to ashes if used to deliver gifts to 300 bad children and coal to 300 good children in one night.

items.name: Wraps of Suppressed Size
items.descriptionText: This length of fabric is wrapped around the wearer's abdomen or chest. On most wearers it appears as a simple roll of gauze, but when a creature wearing it can access elemental powers, it appears as a white satin ribbon edged in a bluish silver. While the wearer is under the effects of the kinetic form wild talent, they gain all of its benefits as normal from changing size to Large, but take up the same space as they ordinarily would, and are treated as if their size has not been changed for the purpose of other effects that alter size, such as the enlarge person spell. This only affects a creature using kinetic form if it's used to increase size to Large. A surging wraps of suppressed size provides the same benefits, but also provides its benefits to a creature that has used kinetic form to increase its size to Huge. For the purpose of determining the effects on a creature due to change in size, effects that would alter its size stack (for example, a Medium creature wearing wraps of suppressed size and affected by both kinetic form and enlarge person would become a Large creature and have its ability scores adjusted as such, but would be considered a Huge creature to determine reach, penalty to AC and attack rolls, effective weapon size and damage, and so on).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, kinetic form, kineticist 12th (16th for surging)

args.text: kineticist 12th (16th for surging)

items.name: Writing Keytar
items.descriptionText: This bizarre cross between a keyboard and a guitar can be played by anyone who has ranks in either of the associated Perform skills (keyboard or string ). It allows its wielder to send written messages while playing a melody. The player may decide to have the keytar write the words he speaks or sings while playing, the words he thinks, or that each note or chord corresponds to a specific letter, syllable, or word. When the message is complete, a small colored leaflet comes out from the instrument's bottom end and is instantaneously teleported to the desired recipient within a range of 100 miles.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, message, scrivener's chant

items.name: Yoke of the Brazen Bull
items.descriptionText: This wooden yoke has polished bronze fittings burnished with flame to a lovely patina. Once every 7 days, the yoke can be placed on the neck of a horse, mule, bull, or similar quadrupedal animal, causing it to burst into flames as you hold the reins. These flames do not harm the animal but deal 1d6 points of fire damage to all adjacent creatures. After 1 round, the animal transforms into a bronze-scaled gorgon with the fire subtype and hooves of flame (dealing 1d6 points of fire damage to any creature struck by its hoof, or 2d6 points of fire damage to creatures it tramples). Its breath weapon deals 8d6 points of fire damage, DC 21 Reflex half ) rather than petrifying creatures. A mythic user can expend two uses of mythic power when activating the yoke of the brazen bull to grant the bull the savage mythic simple template. This brazen gorgon is hostile, but you can control its movement with a successful DC 22 Handle Animal check, directing it to trample creatures in its path. You can command it to attack (including using its breath weapon ) as you direct with a successful DC 29 Handle Animal check. A mythic creature adds its mythic rank or tier as a bonus on all Handle Animal checks to control the brazen bull, and when expending a mythic surge to add to such a check may roll the surge die twice and take the better result. The user must make a Handle Animal check as a swift or move action each round at the beginning of their turn. If the check fails, the brazen bull refuses to move. If the user fails the check by 5 or more (or on a natural 1 in any case), the bull attacks them. Each time it hits the user with an attack, the user must succeed on a DC 21 Fortitude save or lose their grip on the reins, allowing it to roam free and attack as it will. The brazen bull can be controlled again only by successfully grappling it, allowing a creature to seize the reins once more and attempt a new Handle Animal check to control it. A druid or ranger can attempt to calm the brazen bull with wild empathy, allowing a creature to take the reins once again. An Intimidate check can be substited for a Handle Animal check to control the brazen bull, but the DC is increased by 5. The brazen bull remains present as long as its reins are held and for 1 minute thereafter, up to a maximum of 1 hour. It can be commanded to return to its normal form with a successful DC 30 Handle Animal check in three consecutive rounds, or by making it helpful with wild empathy . Any damage taken or harmful conditions suffered by the brazen bull are removed when it returns to its true form. The transformation also ends if the brazen bull is killed, which causes the yoke to cease functioning for 1 month. A creature holding the yoke of the brazen bull moves with the bull as it moves, as if mounted and riding it, though the user gains none of the other benefits of being mounted and maintain its own separate space adjacent to the bull. As a standard action, the user can create a heavy brazen plow that furrows the ground behind the bull as it moves. While the plow is present, the brazen bull can attempt a combat maneuver check to trip all creatures it tramples during its turn, making a check and comparing it to the CMD of each creature in its path. Any creature knocked prone takes 3d6 points of slashing damage from the plow. The newly furrowed ground left in the bull's path is considered difficult terrain for 1 hour for all Medium or smaller creatures. In addition, if the user plows a 30-foot-square area (requiring three rounds), the user can sow the teeth of a dragon or magical beast with 8 or more Hit Dice in that furrowed ground. One round later, a small army of soldiers crawls forth from the ground and immediate falls upon one another in a savage battle that lasts 1d4 rounds. These soldiers focus entirely on one another and do not leave the furrowed ground, though any creature entering or beginning its turn within the area takes 3d6 points of bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage per round. After this brief melee, the slain soldiers and their gear crumble to dust leaving behind a small squad of survivors, identical to the barbarian constructs summoned by a horn of valhalla (roll randomly each time this ritual is performed to see what level of soldiers are created). These soldiers follow the user's commands for 1 hour or until destroyed. At the GM's option, the soldiers created may be fighters (rather than barbarians ) with the phalanx soldier archetype and/or the Phalanx Formation feat. A mythic user can expend two uses of mythic power when sowing the teeth to grant the warriors the invincible mythic simple template.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, fireball, polymorph, summon monster VI

items.name: Armor of Animal Defense
items.descriptionText: This fine suit of polished steel barding floats a few inches above a leather harness that can be adjusted for any animal, and the plates rearrange themselves accordingly, while any excess armor simply folds itself into the suit, affording a comfortable fit for creatures of any dimension. In addition to functioning as +3 full plate barding, these suits of armor have no maximum Dexterity bonus. They are also able to spring into action in moments of danger, propelling the wearer away from potential hazards. As an immediate action, the wearer may choose to gain a bonus of any amount up to the armor's enhancement bonus on Reflex saves. This bonus lasts for 1 round. For each point of bonus to Reflex saves gained in this way, the armor's enhancement bonus to AC is also reduced by 1 for 1 round. Some of an armor of animal defenses' unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +4-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

items.name: Armor of Molten Lashes
items.descriptionText: While these suits of armor appear to be nothing more than a suit of black chainmail, often decorated with fire motifs, they are extremely hot to the touch and uncomfortable to handle. As a convenient side effect to the armor's magical effects, a character who dons this armor is protected from this uncomfortable heat. In addition to functioning as a suit of +4 greater fire resistance chainmail, the wearer of this armor can speak a command word to cause it to become a molten mass of lava, which damages weapons and creatures that strike the wearer. Up to 3 times per day, the wearer of a suit of armor of molten lashes can command the armor to assume this molten form for 1 minute. During this time, the armor offers no armor bonus to AC, but deals 2d6 points of fire damage to any creature that hits the wearer with a natural attack or a melee weapon without reach. Manufactured melee weapons also suffer this fire damage, which is not reduced by hardness of less than 20. None of an armor of molten lashes's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +4-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, fire shield, heat metal

items.name: Armor of the Arctic
items.descriptionText: This armor is made from super-hard ice that has been buried under at least 10 feet of snow for a minimum of a year and a day. The armor itself freezes the air around it, causing a mist to collect about the wearer. In addition to functioning as +3 full plate, a suit of armor of the arctic possesses an extreme cold which provides proof against freezing attacks, and also chills those who would dare strike the wearer. The wearer of a suit of armor of the arctic is immune to cold damage and the effects of spells with the cold descriptor . Additionally, the armor has a frosty aura, which deals 2d6 points of cold damage to any creature that hits the wearer with a natural attack or a melee weapon without reach. This damage also applies to any creature that grapples the wearer. Further, any metal weapon that strikes the armor of the arctic is affected by the spell chill metal (no save). However, if any amount of fire damage is dealt to armor of the arctic, it instantly gains the broken condition. None of an armor of the arctic's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +3-equivalent armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, chill metal, endure elements

items.name: Butterscotch Bulwark
items.descriptionText: This armor was created by a gentle wizard when his best customer was conscripted. The wizard was the owner of a magical confectionery, and the suit is made from enchanted butterscotch which constantly replenishes itself and remains sticky and melted, ready to eat and able to adhere to various weapons, with the aim of keeping the wearer safe by disarming his foes. This curious armor functions as a suit of +1 leather armor and additionally produces up to 10 lbs. of delicious butterscotch each day. This butterscotch is magical in nature and provides no calories, both preventing those that eat it from gaining weight and failing to provide any real sustenance to the eater. In addition to these effects, the armor attempts to grab any weapon that attacks its wearer. The first time each day that any given creature makes an attack against the wearer of a butterscotch bulwark with a melee weapon, the wearer may attempt a free disarm combat maneuver to attempt to disarm that weapon. If the attack is successful, the attacker's weapon becomes stuck to the wearer's armor and cannot be pried free without a DC 25 Strength check. Some of a butterscotch bulwark's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +4-equivalent armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, telekinesis

items.name: Cage of Ribs
items.descriptionText: This unusual suit of armor is made from steel wrapped in bone meal, which has been sewn with abjurative magic to ward off undead creatures. Typically these suits of armor resemble a human rib cage, and are worn over the chest, though other styles and exotic patterns are known to exist. In addition to functioning as a +1 chain shirt, the cage of ribs protects the wearer from undead, warding her against their attacks and shielding her from their senses. The wearer of this armor is invisible to unintelligent undead, as though warded by a hide from undead spell. Anything that would end this effect instead suppresses it for 1 hour. Regardless of whether the hide from undead effect is broken, the wearer of this armor gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against the natural attacks of undead creatures, and a +1 bonus on saving throws made to resist the extraordinary and supernatural abilities of undead creatures. Some of a cage of ribs' unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +2-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, hide from undead

items.name: Dirtmail
items.descriptionText: This suit of hideous armor appears to be made of dry, loose dirt, and fits over the wearer's head like a mail shirt. The armor is tough without being rigid, and is generally as effective as a shirt of steel links. This suit of magic armor functions as a +1 chain shirt, except that it also grants the wearer some control over dust and dirt. First, the wearer ignores the effects of difficult terrain caused by sand, mud, rubble, or magically altered earth. Additionally, whenever the wearer is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, he is placed into a state of suspended animation, as temporal stasis, and buried at a depth of 5 feet. The wearer exits this state when he is returned to the surface. The wearer can be dug up by other characters; otherwise, after 1 minute, the wearer is magically transported back to the location he was in when the temporal stasis effect was triggered. Some of a suit of dirtmail's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +2-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, temporal stasis

items.name: Electric Eel Skin
items.descriptionText: These suits of +1 leather armor are made from the skin of electric eels, which have been magically enhanced to grant the wearer many eel -like traits. The wearer gains a +5 circumstance bonus to CMD to resist attempts to grapple him, as well as a +5 bonus on combat maneuver checks and Escape Artist checks made to escape a grapple . Additionally, the wearer can move through areas as small as one-quarter his space without squeezing, or one-eighth his space when squeezing. Finally, once per day, the wearer of a suit of electric eel skin can unleash a blast of electrical energy in a 20-foot radius, forcing each other creature within the area to succeed on a Reflex save (DC 13 + 1 per point of enhancement bonus the armor possesses) or suffer 2d6 points of electricity damage per point of enhancement bonus the armor possesses. Creatures that fail their saving throw by 5 or more are also stunned for 1 round. Some of an electric eel skin's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +2-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, grease, reduce person, shocking grasp

items.name: Fire Plate
items.descriptionText: This fantastic suit of plate mail is made of solid flames from the Elemental Planes of Fire, which burns hot on the outside, but remains cool and comfortable for the wearer. The flame is super hard, stronger than steel, and gives off heat which can damage those that get too close. In addition to functioning as +2 full plate, fire plate armor burns super-hot, damaging those that touch the armor. Whenever a creature ends his turn adjacent to the armor's wearer, that creature suffers 1d6 points of fire damage. Additionally, whenever a creature adjacent to the wearer deals damage to her with a natural attack or a manufactured weapon without reach, it suffers 1d6 points of fire damage. A command word, spoken as a standard action, can suppress or resume these effects. A suit of fire plate is immune to damage and the broken condition. Some of a suit of fire plate's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +5-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fire shield

items.name: Fluorite Armor
items.descriptionText: Made from magically-toughened fluorite, these suits of armor are made to an individual's measurements and fit like a suit of full plate, but because they are made of natural materials, they can be worn by druids . The suits are normally translucent and colorless, though some wearers are able to focus their will and cause the armor to change color. In addition to functioning as a suit of +1 full plate, fluorite armor can be commanded to take on extremely bright and vibrant colors. This can produce two effects. The first effect can be used to continually cause characters within 5 feet of the armor, including the wearer, to become sickened for 1d4 rounds unless they succeed on a Will save (DC 22). Regardless of whether or not the save is successful, characters that are subjected to this effect are immune to the effect for 1 minute thereafter. The second effect, which can be activated once per day, causes a burst of sickening colors to radiate out from the armor, causing the wearer and all characters within a 10-foot-radius spread centered on the wearer to become confused for 1 round, with no saving throw to resist the effect. None of a suit of fluorite armor's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +1-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, scintillating pattern

items.name: Garbage Mail
items.descriptionText: This unusual suit of armor is made from cobbled-together parts of various other metal items, salvaged from a scrap heap and held together by strained and overworked magic, which isn't quite able to rid the armor of the reeking foul smell of the rubbish heap. No two of these suits look quite the same, though all tend to look somewhat ridiculous, with odd angles and recognizable pieces of trash forming most of the protective value. These unconventional suits of armor function as a suit of +1 scale mail, but additionally issue forth a constant reeking stench, which is difficult to ignore and can cause those who breathe it in to become sick. Any character within 30 feet of the armor, other than the wearer, must succeed on a DC 14 Fortitude save or be sickened . Characters suffer a cumulative –1 penalty to this saving throw for each round they are exposed to the armor's stench. A character which spends at least 5 minutes within the stench's area of effect is immune to the stench for 24 hours. The horrible reeking stench created by this armor is supernatural in origin and can be suppressed or resumed as a swift action . None of a suit of garbage mail's unique abilities count as an enhancement bonus equivalent, and it is treated as a +1-equivalent suit of armor for the purposes of the cost of further improving its magical abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, stinking cloud

items.name: Absorbing (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: These items seem to shift and hum when magic is nearby, giving the wielder a soothing sensation. When the bearer of such items successfully saves against a spell or spell-like ability they also heal a number of hit points equal to twice the spell level of the effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Toughness

items.name: Accompanying
items.descriptionText: An accompanying weapon exudes a beautiful aura of sound that reacts to your performances and enhances them. While holding the weapon, the user gains a competence bonus on Perform checks equal to the total enhancement bonus of the weapon, including special abilities. Additionally, if the user has bardic performance or a similar ability like the skald's raging song, they gain 2 additional rounds of its use per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, sculpt sound

items.name: Acrobat's Slippers
items.descriptionText: This pair of fine slippers are adorned with embroidery of cats stretched out in various poses. While wearing acrobat's slippers you always land on your feet when you fall and gain a +2 bonus on Acrobatics checks. In addition, twice per day you may activate the slippers as a free action to gain the effects of a cheetah's sprint spell.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, cat's grace, cheetah's sprint

items.name: Amulet of Avoidance
items.descriptionText: This amulet appears to be a large black pearl with a few flecks of gold dust across its surface. If you provoke an attack of opportunity you may activate the amulet as free action to gain a +4 dodge bonus to armor class until your next turn. This ability functions twice per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, cat's grace

items.name: Amulet of Spell Conversion
items.descriptionText: This dull-metal amulet is octagonal in shape and etched with arcane runes and symbols. It allows a caster that prepares their spells to cast the spell conversion spell once per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, spell conversion

items.name: Aquatic (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: These sets of armor were made to assist those who may need to spend significant time underwater or at sea. While wearing a set of aquatic armor you are under the constant effect of a water breathing spell and gain a swim speed of 20 ft, unless you already possess a better swim speed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, water breathing

items.name: Asserting (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: These weapons were developed to fight tricky spellcasters. When attacking a creature, an asserting weapon ignores any miss chance created by an illusion effect (including supernatural abilities that mimic an illusion effect like a hellcat's invisible in light ability). In addition, when scoring a critical hit against a creature under the effect of any illusion spell you may make a dispel attempt against one illusion affecting the target using your character level in place of your caster level .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dispel magic

items.name: Banner of Accuracy
items.descriptionText: A banner is a flag or heraldry affixed to a pole. The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. Alternatively, a banner can be affixed to a structure, or to specialized poles that take up a shoulder slot and are affixed to the bearer's back. The exact imagery on the banner varies widely but is emblematic of the nature of the banner. While raised, the banner provides a benefit to all those that can see it within 30 feet. If the banner is cast down, all previous beneficiaries are shaken for 10 minutes or until it is raised again. If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet. All allies making ranged attacks originating in the radius ignore the first range increment penalty. So, they will not take any penalty until their third range increment.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, true strike

items.name: Banner of Bane
items.descriptionText: A banner is a flag or heraldry affixed to a pole. The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. Alternatively, a banner can be affixed to a structure, or to specialized poles that take up a shoulder slot and are affixed to the bearer's back. The exact imagery on the banner varies widely but is emblematic of the nature of the banner. While raised, the banner provides a benefit to all those that can see it within 30 feet. If the banner is cast down, all previous beneficiaries are shaken for 10 minutes or until it is raised again. If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet. All allies within the radius gain a +2 bonus on damage against a creature type selected when the banner is created. This uses the creature types from the bane weapon special ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster I

items.name: Banner of Cavalry
items.descriptionText: A banner is a flag or heraldry affixed to a pole. The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. Alternatively, a banner can be affixed to a structure, or to specialized poles that take up a shoulder slot and are affixed to the bearer's back. If the banner is cast down, all previous beneficiaries are shaken for 10 minutes or until it is raised again. If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet. All mounts ridden by allies gain a +10 enhancement to their base speed if their movement begins within the radius. Additionally the riding ally gains a +5 morale bonus on Ride checks while in the radius.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, haste

items.name: Banner of Destruction

If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet. All allies within the radius gain a +2 morale bonus on damage rolls against constructs and objects. Additionally, they ignore up to 4 points of hardness of objects, or 2 DR of constructs .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, shatter

items.name: Banner of Divine Favor
items.descriptionText: A banner is a flag or heraldry affixed to a pole. The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. Alternatively, a banner can be affixed to a structure, or to specialized poles that take up a shoulder slot and are affixed to the bearer's back. If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet. All allies that worship the same deity whose holy symbol is on the banner gain the benefit of prayer . All enemies that don't follow the deity take the penalties of prayer .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, prayer

items.name: Banner of Goodness

The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. All non-evil allies within the radius gain the benefits of protection from evil .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from evil

The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet. All allied users of channel positive energy, lay on hands, or similar positive energy dealing supernatural abilities increase their DC of those abilities against undead by 2.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, consecrate

items.name: Banner of Non-combatant
items.descriptionText: A banner is a flag or heraldry affixed to a pole. The banner is either affixed to a pole which requires two hands to use and cannot be effectively used in combat, or to a piercing polearm weapon. Alternatively, a banner can be affixed to a structure, or to specialized poles that take up a shoulder slot and are affixed to the bearer's back. The exact imagery on the banner varies widely but is emblematic of the nature of the banner. While raised, the banner provides a benefit to all those that can see it within 30 feet. If the banner is cast down, all previous beneficiaries are shaken for 10 minutes or until it is raised again. If the banner is borne by a creature with marshal levels, or the standard-bearer of the banneret archetype, the radius is extended to 60 feet. All unarmed allies within the radius, including the bearer of the banner if it is not affixed to a polearm, are affected by the sanctuary spell with a DC of 14.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, sanctuary

items.name: Banner of Undeath
items.descriptionText: All undead creatures within the radius gain a +2 channel resistance that stacks with any existing channel resistance .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, desecrate

items.name: Banner of Vileness
items.descriptionText: All non-good allies within the radius gain the benefits of protection from good .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, protection from good

items.name: Banner of Warding
items.descriptionText: All allies within the radius gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC against a creature type selected when the banner is created. This uses the creature types from the bane weapon special ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, summon monster I

items.name: Belt of Endless Pouches
items.descriptionText: This unassuming belt has what seems like a dozen tiny pouches adorned across its surface. In fact there are 24 pockets, 12 on the outside and 12 on the inside. Each pocket holds 1 cubic foot of material but items stored in the belt do not count against the wearer's carrying capacity.

items.name: Belt of Stitches
items.descriptionText: This old leather belt is held together by hundreds of stitches, as though it has been mended over and over again. While wearing this belt you may heal yourself as a swift action as though you cast cure moderate wounds three times per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds

items.name: Bewitching Mantle
items.descriptionText: This half length cloak of fine silk is adorned with embroidered swirling patterns. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to tell lies and a +1 bonus to caster level when casting enchantment ( charm ) spells.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, charm monster

items.name: Bonded (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: These sets or armor or shields were made for those who need to be ready at a moment's notice. Bonded armor and shields are keyed to a charm which can be attached to a necklace, bracelet, or article of clothing. As long as the charm and bonded shield or suit of armor are on the same plane the holder of the charm can teleport the armor or shield any distance to themselves as a move action . If not wielding a shield or wearing a suit of armor the item automatically dons itself to the caller.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, teleport

items.name: Bonded, Greater (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: A suit of greater bonded armor (or a greater bonded shield) functions as bonded armor but can also be directed to teleport the armor on to a willing target within 60 feet.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, teleport

items.name: Conniving (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: These weapons were developed by spelljacks to aid them in their subtle work, using enemy magic to create an opening. Whenever a conniving weapon deals damage to a creature with a spellcasting feature or spell-like ability for the first time each round that creature is considered to be flat-footed for the next attack the wielder makes before the end of their turn.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Improved Feint

items.name: Cowl of Languages
items.descriptionText: This half length cloak of fine silk is adorned with embroidered swirling patterns. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to tell lies and a +1 bonus to caster level when casting enchantment ( charm ) spells.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, the creator has the ability to speak the five languages chosen, tongues

items.name: Cursebearing
items.descriptionText: Each time this weapon deals damage, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC 14) or be affected by a curse effect available to the lesser bestow curse spell. The curse inflicted does not stack with other curses with the same effect. The nature of the curse imposed by the weapon is chosen when the weapon is created and cannot be changed later.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, lesser bestow curse

items.name: Greater Cursebearing
items.descriptionText: Each time this weapon deals damage, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC 16) or be affected by a curse effect available to the bestow curse spell. The curse inflicted does not stack with other curses with the same effect. The nature of the curse imposed by the weapon is chosen when the weapon is created and cannot be changed later.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bestow curse

items.name: Lesser Cursebearing
items.descriptionText: Each time this weapon deals damage, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC 11) or be affected by a curse effect available to the minor bestow curse spell. The curse inflicted does not stack with other curses with the same effect. The nature of the curse imposed by the weapon is chosen when the weapon is created and cannot be changed later.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, minor bestow curse

items.name: Deathmark Gauntlet
items.descriptionText: This jet -black spiked gauntlet has long clawed fingers and is detailed to resemble a skeletal hand. The deathmark gauntlet functions as a +2 spiked gauntlet and also allows the wearer to cast finger of death once per day using their character level as the caster level, with a save DC of 19.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, finger of death

items.name: Diminishing Armband
items.descriptionText: This simple leather armband is decorated with a row of geometric shapes that grow smaller as they circle the band. Useful for spies and thieves, once per day the wearer can cast reduce person on themselves as a swift action . This effect lasts for 2 hours and may be dismissed by the wearer as a free action .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, reduce person

items.name: Directed (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: These shields were made to defend against single foes. When wielding a directed shield the bearer gains a +10 bonus vs. a designated opponent's attempts to feint . Designating a foe is a swift action . The shield's AC bonus also increases by +1 when being threatened by only a single opponent.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Combat Expertise

items.name: Disarming
items.descriptionText: A disarming weapon improves the user's ability to disarm a foe. If applied to a ranged weapon, it allows the user to make ranged disarm combat maneuvers using any feats that modify the combat maneuver, with the exceptions of ones that involve the wielder taking the weapon from the target. If applied to a melee weapon, the user gains an enhancement bonus to disarm combat maneuver checks equal to the enhancement of the weapon, including from other special abilities, like this one.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, telekinesis

items.name: Distributing (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: These sets of armor were created to make traveling light go further by ensuring weight is always perfectly distributed to its wearer's body. While wearing a set of distributing armor you treat your light and medium loads as your light load for the purpose of encumbrance penalties. In addition you never need to make a constitution check to avoid non-lethal damage during a hustle or forced march, though you become fatigued after 10 hours of such activities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ant haul

items.name: Echo Leaf
items.descriptionText: This leaf is imbued with the magic of silence, but instead of imposing silence, whomever consumes an echo leaf as a standard action is immune to the effects of silence for 1 minute.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item,, silence

items.name: Exploding Nail
items.descriptionText: Glowing as though red hot, this nail seethes with stored energy. The nail does nothing until firmly planted into a solid object, this is a standard action and the nail can be pushed into any material with hardness less than 20, though it deals no damage to the object. After being planted in this way it becomes invisible and any creature that comes within 10 feet of the nail causes it to explode in a fireball that deals 10d6 points of fire damage ( Reflex DC 14 half) to each creature within 20 feet of the nail. This destroys the nail.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, fireball

items.name: Greedy (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: This ability can be placed on light weapons and was designed to help spelljacks and others that can steal magic hoard just a little more stolen power. A greedy weapon can store a touch range or personal only spell that has been stolen. When stealing a spell or spell-like ability the wielder can choose to store it in the greedy weapon rather than in their own reservoir of power. Discharging the spell requires making a successful attack against a target with the weapon. Alternatively the wielder can deal 1d4 points of damage to themself in order to be the target of the stored spell. A character can only have one greedy weapon with a stored spell at a time, if a second greedy weapon would store a spell any other carried greedy weapons lose their own stored spells, this also occurs if a character picks up a second greedy weapon with a stored spell when they already possess one.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, creator must be able to steal, or spell-like abilities

args.text: creator must be able to steal

items.name: Hellfire Cloak
items.descriptionText: This crimson cloak appears to be made of loose knit wool, sparks sometimes dance between its fibers, begging to catch fire. This cloak confers fire resistance 10 to its wearer. In addition, three times per day the wearer can command the cloak to take the form of a unique large fire elemental as a standard action, appearing in a space adjacent to the wearer of the cloak and acting immediately. This fire elemental uses all the normal statistics of a large fire elemental except as follows; it has a +2 profane bonus to AC, skill checks, attack and damage rolls and has an aura which deals 3d6 damage each round to creatures which start their turn adjacent to the elemental . This damage is half fire and half unholy . Each creature may attempt a DC 16 reflex save to reduce this damage by half. The cloak maintains this form for one minute or until commanded to return to its original form as a standard action . The elemental recognizes its controller's enemies and unless otherwise directed will approach and attack the nearest foe each round. While in elemental form, the wearer loses the fire resistance granted by the cloak.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, summon nature's ally v, protection from energy

Bearers can also expend their uses of inspire action, if applicable, to activate these abilities beyond the first use per day. A character can only have one heraldic crest active. If they possess more than one, they can only have one active and usable. A single shield and armor can only have one heraldic crest each
items.descriptionText: The bearer gains a +1 morale bonus to saves against lawful spells. Once per day, on command, the bearer can cast chaos hammer centered on them.
