items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, keen edge

items.name: Impatient (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: These weapons are especially useful to not just thieves and assassins, but anyone who may need to end a fight quickly. While wielding an impatient weapon you gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks and a +2 bonus on damage rolls with the weapon during a surprise round. In addition an impatient weapon can be drawn as part of making an initiative check, though you do not get the +2 bonus unless the weapon was already in hand. The bonuses provided by multiple impatient weapons do not stack.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Improved Initiative

items.name: Infinite Library
items.descriptionText: This massive tome is a repository of all knowledge but no mortal is able to plumb its depths fully. The pages are infinite but seem to guide toward the information you seek when perusing the book . Once per day you can attempt a single Knowledge check (as if you were trained in the skill) with a +10 insight bonus to the check. To gain the bonus you must spend 2d6 hours reading the book . If you try to use the book further after the one use per day is used, the book never seems to turn to pages of information that are useful to you.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, pocket library

items.name: Jar of Spell Stealing
items.price: 33 gp (0-level), 75 gp (1st-level), 450 gp (2nd-level), 1,125 gp (3rd-level), 2,100 gp (4th-level), 3,375 gp (5th-level), 4,950 gp (6th-level), 6,825 gp (7th-level), 9,000 gp (8th-level), 11,475 gp (9th-level)
items.descriptionText: This small earthenware jar bears runes upon its surface. If held in one hand, the user can steal a spell being cast within 10 feet as an immediate action . When the jar is activated (the open part of the jar pointed at the target), the caster must make a concentration check (DC 20 + the spell level). If the concentration check fails, the spell fails and is sealed within the jar. A runed, earthenware lid seals the top. The jar can contain a spell of equal level or lower than the spell level listed for the jar. If the target spellcaster succeeds on their concentration check, the attempt to steal a spell is lost but the jar is still usable. A stored spell can be used in two ways. In both cases the jar itself disintegrates and is no longer usable. By opening the jar's lid the spell is cast upon the holder or with the holder as the center of the radius of the effect. By throwing the jar, the thrower may make a ranged touch attack as if throwing an alchemical item. The target or square hit by the jar is the target of the spell or the center of the spell's radius. Jars of sealing with spells stored within already can be found and or sold by general merchants.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, dispel magic

items.name: Magebane (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: Magebane weapons were developed for fighting wizards and others who use arcane magic. Against enemies capable of casting arcane spells, the weapon's enhancement bonus is +2 better than its actual bonus. It also deals an extra 2d6 points of damage to them. A creature capable of casting arcane spells takes a -1 penalty to concentration checks when holding a magebane weapon.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer

items.name: Memory Crystal
items.descriptionText: This colorful crystal is created with the ability to store thoughts and memories. A single memory crystal can hold up to 5 pieces of information or memories, or a single spellcaster's collection of prepared spells. A creature that touches the crystal and speaks the command word can know the general contents of the information stored within. However, to gain the contents, the user must consciously elect to retrieve the information. Retrieving information from the memory crystal is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity and once retrieved, the information is lost from the crystal. Storing information within the crystal takes 3 full rounds by a willing creature and deals 2d8 damage to the creature storing information. A specific idea, conclusion, piece of information or a single day's worth of events can be stored as one of the 5 pieces of information. Once such a thought or memory is stored within the crystal, the information is blotted out of the storer's memory. For example, a cultist can store the location of their hideout in the crystal and will thus have no means to remember the location of the hideout. For spells, all 5 pieces of information are taken up by a spellcaster storing their entire day's worth of prepared spells. Doing so expends the spells as if they were cast for the day. This allows the user to store their spells for later preparation in case they lose access to their spellbook, familiar or similar source for spells to prepare. Only the spellcaster whose spells are stored within the crystal can retrieve the stored spells as newly prepared spells and only when they have sufficient preparable spell slots. If the memory crystal is destroyed, the thoughts, information, memories and prepared spells are lost with no effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, demand, modify memory, thought crystal

items.name: Chain Metamagic Rod
items.price: Varies Lesser chain metamagic rod 14,000 gp Chain metamagic rod 54,000 gp Greater chain metamagic rod 121,500 gp
items.descriptionText: The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are chained as though using the Chain Spell feat.

items.name: Metamagic Wand Grip
items.descriptionText: This light copper clasp can be wrapped around the grip of a wand and the copper is etched with runes. A metamagic wand grip functions three times per day and the runes on it glow when activated. Attaching the metamagic wand grip to a wand is a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity . If the wearer of the belt has a familiar, animal companion, or special mount it can fit into one of the pockets regardless of its size. While within a pocket the creature requires no air, food, or water.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, carry companion, secret chest

items.name: Monocle of the Fastidious Craftsman
items.descriptionText: This fine golden monocle is fastened to the collar with an intricate decorative chain . If you are wearing the monocle it allows you to cast detect magic at will as a move action . When using the monocle to examine a magic item, if you have at least 5 ranks in Spellcraft, you may spend one full minute to cast identify from the monocle. This ability functions once per day plus one additional time per day for every 3 ranks in Spellcraft you possess.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, detect magic, identify

items.name: Hideaway Musical Instrument
items.descriptionText: This musical instrument is decorated with symbology of travel and carrying your possessions. A musical instrument can be crafted with this enchantment which adds a small extra dimensional pocket to the item. This pocket can hold a single item no larger than 3 cubic feet and weighing no more than 50lbs.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, secret chest

items.name: Morphing Musical Instrument
items.descriptionText: This musical instrument bears motifs ofvarious other instruments and performance types. A musical instrument can be crafted with this enchantment which allows it to change shape into any other musical instrument of the same or smaller size than the original instrument. Shifting the instrument is a move action which does not provoke attacks of opportunity .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, summon instrument

items.name: Necklace of Force Beads
items.descriptionText: This is a string of clear glass beads on a silver chain that is tied together to form a necklace. This does not need to be worn as a neck slot item to be used. The glass beads can be removed by the user (and only the user), who can toss them as a standard action . Once in the air, the bead turns into a magic missile and strikes a target of the user. If you have multiple attacks in a full-attack action from your Bab and not from two-weapon fighting, feats, or multiple natural attacks, you can retrieve and toss a number of beads equal to your number of attacks per round. This includes extra attacks from effects such as haste . Each necklace begins with 10 beads but can be found with fewer beads. Each bead expended reduces the necklace's cost by 50 gp.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, magic missile

items.name: Necklace of Glowing Force Beads
items.descriptionText: This is a string of clear glass beads on a silver chain that is tied together to form a necklace. The beads glow with a violet, blue, or green light This does not need to be worn as a neck slot item to be used. The glass beads can be removed by the user (and only the user), who can toss them as a standard action . Once in the air, the bead turns into a magic missile and strikes a target of the user. A creature struck by the magic missile is affected by faerie fire for 1 minute. If you have multiple attacks in a full-attack action from your Bab and not from two-weapon fighting, feats, or multiple natural attacks, you can retrieve and toss a number of beads equal to your number of attacks per round. This includes extra attacks from effects such as haste . Each necklace begins with 10 beads but can be found with fewer beads. Each bead expended reduces the necklace's cost by 100 gp.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, faerie fire, magic missile

items.name: Needle of Softening
items.descriptionText: This needle is made of precious metal. When jabbed into a creature who has been petrified, the needle absorbs into their body and the target is returned to their natural form.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item,, stone to flesh

items.name: Pain-reflecting
items.descriptionText: This armor is decorated with the images of bones. Three times per day, when the wearer of pain-reflecting armor is dealt damage by a melee attack the armor deals 1d8+ 3 damage to the attacking creature. They may make a Will Save DC 14 to reduce this damage by half.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, inflict light wounds

items.name: Panacea
items.descriptionText: This magically-infused poultice cures the imbiber of many ailments. If consumed like a potion, the consumer is fully cured of the following: ability damage, blinded, confused, dazed, dazzled, deafened, diseased, exhausted, fatigued, feebleminded, insanity, nauseated, poisoned, sickened, and stunned .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item,, heal

items.name: Pendant of Proof against Curses
items.descriptionText: This pendant is set with a white pearl, though specs of black dust appear to shift within. This necklace protects its wearer against curses and grants a boon against creatures who use them. While wearing the pendant you gain a +2 bonus on saves against spells with the curse or evil descriptors. While wearing the pendant if you fail a save against a spell with the curse or evil descriptor you may shatter the pendant as an immediate action and be unaffected by the spell, if you do, you gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls against the caster of the spell until the end of your next turn. Using the pendant in this way permanently destroys it.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, magic weapon, protection from evil

items.name: Pennant of the Champion
items.descriptionText: This crimson pennant can be affixed to a hafted polearm. When attached to a hafted polearm with the reach special quality its power activates granting a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls for all allies within 60 feet. In addition if the wielder of the polearm has a smite or challenge class feature they gain an additional use per day of that ability and the first time each day they successfully deal damage with one of those abilities they deal additional damage equal to their character level.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, prayer

items.name: Perfectly Balanced Gauntlets
items.descriptionText: These gauntlets are slight and their surface seems to shimmer like liquid glass. While worn the gauntlets grant you the use of Two-Weapon Fighting feat even if you do not meet the prerequisites. If you possess the Two-Weapon Fighting feat already the gauntlets instead grant the use of Improved Two-Weapon Fighting . You are not considered to possess either feat for the purpose of meeting other prerequisites.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, haste

items.name: Phantasmal Staff
items.descriptionText: This staff is made of a light, white wood whose surface is matte and the grains and knots seem to shift and move. It allows use of the following spells: phantasmal assailants (1 charge) phantasmal strangler (1 charge) phantasmal decoy (2 charges) phantasmal killer (2 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, phantasmal assailants, phantasmal decoy, phantasmal killer, phantasmal strangler

items.name: Greater Phoenix Feather
items.descriptionText: This feather is not truly taken or cast off from a phoenix, but instead is instilled with magic to bring life back to a fallen ally. If placed on a creature that has died within the last 5 rounds, the feather bursts into a harmless flame and disintegrates, and the affected creature is brought back to life, their hit points are set to 0 then they are healed by 5d8+9 hit points . This item cannot be used on creature who were killed by death effects.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item,, breath of life

items.name: Pouch of Endless Rations
items.descriptionText: This small leather pouch contains enough trail rations and water to feed a single Medium creature for one day. Every morning at sunrise the pouch magically creates another day's worth of food and water. Any remaining food and water left unconsumed disappears.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, create food and water

items.name: Priestbane (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: Priestbane weapons were developed for fighting clerics and other servants of the gods who wield magic. Against enemies capable of casting divine spells, the weapon's enhancement bonus is +2 better than its actual bonus. It also deals an extra 2d6 points of damage to them. A creature capable of casting divine spells takes a -1 penalty to concentration checks when holding a priestbane weapon.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer

items.name: Psibane (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: Psibane weapons were developed for fighting those gifted with strange powers of the mind. Against enemies capable of manifesting psionic powers, the weapon's enhancement bonus is +2 better than its actual bonus. It also deals an extra 2d6 points of damage to them. A creature capable of manifesting psychic or psionic powers takes a -1 penalty to concentration and autohypnosis checks when holding a psibane weapon.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer

items.name: Puncturing (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: This ability may only be placed on a piercing weapon. These weapons were designed to leave brutal wounds on unsuspecting targets. Whenever a puncturing weapon would deal sneak attack or other precision damage, that damage is increased by 1d6. Additionally any bleed damage dealt with a puncturing weapon has the heal skill check DC to remove it increased by 5.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, sneak attack

items.name: Quill of Scribing
items.descriptionText: This looks like a typical quill albeit made from the feather of an exotic bird. To gain the benefit of this magic item the user must have the Scribe Scroll feat. By speaking a command word as a standard action, the quill will begin the process of scribing a scroll while allowing the scriber to perform other duties or rest, though the scroll still has the same cost and time requirements. The quill can be stopped by removing it from the writing medium, though this wastes time and materials incurred. Additionally, even if the quill is stopped early, it can only be activated once per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Scribe Scroll, amanuensis

items.name: Raider's Eyepatch
items.descriptionText: This simple leather eyepatch does not hamper the wearer's vision in any way. If worn over the left eye you gain the benefits of the Blind Fight feat. If worn over the right eye it can be activated as a swift action to grant you see invisibility as the spell for 3 rounds. This ability functions twice per day. Switching which eye the patch is covering is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, see invisibility

items.name: Reflecting (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: These armors and shields were created to protect against magical ranged attacks. Armor and shields mostly constructed of metal with this special quality apply their AC bonus to touch armor class vs rays.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Dodge

items.name: Restful Bedroll
items.descriptionText: This looks like a utilitarian, if well-made, bedroll. When used the bedroll grants the benefits of 8 hours of sleep in 1 hour. This includes removal of fatigue or exhaustion, natural healing, and spell recovery or preparation. However, any spells or spell-like abilities used within 8 hours of the end of the rest are still counted as used. Once the special ability of the bedroll is used, it cannot be used, except as a mundane bedroll, for 48 hours.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, sleep

items.name: Rhino Boots
items.descriptionText: These tough gray, leather boots have upward pointed toes. The wearer of a pair of rhino boots can charge as a standard action rather than as a full round action and +10 foot enhancement bonus to move speed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, haste

items.name: Ring of Escape
items.descriptionText: This ring is made of shiny light metal wires, woven together in a braid. When activated the wires shift and move. Once per day when the wearer is subject to a spell or effect that allows for a Reflex save, they can activate the ring as an immediate action to teleport away as per the dimension door spell with a 40 foot range. This teleportation occurs before the effects that required the Reflex save, so the wearer of the ring is unaffected assuming their new location is outside the affected area.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, dimension door

items.name: Ring of Lore
items.descriptionText: The wearer of the ring of lore can use legend lore and stone tell each once per week by using the command word. Additionally, the wearer gains the ability to find traps created by glyphs, runes, sigils, and symbols as a rogue can.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, find traps, legend lore, stone tell

items.name: Ring of Mystic Might
items.descriptionText: This bronze ring is formed into a motif of unending power like an ouroboros. When worn by a spellcaster, the ring provides a +1 bonus to caster level for the purpose of concentration, against spell resistance, caster level checks, and level dependent variables.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, limited wish, greater magic weapon

items.name: Ring of Preparation
items.descriptionText: This ring is carved from a single piece of polished stone or coral and serves as a quickly accessible source of spells. When preparing spells for the day, a prepared spellcaster can instill three spells of any level that they can normally prepare into the ring. As a move action, the wearer of the ring can prepare one of the spells stored in the ring in an empty spell slot of the appropriate level. The spell cannot be transferred into an expended spell slot and the wearer must be able to cast the spell normally via their own spell list. For example, a wizard could leave a 3rd-level slot open and if the ring had fireball, dispel magic, or heroism, they could prepare it in their open slot as a move action . On the other hand, a cleric could not use the same ring to prepare the fireball or heroism spells. If the spell is given to a spontaneous caster, they treat the spells stored within as a spell known so long as the spells are on their spell list.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, mnemonic enhancer

items.name: Ring of Tenacious Spells
items.descriptionText: This ring is forged in an intricate lattice of copper that covers most of the length of a finger. The ring flexes and bends with the finger without breaking however. The ring must be worn and attuned to for 24 hours before its effects can benefit the wearer and if it is removed for more than 24 hours, the wearer must re-attune to it before use. The wearer is considered to be 4 levels higher for the purposes of dispel or counterspell attempts made against spells you cast.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, dispel magic

items.name: Robe of Spellwarding
items.descriptionText: This shimmering silk robe is stitched with arcane runes and is coated in a powder of precious stones adhered to the silk. This robe grants the wearer a +4 resistance bonus on all saving throws. Additionally, it functions as a ring of counterspells, except is can hold, and counter, a single spell of any level.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, imbue with spell ability, resistance

items.name: Rod of Endless Rope
items.descriptionText: Crafted from dark ebony and stained until it is a most lustrous black, this rod is a sculpted, 18-inch-long baton. Close inspection ( Perception DC 15) reveals three barely noticeable indentations in the middle third ofthe rod. The three indentations are in fact buttons. Pressing any one of the rod's buttons requires a move action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity . If used as a weapon it functions as a +1 light mace. The rod has three functions, each of which can be employed at will. However, no two functions can be used at the same time. The three functions of the rod are as follows. Rope: When you press the first button, rope begins to appear from one end of the rod at a rate of 60 feet per round. The rod can create 300 feet of rope in this way. Pressing the button again stops the rope from appearing. Pressing it a third time retracts the rope back, also at a rate of 60 feet per round. This rope has the same hardness and hit points as the rest of the rod. Grappling Hook and Rope: When you press the second button, a leather wrist loop springs from one end of the rod and the other end extends three hooks, forming a grapnel. Pressing the button again launches one end of the rod (the end with the newly formed grappling hook ) in the direction you aimed. A length of rope up to 300 feet trails behind the launched grappling hook, this rope connects the end you are holding to the grappling hook; all 300 feet of rope can discharge in a single round. The rope stops extending if the hook strikes something solid (including a creature), and secures itself in place automatically if it strikes a solid non living object capable of bearing your weight. Pressing the button once more retracts the rope, drawing the held end toward the hooked end if it is secured properly. The retracting feature can pull up to 1,000 pounds, drawing 60 feet of rope per round. The rope has the same hardness and hit points as the rest of the rod. You may also use this to push back opponents within 30 feet (outside this distance the rod lacks sufficient power). On a successful ranged attack the hooked end deals 2d6 points of damage. The force of this is surprisingly strong, and those struck are subject to a bull rush combat maneuver . Treat the rod's strength score as 20 for the check but otherwise calculate your combat maneuver bonus normally, including any feats or special abilities you possess which would add to the attack. Grappling Hooks and Slide: The final button launches a second grappling hook from the opposite end of the rod using all the rules described above. When both grappling hooks are secured the middle section of the rod can be activated to expand slightly and slide back and forth across the rope you created at a speed of 40 ft. per round. This allows each end of the rod to create 300 feet of rope effectively giving you 600 feet of rope. The grappling hooks and rope can support no more than 1000 pounds.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, animate rope

items.name: Rod of Ready-Making
items.descriptionText: This utilitarian metal rod, usually made of adamantine or iron, allows the user to equip or unequip and store a full set of armor and weapons. When fully armed, the user can use a standard action to store the equipped armor and weapons in the rod. Anytime thereafter, the user can use a standard action to retrieve the stored equipment. If the user is wearing a different set of weapons or armor, they are swapped for the stored set, and the new set is now stored. As a full round action, stored equipment can be ejected in a nicely stacked and folded fashion in an adjacent space.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, shrink item

items.name: Rod of Shadow Infusion
items.descriptionText: This rod looks like a burned, twisted branch about 2 feet long, it is in fact made of dark metal instead of wood. When activated, the rod emits a shadowy smoke around it for 1 round. As a swift action, usable 3 times per day, the user can convert an illusion spell into a more powerful shadow spell, making them partially real. Any casting of minor image or major image can be converted into a casting of shadow conjuration and any casting of major image can be converted into a casting of shadow evocation .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, shadow conjuration, shadow evocation

items.name: Rod of Spell Holding
items.descriptionText: This thin copper rod is capped with an open hand. It allows the user to cast a spell with a range of touch into the rod and "hold" it, allowing them to cast other spells or using other touch effects while the charge is held in the rod. As a standard action, the rod can be used to deliver the held charge as a melee touch attack . The rod can hold the charge for up to 6 minutes. If the duration expires or the rod leaves the user's hand, the charge in the rod is lost. As a bonus, the rod acts as a great back scratcher.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod

items.name: Rod of the Admiral
items.descriptionText: This golden rod appears to be an ordinary, though sturdy, spyglass. While in the possession of a creature they gain the effects of a constant water breathing spell and gain a swim speed of 40 feet. In addition once per week they may summon a longboat, crewed by ghostly force. This longboat functions at the rod owner's commands and rolls Profession (sailor) checks with a +15 bonus. The longboat persists for one week and the owner of the rod may choose to maintain the ship when the duration expires by activating the rod as a purely mental action.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, major creation, water breathing

items.name: Rod of the General
items.descriptionText: This gilded rod is in shining metal, usual mithral, and banded in gold. The possessor gains a +2 enhancement bonus to their leadership score while the rod is held or carried. Additionally, the bearer can prepare an additional aura from the marshal class. Additionally, once per day, the rod can create a 30-foot radius command tent. The inside of the tent is furnished as a military command post. The tent provides protection from harsh weather and temperatures. The tent lasts for 24 hours at which point it disappears with any objects left within the tent. The objects left within are restored when the tent is summoned again. Additionally, once per week, the tent can be summoned with a detailed map of the 10-mile radius around the tent. This map cannot be removed from the tent and disappears when the tent does.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, eagle's splendor, major creation, scry

items.name: Shieldshift (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: These weapons are most often used as off-hand weapons by those who sometimes need a little more protection. As a swift action a shieldshift weapon can transform into a heavy steel shield with an enhancement bonus equal to that of the shieldshift weapon to both AC and to attack rolls with the shield.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield

items.name: Silvermist
items.descriptionText: Silvermist armor is etched and filigreed and stitched in patterns of clouds and swirls. This armor ability can be added to any light armor as well as any mithral armor. Three times per day as a standard action the wearer of this armor can cause all squares within 20 ft. of themselves to fill with mist which provides concealment as the spell obscuring mist but does not interfere with the wearer's own vision . This mist lasts for 1 minute.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, obscuring mist

items.name: Greater Silvermist
items.descriptionText: This armor functions as silver mist armor except that it provides total concealment to the wearer and only normal concealment to other creatures.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fog cloud

items.name: Snakeskin Corset
items.descriptionText: This fine corset is made of multiple complementary strips of snakeskin. The snakeskin corset grants its wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saves against poison and disease . Additionally, once per day as a move action, the wearer can take the shape of an emperor cobra as though by beast shape iii.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, beast shape iii

items.name: Soldiers of Camaraderie
items.descriptionText: This small ivory statuette resembles a pair of soldiers in formation. The soldiers can be separated and restored to a single statuette as a move action . As long as the soldiers are carried by two creatures they may communicate as though by telepathy regardless of distance as long as they remain on the same plane. In addition a single soldier can be thrown to the ground and shattered as a standard action, teleporting you adjacent to (or nearest safe space) the creature which carries the other statuette. A creature can only benefit from one statuette at a time. Once one soldier has broken, the other becomes magically inert, though is still a fine art piece worth approximately 200 gp.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, telepathic bond, teleport

items.name: Soldier's Satchel
items.descriptionText: This simple burlap backpack looks well worn and battle scarred. The soldier's satchel acts as a handy haversack except that one of the smaller pockets can't be used for personal storage. Instead you may draw a masterwork simple or martial weapon, a day's rations, a full waterskin, a tent, a bedroll, 100 feet of rope, a torch, soap, a climbing kit, a spyglass, or a fishing rod and bait from it, each once per day. Any item drawn forth from the bag disappears after 8 hours or if you attempt to sell or trade it.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, secret chest, major creation

items.name: Spectacles of Spell Reading
items.descriptionText: These multi-lensed spectacles grant the user a +5 competence bonus on Spellcraft and Use Magic Device checks relating to scrolls .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, read magic

items.name: Spell Stone
items.descriptionText: A spell stone is a small piece of slate etched with a series of runes. If snapped in half, the spell stone releases the spell stores within as if the user has cast it. Spell stones are only usable once. A spell stone is created with a spell etched on it up to a maximum spell level of 4th level, with a casting time of less than 1 minute. A user of a spell stone need not be able to cast the spell normally or Use Magic Device to activate the spell stone. The price of spell stones is equal to the level of the spell x the caster level of the spell stored within x 100 gp. If the spell etched into the spell stone has a material cost, it is added to the base price and cost to create. Note that some spells appear at different levels for different casters. The level of such spells depends on the caster creating the spell stone. The creator or user of a spell stone cannot apply metamagic or any feats that would normally affect the spell, like Spell Focus or Augment You can apply one metamagic feat you know to the wand to which the metamagic wand grip is attached. Doing so drains one additional charge per spell level increase normally required by the metamagic feat . The level increase for this purpose is not reduced by any class abilities or feats. For example, you couple apply Extend Spell to a spell cast from a wand by expending two charges because Extend Spell normally increases the spell level by one.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Metamagic Spell Trigger Identifying Spell Stones: A spell stone can be identified in a similar manner to a scroll . Activating a Spell Stone: As mentioned before, a spell stone is activated by snapping the slate in half. The user of the spell stone is treated as the caster and may choose the target of the spell stored within as if they were the caster. However, the spell stone uses the caster level of the creator and the spellcasting attribute of the spell for the spell effects and DC is equal to the minimum required to cast a spell of that spell's level. For example, a 1st level spell would require a minimum of an 11 in the requisite ability score, so the ability score bonus would be +0. Activating the spell stone is a standard action that provokes an attack of opportunity . Unlike spellcasting, or using spell completion items, the spell from the stone cannot be lost and does not require a concentration check. A spell stone broken or destroyed by other means does not release the spell.

items.name: Spellslinging (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: These weapons were developed to aid arcane archers, though other spellcasters can find use in them as well. This special ability may only be placed on bows and crossbows. Once per round as free action you may sacrifice a prepared spell or expend a spell slot to add a bonus on the next damage roll with this weapon equal to the level of the spell or spell slot sacrificed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft (any bow-craft) 5 ranks

items.name: Spy's Tattoos
items.descriptionText: A spy's tattoos is a pair of connected magical tattoos, each one inscribed on a different creature. A wearer can activate their magical tattoo from the spy's tattoos as a move action . Once activated, the wearer can mentally communicate with the recipient of the other paired magical tattoo from the spy's tattoos. This effect functions as per paired seals of private communication (including the penalty to Perception checks while the magic is in effect). A wearer can only use the spy's tattoos up to 10 minutes per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 1-minute increments.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Inscribe Magical Tattoo, paired seals of private communication

items.name: Staff of Hope
items.descriptionText: This staff is made of a golden honey wood and feels comfortable in heft and grip. It allows use of the following spells: ray of hope (1 charge) good hope (2 charges) joyous laugh (2 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, good hope, joyous laugh, ray of hope

items.name: Staff of the Daimyo
items.descriptionText: This thick oak staff is inlaid with gold and silver spiraling in alternating patterns and is tipped with a large, curved blade. This staff functions as a +2 keen naginata and also allows the use of the following spells. greater magic weapon (1 charge) magic vestment (1 charge) heroism (1 charge) towering presence* (1 charge)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, greater magic weapon, magic vestment, heroism, towering presence

items.name: Staff of the Dread Knight
items.descriptionText: This thick iron staff is topped with a wicked ball of twisted metal. This staff functions as a +1 shocking earthbreaker and also allows the use of the following spells. cause fear (1 charge) fear (1 charge) war song* (2 charges) feast on fear (2 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, cause fear, fear, war song, feast on fear

items.name: Staff of the Lord Protector
items.descriptionText: This ornate golden staff is well balanced and adorned with silver filigree of shields and flowers throughout. This staff functions as a +1 flaming /+1 frost quarterstaff and also allows the use of the following spells. shield (1 charge) shield other (1 charge) protection from arrows (1 charge) glyph of warding (2 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, shield, shield other, protection from arrows, glyph of warding

items.name: Staff of Words
items.descriptionText: This blackened wood staff is etched with arcane words, runes and symbols along its entire length. It allows use of the following spells: power word fatigue (1 charge) power word pain (2 charges) power word frighten (2 charges) power word kill (3 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, power word fatigue, power word frighten, power word kill, power word pain

items.name: Stitching (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
items.descriptionText: These special suits of armor were originally developed to reduce the burden on combat healers in dwarven fortresses, though their utility is universal. The first time each day you would be reduced to less than 0 hit points while wearing this armor you are healed for 3d8+ 5 points of damage. If this would leave you with a hit point total greater than zero, you remain conscious and aware as though your hit point total had never fallen below zero. If your hit point total is still less than zero after this healing you are unconscious but stable .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure moderate wounds

items.name: Stone of Natural Form
items.descriptionText: This small stone is imbued with the magic to free creatures from being stuck in a form not their own. The stone, if pressed against a creature who is under the effects of a polymorph spell or effect, dissolves and the target is instantly returned to their natural form.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item,, break enchantment

items.name: Stonerope
items.descriptionText: This 50-foot-long coil of hemp rope is of dwarven make. When the command word is spoken, the rope becomes stone in whatever shape it was in when the command word was spoken. If used for restraints while in its stone form, the rope acts like manacles for the purposes of the Escape Artist DC. The rope returns to its original form if the second command word is spoken. If the rope is broken in either form it is destroyed.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, stone shape

items.name: Storm Vest
items.descriptionText: The trim of this vest is set with fine golden chain and the stitches appear to be arrayed as miniature bolts of lightning, it seems to hum lightly when worn. Twice per day while wearing the storm vest you can become a bolt of electricity as a standard action . You instantly move up to 60 feet in a straight line to an unoccupied space and deal 3d6 electric damage to each creature whose space you pass through, a reflex saving throw with a DC of 14 reduces this damage by half.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, lightning bolt

items.name: Stuttering (Magic Weapon Quality)
items.descriptionText: These weapons were made to combat mages by hampering their ability to cast spells. Whenever the wielder strikes a creature with this weapon they take a -5 penalty on concentration checks to cast spells with verbal components defensively. This penalty lasts for one minute.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer

items.name: Sudden
items.descriptionText: A sudden weapon can be drawn as a free action . If you are wielding a sudden weapon you also gain a +2 bonus to initiative rolls and a +2 bonus to damage rolls with the weapon against creatures who have not yet acted in combat.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Improved Initiative, cat's grace

items.name: Tabard of the Boastful Scoundrel
items.descriptionText: This pure white roll of cotton fabric can be donned as a tabard, bearing the symbol of your family, or a personal symbol if desired. While worn by a character with the challenge or parry and riposte class feature this tabard grants a +2 competence bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sleight of Hand checks. In addition when activating challenge or parry and riposte, your next attack before the end of the current turn gains a bonus to damage and critical confirmation rolls equal to your Charisma modifier. Once per day while wearing the tabard, if you score a critical hit you regain a use of challenge or a point of panache, your choice.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, eagle's splendor

items.name: Translocation Cloak
items.descriptionText: This cloak appears to be a very dark velvet, though the shadows between its folds seem immeasurably vast. Twice per day as a swift action you can command the cloak to teleport you 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, as though by a dimension door spell, though you may still take actions normally for the rest of your turn.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, dimension door

items.name: Weeping Ring
items.descriptionText: This ring is made of a dark, dull metal that seems to be streaked with dried salt, when activated tears drip from the ring and the quiet sounds of crying can be heard. The wearer can touch a target and impose a -3 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, and skill checks for 5 rounds. The wearer of the ring takes a -1 penalty to the same rolls for the same duration as the target. This is an emotion and mind-affecting effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, ray of sorrow

items.name: Whirlwind Bracelet
items.descriptionText: A whirlwind bracer is a thin golden bracelet inscribed with lightning bolts and storm clouds. It is small enough to be easily hidden beneath loose clothes or heavy gloves. As a standard action you can reach toward the sky and be transformed into a violent and crackling whirlwind for one round. When transformed you are made of air, granting you DR 10/magic and a flight speed of 100 feet (perfect). You may pass through squares occupied by creatures and objects but cannot pass through walls or other immovable solid objects, though you may be able to pass through particularly drafty windows, and openings in solid objects. Whenever you pass through a square occupied by a creature, that creature must make a reflex save with a DC of 15 or take 3d8 electricity damage. The bracelet can be activated three times per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, polymorph

items.name: Doomblood Athame
items.descriptionText: While this cold iron dagger is on your person or in your possession (it need not be welded), the first time each round a target makes a saving throw against a hex of yours, you may choose to take damage equal to half your hexcaster level (all levels in classes that give you access to hexes, or half your character level, whichever is higher) to create a blood curse. This damage bypasses any defenses you have, and cannot be recovered through spells or channeling (though hexes and other spell-like abilities, potions, and natural healing, work normally). If you are affected by this damage, the target is sickened for 1 round. This duration can be extended with the cackle hex. This effect can be removed with a remove curse or remove disease, but requires a caster level check against a DC equal to 10 + your caster level . Once you have used the doomblood athame 's blood curse against a target, you cannot use it against that target again for 24 hours. Additionally, when you use either the doomblood athame or a natural weapon or unarmed attack to attack a target that has failed a save against one of your hexes within the past 24 hours, you may use your hexcaster level as your bonus to attack (in place of your base attack bonus and any ability score bonus you would normally add to the attack), and your attack is considered bane against that target (an additional +2 to your attack roll, and +2d6 damage).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor

items.name: Ring of Favor
items.descriptionText: This ring appears to be a tiny silver chain with a thorny rose vine intertwined among the links. When worn by a character who has the hex class feature, it changes form to look like their personal symbol of heraldry (or a thematically appropriate appearance if the character has no heraldry). When the witch casts a hex on an ally, they can choose to have this symbol appear briefly over the ally, as a sign of the witch's favor. When word by a character who has 3 or more hexes gained from classes or feats, this ring grants one bonus hex known while worn. If the wearer has 6 or more hexes, it grants 2 bonus hexes. If the wearer has 12 or more hexes, the ring grants 3 bonus hexes. The bonus hexes must be selected from the following list: ameliorating, aura of purity, fortune, healing, protective luck, ward . Once made, the selection of bonuses hexes cannot be easily changed. Each time a character gains a new level in a class that grants hexes, they may change what bonus hexes they gain from the ring.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring

items.name: Slippers of the Glacier
items.descriptionText: You ignore all movement reductions and skill check penalties from ice, cold, snow, and other winter hazards (mundane or magical). Additionally, if you have hexcaster levels (levels in a class that give you access to hexes ), once per day you can cause a whirlwind of snow and ice to surround and support you as if you were using the flight hex. (If you have the flight hex, instead double the number of times you can use levitate, or the number of minutes of fly you receive).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item

items.name: Blessed Stone of the Hearth & Flame
items.descriptionText: This flat stone is always warm to the touch . When placed in the palm of a veilweaver who has the Chef's Armory veil shaped, it bursts into flames, leaving the scent of freshly baked bread behind. The veilweaver's Chef's Armory veil gains the following text: Bind: Flames created by the Spark spell-like ability granted by the Chef's Armory are exceptionally suited to cooking. They'll never burn the food (Unless commanded by the veilweaver), and will maintain a perfect temperature that'll have any food cooked to perfection in half the time. Even the tools created by the veilweaver seem to share this flame's affinity for cooking — Vegetables chop neatly, spices spread evenly, and so on. The veilweaver needs only half an hour to prepare and cook akashic recipes instead of an hour.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Crafter's Fortune

items.name: Falcon Dagger
items.descriptionText: These jagged-bladed +1 daggers are decorated with copper feathers and can, once per day, give their wielder the ability to fly, as the spell, for three rounds, consecutively. Activating the flight power is a swift action
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly, Quicken Spell

items.name: Fourbane Shield
items.descriptionText: This +1 heavy wooden shield has a four-sectioned crest on the front, showing stylized images of wind, fire, earth and water. It gives its wielder a resistance of 5 to acid, cold, electricity, and fire.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, endure elements, resist energy

items.name: Gelert's Crwth
items.descriptionText: A crwth (pronounced crowt) looks like a flat lute, and is played with a bow while hanging from a strap around the player's neck. These magical instruments remind the people of Geranland of the story of Gelert, favorite hunting-hound of Lord Lewyn, a noble of that kingdom. When Lewyn came home from hunting, he found his child's crib overturned, and Gelert's muzzle covered in blood. He furiously slew Gelert, thinking he had killed his baby. Then he heard a cry and found the child, unharmed, under the crib, a dead wolf nearby. His story of grief and gratitude is the signature song of gelert's crwth; its player gains +3 to Perform (strings) checks, and can use lesser planar ally to call a hound archon, always named Gelert, to their aid . As it is always the same hound archon, it interacts with the owner of the crwth consistently; it will serve for a maximum of 7 hours per week, in any increment of 1 hour. It will immediately attack a crwth owner of evil alignment . If the hound archon is slain (it does not necessarily regain lost hit points when dismissed) the crwth will lose its ability to call Gelert, and will thenceforth grant the user the ability to cast crushing despair 1/day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, crushing despair, lesser planar ally

items.name: Hexenhammer
items.descriptionText: This +1 cold iron warhammer has a hilt wound in gilded sunflowers. It grants the holder a +1 bonus vs. the spells and hexes of witches, and a +1 additional attack bonus vs. witches . Once per day, as a standard action, the wielder can "accuse" a target of being a witch; if they fail a DC 17 Will save, they are treated as though they have levels in the witch base class for the rest of that day, to all tests magical and mundane. If the save is made, the accuser is shaken for 1d10 rounds, no save. Accusation is a mind-affecting effect, but can otherwise be made against any monster type.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bless, cause fear, command

items.name: Mitre of Benevolence
items.descriptionText: This large, ornate headgear bears symbols of goodness and service, but is can be cumbersome, extending a full foot into the air. An evil wearer suffers a -2 penalty to armor class when it is worn, which disappears if removed. It grants the wearer a +1 sacred armor bonus, and radiates an aura of guidance and virtue for 30 ft.; those within it are affected by those spells, which are renewed each minute, and are not cumulative.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, guidance, protection from evil, virtue

items.name: The Traveling Chef
items.descriptionText: This tiny bag functions as a, well, a backpack made for a tiny sized individual. When placed in the palm of a veilweaver who has the Chef's Armory veil shaped, it dissolves into a fine spice, then is quickly absorbed by the veil. The veilweaver's Chef's Armory veil gains the following text: Shaped: The veilweaver gains the ability to store food and ingredients into their veil. Treat this a Bag of Holding, with the exception that this bag will only accept food and ingredients. Any other item that one attempts to place in there will not cross the threshold. This veil can store 100lbs of food and ingredients, and food and ingredients placed in here will be placed in a stasis — They will never rot, expire, or go bad, and will maintain their temperature and consistency as long as they were placed in. Living creatures, despite how tasty they may be, are never considered food for purposes of storing them inside this veil. Bind: The veilweaver can alter the flow of time within the extra dimensional storage space. Time inside this veil can be altered so that for each day passes, one year passes for the selected items inside. While not great for most foods, this can be an excellent way to cool off hot soups, or a way to quickly age wine . The veilweaver may pick and choose which items are affected, and may have different rates for different items.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Secret chest

items.name: Vial of Rotted Food
items.descriptionText: This magically enchanted vial contain bits and pieces of rotted food, doused with poison. When drunk, the imbiber must make a DC 16 fortitude save or be affected by both the Filth Fever disease and Arsenic poison . If drunk by a veilweaver who knows the Chef's Armory veil, they additionally gain knowledge of poison and diseases in relation to the food that they cook. Their Chef's Armory veil gains the following text: Shaped: The veilweaver gains a +1 insight bonus on fortitude saves made to resist poisons and diseases. Essence: Each point of essence invested in this veil also increases the insight bonus on fortitude saves made to resist poisons and diseases by 1. Bind: When preparing food, the veilweaver may spend 10 minutes to turn any F-ranked food into an E-ranked food, removing any poisons or diseases that the food may carry in the process.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, Neutralize poison

items.name: Band of Augmentation
items.descriptionText: This ring is a jet-black band decorated with dozens of diamonds that form the fourteen occult constellations. Each band of augmentation is keyed to one specific pact augmentation available to a 3rd level pactmaker . While bound to a spirit that she has sealed a good pact with and wearing a band of augmentation, the wearer gains that pact augmentation, using her binder level as her pactmaker level. If the wearer already possesses the ring's pact augmentation, then the wearer increases the bonus that she gains from the chosen augmentation by +1 or her pactmaker level by +4. The effects of a band of augmentation don't stack; each must apply to a different pact augmentation.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, bolster binding

items.name: Bell of Eviction
items.descriptionText: Traditionally crafted from bronze, this ornate bell possesses a wooden shaft that is scrawled with the seals of various spirits. When the bell is rung, all creatures bound to a spirit within the bell's range feel a sense of increasing anxiety and discomfort. After 3 consecutive minutes, these creatures are affected as banish pact spirits (DC 25 Will ), except this effect does not require a touch attack . A bell of eviction is a sonic effect and does not affect deafened creatures. Additionally, an area of silence protects a binder from the bell's effects. Bells of eviction come in several different shapes and sizes, each with an increasingly wide-spread area of effect. A standard bell of eviction (CL 10th) banishes spirits in a 20-ft. radius, costs 75,000 gp, and weighs 1 pound A gong of eviction (CL 10th) banishes spirits in a 100-ft. radius, costs 150,000 gp, and weighs 100 pounds A tower bell of eviction (CL 17th) banishes spirits a 1 mile radius, costs 600,000 gp, and weighs 2 tons. A tower bell of eviction has a strong occult aura.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, banish pact spirits

items.name: Brooch of Lamenting
items.descriptionText: This intricate brooch consists of a mithral embroidery surrounding an obsidian jewel that neither shines nor reflects light or images. While wearing a brooch of lamenting, the wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Will saves against effects that suppress or exorcise spirits. Additionally, if the wearer fails a saving throw against an effect that would suppresses or exorcise its bound spirits, the brooch shatters, negating the effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, exorcist's lament

items.name: Cloak of Constellations
items.descriptionText: A cloak of constellations is designed with a motif representing one of the 13 occult constellations. A cloak of constellations cannot be designed with a starless motif. While worn, the cloak provides the wearer with a +4 competence bonus on binding checks made with spirits that belong to the cloak's constellation. Additionally, the wearer gains the benefits of the Rapid Recovery feat while wearing the cloak, but only with spirits that belong to the cloak's constellation.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, bolster binding

items.name: Cyclopean Staff
items.descriptionText: This wooden staff possesses a plant-like bud that conceals an organic eye. When a charge from the staff is spent, the bud opens. The staff allows the use of the following spells: Bolster binding (1 charge) Comprehend languages (1 charge) Daze (1 charge) Detect pact spirits (1 charge) Bind spirit I (2 charges) Dismiss pact spirit (2 charges)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Staff, bolster binding, bind spirit I, comprehend languages, daze, detect pact spirits, dismiss pact spirit

items.name: Dedicated Vest
items.descriptionText: Outwardly plain, this leather vest is stitched with several dozen seals and occult motifs on the inside. While wearing a dedicated vest, the wearer automatically gains the capstone empowerments of any spirits that she is bound to. If a dedicated vest is removed or destroyed while its wearer is bound to a spirit, she becomes stunned for 1d4 rounds and those capstone empowerments are lost.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, capstone surge

items.name: Endless Chalk
items.descriptionText: This stick of ordinary white chalk is roughly 2 inches in length and smooth to the touch. Unlike normal chalk, a stick of endless chalk does not powder off onto its user's fingers and it does not smear or smudge easily. Endless chalk is water resistant and can be used in damp environments. Heavy rain, being submerged, or actively trying to wipe away the chalk will wash it away. Finally, no amount of use causes the chalk to diminish in size; the chalk effectively never depletes after use, though being completely submerged in water for 1 hour will cause it to dissolve. If a stick of endless chalk is used to draw a spirit's seal, the chalk grants its user a +1 competence bonus on binding checks made with the spirit.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, arcane mark

items.name: Exorcising
items.descriptionText: An exorcising weapon functions like a spell storing weapon, but it may only store dismiss pact spirit; however, the caster level check to exorcise gains an additional bonus equal to the weapon's enhancement bonus . This bonus also applies to any class feature, option, or ability that functions as banish pact spirits, such as the exorcise pact spirits binder secret.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dismiss pact spirit, creator must be a binder of at least 10th level

args.text: creator must be a binder of at least 10th level

items.name: Exorcising Burst
items.descriptionText: An exorcising burst weapon functions like an exorcising weapon but may store banish pact spirits or dismiss pact spirit and its enhancement bonus applies to any class feature, option, or ability that functions as banish pact spirits or dismiss pact spirit, such as the exorcise pact spirits binder secret. In addition, these spells can be discharged as a free action when the wielder of an exorcising burst weapon confirms a critical hit . When the wielder does so, the bonus to the check made to exorcise (including from abilities that function as banish pact spirits) increases by an amount equal to the weapon's enhancement bonus or the weapon's critical multiplier (whichever is higher). If an exorcising burst weapon confirms a critical hit while it is not currently storing a banish pact spirits or dismiss pact spirit spell, yet the wielder has either spell prepared (or is a spontaneous spellcaster able to cast either spell), she may cast either spell into the weapon as a swift action and then immediately discharge it into the target as a free action .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dismiss pact spirit, creator must be a binder of at least 12th level

args.text: creator must be a binder of at least 12th level

items.name: Exorcist's Revealing Box
items.descriptionText: This hand-held box is made from cast iron or a similarly tough metal and possesses no features save for a single hole large enough to slide the hand of a Medium creature. If a creature that is currently bound to a spirit has its hand placed wholly within an exorcist's revealing box, the box's sides light up with the seal of the spirit (or spirits) that the individual is bound to, revealing them as a binder. A character can attempt a Knowledge check to identify the seal, but most exorcists care little for such knowledge and use the box solely as a way to confirm heresy.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, reveal heresy, reveal heretic

items.name: Gnostic Tome
items.descriptionText: A gnostic tome contains all the necessary lore requires to bind one, specific spirit. A binder that spends 24 uninterrupted hours reading a gnostic tome completes all Knowledge Tasks associated with the gnostic tome's associated spirit.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must complete all of the Knowledge Tasks of the gnostic tome's associated spirit (this requirement cannot be ignored by increasing the Craft or Spellcraft DC of the item)

args.text: creator must complete all of the Knowledge Tasks of the gnostic tome's associated spirit (this requirement cannot be ignored by increasing the Craft or Spellcraft DC of the item)

items.name: Goggles of Spirit Sight
items.descriptionText: These goggles are decorated with seal motifs across the lenses that curiously do not impede vision. The wearer can utter a command word in order to gain the benefits of occult sight while wearing a pair of goggles of spirit sight. The same command word is used to end the effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, occult sight

items.name: Guarded
items.descriptionText: A guarded suit of armor or shield reacts to the paranoid musings of pact spirits, increasing its defenses against such foes, similar to a bane weapon's excelling against certain foes. Against creatures that are considered to be the favored enemy of any spirits that the wearer is bound to, the item's enhancement bonus to AC is +2 better than its actual bonus and provides DR 2/– against attacks from that foe. This increase in enhancement bonus applies only to the armor or shield's enhancement bonus, not to temporary bonuses (such as the magic vestment spell).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, protection from the supernatural

items.name: Lens of Scribing
items.descriptionText: This palm-sized lens appears mundane at a glance, but viewing it under light shows a myriad of words not yet spoken and scenes that have not yet occurred. By holding a lens of scribing up to your eye and uttering a command word, the lens immediately copies whatever you are viewing onto it, storing the image for later. By holding the lens under a light source above a piece of parchment or similar material, you can burn the last scene stored within the lens onto the parchment with a second command word. The lens has vision comparable to a human eye and is thusly limited when used in conditions of dim lightning and darkness.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, arcane mark

items.name: Loops of Forced Requisition
items.descriptionText: This set of matching rings are made of solid, white gold, one marked with the word "devotion" and the other "devotee." The "devotion ring" has no effect on its wearer while worn, but the wearer of the "devotee ring" must succeed on a DC 18 Will save once per round or fall helplessly in love with the creature wearing the "devotion" band, as the one-target version of love spell, and refuse to remove the "devotee ring" from her finger. If both rings are worn for three days, the effect becomes permanent and the magic within a set of loops of forced requisition is lost. If the creature wearing the "devotion" band is forced to remove her ring before three days have passed, the love spell effect immediately ends.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, love spell

items.name: Occult Infusion Metamagic Rod
items.descriptionText: The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that automatically succeed at all concentration checks that he makes to avoid losing the spell as though using the Occult Infusion feat. If you are not bound to a spirit when attempting to activate this rod, you must succeed at a DC 20 Use Magic Device to emulate the bind spirit class feature.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, Occult Infusion

items.name: Tailored Metamagic Rod
items.descriptionText: The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that alter the target's age, height, and weight to his exact specifications as though using the Tailored Spell feat.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, Tailored Spell

items.name: Mirror of Spirit Reflecting
items.descriptionText: This ordinary mirror possesses a black-metal border depicting the deaths of half a dozen binders, each one showing the physical sign of half a dozen random spirits. A mirror of spirit reflecting shows the reflections of normal creatures as they are, but creatures currently bound to one or more spirits do not show their reflection in the mirror. Instead, the mirror shows that creature suffering the physical sign of any spirits it is bound to, as well as those spirits' seals glowing across their heart. Spells and effects that prevent divination effects from revealing the presence of spirits (such as undetectable spirit) thwart the mirror.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, reveal heretic, true seeing

items.name: Monomorphic
items.descriptionText: A suit of monomorphic armor stabilizes the wearer's body, preventing its form from being altered. The wearer gains a circumstance bonus on saving throws against polymorph spells and effects equal to the armor's enhancement bonus and the wearer must make a saving throw against all polymorph spells that target her. If the wearer uses a supernatural ability that alters its form, such as change shape or the wild shape class feature, then using that ability while wearing a suit of monomorphic armor provokes attacks of opportunity because of the effort needed to bypass the armor's magic.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, true form

items.name: Orb of Soul Binding
items.descriptionText: This large, glimmering orb is roughly three feet in diameter and appears to be translucent, like glass, but is as sturdy and thick as marble. When unoccupied, an orb of soul binding is as clear as finely polished glass. A binder can draw a smaller version of a spirit's seal onto the orb and perform the spirit's ritual with it, typically by placing the orb onto a device specifically designed to hold it. Once the ceremony has been performed, the spirit manifests within the orb where it remains for 24 hours. During this time, any sufficiently skilled binder may touch the orb to initiate a pact with that spirit. This functions as any other pact, taking approximately 5 minutes to create an empathetic link with the spirit and perform the binding check. The binder can make a rushed binding check as described in Chapter 3 to reduce this to 5 rounds. The binder must make a binding check as per usual and can end up with either a good pact or a poor pact depending upon the result. Unlike normal pacts, a binder gains no totem benefits on binding checks when using an orb of soul binding. The spirit remains within an orb of soul binding for 24 hours, regardless of how many binders make a pact with the spirit held inside of it. A spirit cannot be expelled from an orb of soul binding but it can be exorcised via dismiss pact spirit or a similar ability. If an orb of soul binding is not used to make a pact at least once before the spirit departs, it destroys the orb in a fit of rage. Orbs of soul binding are created with a maximum spirit level that they can contain; an orb cannot contain a spirit whose level is higher than its maximum spirit level. An orb's binder level (CL) is equal to the minimum level a pactmaker would require to forge a pact with a spirit of the orb's maximum spirit level. An orb's aura is faint if the maximum spirit level is between 1st through 3rd, moderate if 4th through 6th, and strong if 7th through 9th. An orb's cost is equal to its maximum spirit level x its binder level x 1,000 gp.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, draw seal, permanency
items.constructionCostText: varies, usually half of its purchase

items.name: Pact Augmenting
items.descriptionText: A suit of pact augmenting armor enhances the effects that pactmaker powers have on the wearer's defenses. If the wearer possesses the pact augmentation class feature, any bonuses to AC, saving throws, or on initiative checks from pact augmentation are increased by half the armor's enhancement bonus .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bolster binding

items.name: Pact Bane
items.descriptionText: A pact bane weapon is designed to wreck occult creatures as well as those that are bound to otherworldly entities. When wielded against a creature with a binder level or that possesses the occult subtype, a pact bane weapon's enhancement bonus is +2 better than its actual bonus. It also deals an extra 2d6 points of damage against creatures with a binder level or that possess the pact subtype. This extra damage is not multiplied on a critical hit .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, reveal heresy, weapon of awe

items.name: Pact Warding
items.descriptionText: A suit of pact warding armor is designed to protect its wearer from the weird influences of the occult, but its enchantments are equally effective against more commonly encountered supernatural abilities. The wearer adds the armor's enhancement bonus to his saving throws against supernatural abilities.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, protection from the supernatural

items.name: Planeswalking
items.descriptionText: A suit of planeswalking armor constantly shifts between a multitude of designs and colors while twinkling stars blink in and out of view. While in this armor, the wearer is immune to the harmful effects of any plane of existence that is not the wearer's native plane, functioning as planar adaptation. In addition, once per day the wearer can command the armor to transport it to a different plane of existence, as plane shift .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, planar adaptation, plane shift

items.name: Ring of Dancing Chains
items.descriptionText: This platinum band possesses a thin indentation that cradles a thin, adamantine chain . Although held in place on the ring by the indentations, the chain itself isn't directly connected to the ring and can be spun freely. As a move action, the ring's wearer can spin the chain twice, causing it to dislodge from the ring and grow into a +1 dancing deadly adamantine whip or return an active whip to the ring. If the wearer has the Quick Draw feat, she can activate or deactivate the whip as a free action instead and this whip can be further enhanced with a greater enhancement bonus or additional abilities like any melee weapon could be.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Forge Ring, chain of perdition

items.name: Ring of Reincarnation
items.descriptionText: This ring is crafted in a beautiful medley of yellow and white gold that forms a phoenix holding its tail within its beak. If the wearer of a ring of reincarnation dies, 1 minute following his death he automatically scheduled to reincarnate (as the spell) 1 day later as a Youth of his race. When this occurs, one of the ring's two rubies (which are set as the phoenix's eyes) immediately burst into a spark of flame. When both rubies are expended, the ring becomes a non-magical item. A ring of reincarnation does not function if its wearer was slain by a death effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, reincarnate

items.name: Ring of Shifting Smiles
items.descriptionText: The ring of shifting smiles is a modest iron band fitted with a cubic slab of lodestone that rests in an ornamental, lemniscate filigree. When the ring is worn, an image of the wearer appears on all of the lodestone's faces, smiling. As a standard action, the wearer can remove this face and rotate it to the left, making her image younger, or to the right, making her image older. For each leftward rotation she makes, the wearer becomes one age category younger (minimum Infant). For each rightward rotation she makes, the wearer becomes one age category older (maximum Venerable). The wearer ages (or regresses) at a rate of one age category per round until she reaches the chosen age, at which point the engravings on the ring of shifting smiles alter to match the wearer's current age. This is a physical aging effect. The effects of the ring of shifting smiles are instantaneous; even after the ring is removed, the wearer's age does not return to normal. In order to return to her true age, the wearer must rotate the ring of shifting smiles as appropriate, be targeted by another instantaneous aging effect, or return to her original age the natural way. DESTRUCTION While wearing the ring, a creature must set herself to Venerable and eat a solar lotus. She must repeat this process for each age category until, as an Infant, another assists her in eating the final solar lotus, at which point the lodestone crumbles away into dust. When this happens, the creature's memories and experiences are likewise destroyed; she returns to infancy instantaneously and must live her life again anew.

items.name: Ring of the Secret Sect
items.descriptionText: A ring of the secret sect is created with the insignia of a specific, often secret, organization engraved somewhere on the band, typically on the gemstone. Virtually all of the organizations noted in Chapter 8 use these rings to identify their members. The wearer of a ring of the secret sect receives a +5 competence bonus on Bluff checks as well as a +2 insight bonus on Will saves against effects that would force him to reveal the truth, such as discern lies . In addition, the wearer can press a ring of the secret sect onto another creature's skin while speaking a command word to learn whether the creature belongs to the ring's organization and the creature's rank within that organization, if any.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, reveal heresy

items.name: Rod of the Imprisoned Letter
items.descriptionText: Countless words dance within the surface of this glass rod. When the rod is touched to a page with writing or illustrations written with a liquid-based medium (such as ink or blood) and a command word is spoken, the rod removes all trace of those writings, functioning as erase, by absorbing the medium used to create them. These works are not lost, however; any page destroyed by the rod is stored within it and can be viewed upon its glass surface by speaking a second command word and by speaking a third command word, the wielder can expel one page of work stored within the rod onto a blank page. A rod of the imprisoned letter can store up to 200 pages of information and a page can be permanently erased from the rod by speaking a fourth command word. When copying written words, the rod follows the same limitations as memorize page.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, erase, memorize page

items.name: Rod of the Muse
items.descriptionText: This slender rod possesses a small, thumb-sized button and a dial that is marked with dozens of artistic mediums as well as a general setting. When the button is pressed, any surface that one of the rod's edges touches is colored as if by the chosen medium; the harder the button is pressed, the thicker and wider the strokes created by the rod are. Selecting the general setting permanently changes the color of the touched surface without applying any medium or texture; color alterations to a creature or object made by a rod of the muse can be removed via an erase spell. In addition, the rod is considered a masterwork artisan's tool for Craft (painting) and similar skills and provides a +5 competence bonus instead of the usual +2 bonus.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Rod, color spray

items.name: Skull of Questioning
items.descriptionText: This skull is typically crafted from a humanoid creature, its eyes fitted with precious gems and the seal of a spirit carved into its forehead. In order to activate a skull of questioning, a character must feed blood into its mouth; as a standard action, a creature holding a skull of questioning can use its razor-sharp teeth to deal 1d4 points of Constitution damage to herself, draining the blood into the skull. For each point of Constitution fed into it, a skull of questioning will answer 3 questions, functioning as divination, up to a maximum of 21 questions per day. Any Constitution damage fed into a skull of questioning cannot be healed for 24 hours, even by greater restoration . A skull of questioning only answers questions for a creature whose blood it has fed; offering the blood of another creature solicits no response from a skull of questioning.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, augur pact, speak with dead

items.name: Sliver of the Wyrmkin Amulet
items.descriptionText: A sliver of the Wyrmkin Amulet is one of fourteen fragments of an ancient, Atlan artifact known as the Wyrmkin Amulet. In an age long past, the Wyrmkin Amulet was created by the Atlan Empire as a weapon of mass destruction. Forged using hundreds of souls, tortured to breaking, the congealed mass of spiritual energy that resulted from this torment was a thennew spirit bound forever to the amulet known as Taios the Wyrmkin. After using the amulet's power to annihilate 90% of the world's frehmin population, the gods ripped the Atlan Empire from reality, sunk their island capital beneath the waves, and shattered the Wyrmkin Amulet, scattering each fragment across time and space, locking each to a specific place and moment so they would never be rejoined. Any character that wears a sliver of the Wyrmkin Amulet is immediately bound to the spirit Taios; this pact counts against the total number of spirits that the character can be bound to (minimum 1) and lasts while the sliver is worn and for 24 hours after it is removed. The wearer receives Taios's capstone empowerment, but she also suffers Taios's physical sign and personality influences. In addition to Taios's standard personality influences,the wearer suffers Taios's personality influence whenever she unequips a sliver of the Wyrmkin Amulet. Although a sliver of the Wyrmkin Amulet is considered a neck slot magic item, a creature in possession of multiple slivers can wear all of them in her neck slot simultaneously. When she does so, the wearer gains the ability to alter reality to her whims.
