items.name: Ring of Stored Potential
items.descriptionText: This ring is carved from a single solid gemstone and glows with an inner light that pulses with its wearer's heartbeat. Rings of stored potential come in three forms, each allowing a legendary magus wearing it to store arcane potential in the ring as a swift action for use later in the day. This stored potential can be accessed as if it were part of the magus' normal potential and remains stored in the ring until used. The wearer can still only use their potential technique while in combat. A least ring of potential is carved from a single large quartz gemstone and can store 2 points of potential. A lesser ring of potential is carved from a single large sapphire gemstone and can store 4 points of potential. A greater ring of potential is carved from a single large diamond and can store 6 points of potential.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, creator must have the arcane potential class feature

args.name: creator must have the arcane potential

items.name: Ring of the Elemental Adepts
items.descriptionText: These rings enhance the power of storm knights, earth lords, fire lords, and arcane casters specialized in one of the elements (air, earth, fire or water). While wearing one of these rings, every elemental spell of the user's focus type (air, earth, fire, or water) has +1 added to its save DC. Once per day, when the wearer of the ring successfully saves vs. an attacker's spell with an elemental descriptor (air, earth, fire or water), he may transform some of its energy and use it for his own magical defense. This defense automatically takes the form of one of the effects listed below on the wearer's next turn, as a move action, if he so desires. The defense effect always matches the elemental type of the attacker's spell. Effects: Air: wind wall Earth: stoneskin (protects against 30 pts of damage total) Fire: fire shield Water: fog cloud The defensive effect must be used on the ring wearer's next turn, and lasts for only one round.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, fire shield, fog cloud, stoneskin, protection from energy, wind wall

items.name: Ring of the Favored Archpriest
items.price: 6,000 gp (1st level spell), 12,000 gp (2nd level spell), 17,000 gp (3rd level spell),
items.descriptionText: These rings are identical to a ring of the gifted hierophant, but are usable by clerics with the spontaneous casting ability to exchange a prepared divine spell for a cure or inflict spell of the same level. Each ring allows the spontaneous casting of a single, specific cleric spell from the abjuration, enchantment, conjuration, necromancy or transmutation schools. For example, a 3rd-level ring could be forged to allow a cleric to spontaneously exchange any 3rd-level prepared cleric spell for a daylight spell.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring,, of the spell level to be spontaneously cast, cure wounds (of the level equal to the spell to be spontaneously cast), plus the specific cleric spell to be spontaneously cast (e.g., daylight, etc.)
items.constructionCostText: 3,000 gp (1st level spell), 6,000 gp (2nd level spell), 8,500 gp (3rd level spell)

args.text: of the spell level to be spontaneously cast
cure wounds (of the level equal to the spell to be spontaneously cast)
plus the specific cleric spell to be spontaneously cast (e.g., daylight, etc.)

items.name: Ring of the Gifted Hierophant
items.price: 6,000 gp (1st level spell), 12,000 gp (2nd level spell), 17,000 gp (3rd level spell),
items.descriptionText: These druidic rings carved from hard stone or exotic wood allow any druid with the spontaneous casting ability to channel stored spell energy into not only 112 summoning spells that she hasn't prepared ahead of time, but also a single spell from select schools. Each ring allows the spontaneous casting of a single, specific druid spell from the abjuration, enchantment, conjuration, necromancy or transmutation schools. The specific spontaneous spell is set when the ring is created, and the maximum level spell that can be spontaneously cast is 3rd. The spontaneous spell level must always be the same level as the prepared spell. For example, a 3rd-level ring could be forged to allow a druid to spontaneously exchange any 3rd-level prepared druid spell for a cure moderate wounds spell. A different ring could be forged that allows the spontaneous exchange of any 2nd-level spell for barkskin . These rings do not replace the druid's ability to spontaneously cast summon nature's ally spells – they simply expand it.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, of the spell level to be spontaneously cast, summon nature's ally (of the level equal to the spell to be spontaneously cast), plus the specific druid spell to be spontaneously cast (e.g., cure moderate wounds, etc.)
items.constructionCostText: 3,000 gp (1st level spell), 6,000 gp (2nd level spell), 8,500 gp (3rd level spell)

args.text: of the spell level to be spontaneously cast
summon nature's ally (of the level equal to the spell to be spontaneously cast)
plus the specific druid spell to be spontaneously cast (e.g., cure moderate wounds, etc.)

items.name: Serpent Ring
items.descriptionText: These gold rings are fashioned to resemble a snake devouring its own tail and endow the wearer with some of the aspects of a serpent. The wearer gains a +3 competence bonus to Stealth and Escape Artist checks. The ring also gives the wearer the Scent ability three times per week for one hour, activated as a supernatural ability. As long as the ring is worn, the wearer's tongue becomes forked and his voice takes on a hissing quality. As a result, he suffers a – 2 penalty to Charisma -based skill checks in social situations where he must speak.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, cat's grace, invisibility, serpent strike*

items.name: Ring of Eibon
items.descriptionText: This ring grants the wearer glimpses into the future. Three times per day, as a swift action, the wearer can activate the ring of Eibon to gain a +4 insight bonus to AC and on attack rolls, as well as the benefits of foresight for 1 round.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, foresight

items.name: Rusting Antenna
items.descriptionText: A rusting antenna can be used to make a melee touch attack that causes any non-magical metal object touched to swiftly rust and corrode. The object touched takes half its maximum hp in damage and gains the broken condition—a second hit destroys the item. Using the antenna does not provoke attacks of opportunity . Against creatures made of metal, a rusting antenna deals 3d6+7 points of damage. An attended object or a metal creature can attempt a DC 15 Reflex save to negate this effect. A rusting antenna has only five charges and once expended the antenna withers to dust.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wand, rusting grasp or a removed antenna of a rust monster

args.name: a removed antenna of a rust monster

items.name: Morphic
items.descriptionText: Morphic weapons can create subtle changes to their shape, adding spikes, blunt sections, and edges to better bypass a creature's defenses. A morphic weapon can be used to deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as opposed to the weapon's normal damage type. This does not allow weapon properties that only function for certain damage types to be added to a weapon that is not that type naturally, such as adding vorpal to a bludgeoning weapon.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, greater alter weapon

items.name: Resonant
items.descriptionText: A resonant weapon responds to wielders that are capable of using resonances. When its wielder is using a resonance (either the vanguard himself or his construct companion), the weapon's threat range doubles, and the weapon's enhancement bonus becomes +2 better than normal. This benefit doesn't stack with any other effects that expand the threat range of a weapon (such as the keen edge spell or the Improved Critical feat).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, keen edge, lead blades

items.name: Sundering
items.descriptionText: A sundering weapon is especially effective at breaking inanimate objects. When used to attack an object or when making a sunder attempt, the wielder adds the weapon's enhancement bonus as an additional bonus to attack rolls (this stacks with the attack bonus the enhancement bonus normally provides). The wielder of a sundering weapon does not provoke attacks of opportunity for making sunder attempts if he uses the weapon to do so.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, break

items.name: Vengeful
items.descriptionText: Vengeful weapons strike for increasing power against creatures that harm its wielder. When the wielder takes damage from a creature that he can see, he can declare vengeance upon that foe as a free action . He gains a +1 bonus to damage rolls and critical hit confirmation rolls against that creature. Each round he wields his vengeful weapon, the bonus increases by +1, up to an amount equal to the weapon's enhancement bonus + 3. He can only declare vengeance on one creature at time, and cannot declare vengeance on another target until the target is slain or for 1 hour, whichever comes first.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, vengeful outrage

items.name: Cane of Winter's Shepherd
items.descriptionText: This long white shepherd's crook is bound in a band of red and functions as a +1 staff though its bearer gains several additional benefits. First, their breath is always minty fresh, and they can cast purify food and drink and neutralize poison three times per day. Not only is the food or beverage made perfectly edible, but they also gain a slight mint flavoring.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, purify food and drink, neutralize poison

items.name: Dagger of the Winter Wonderland
items.descriptionText: This strange poniard resembles a carrot perpetually glazed in frost. It functions as a +1 dagger but allows the bearer to cast dimension door once per day provided they are standing on a patch of snow and reappear on a patch of snow within 360 ft. In addition, the bearer receives a +2- enhancement bonus to all saving throws made against any cold effects or damage.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dimension door, endure elements

items.name: Deflecting Scimitar
items.descriptionText: While wielding this +3 training scimitar you gain the benefit of the Deflect Arrows feat.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic weapon

items.name: Frost Fang
items.price: 36,002 gp Alignment: LG Ability Scores: Int 18 Wis 10 Cha 14
items.descriptionText: This +1 frost dagger glows with a frosty blue light, and ice crystals form along the edge of the blade. While wielding frost fang you are immune to cold damage. In addition, you may cast snowball from the dagger up to three times per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, chill metal or ice storm, resist energy, snowball

items.name: Blade of the Bloodthirsty
items.descriptionText: This +2 keen blood iron falchion has a handguard on its hilt that points towards the blade, giving the appearance like a ring of jagged teeth like the mouth of a leech. As a move action, the wielder of a blade of the bloodthirsty can will the weapon into a new form, transforming it into any weapon in the axe, heavy blade, or light blade category (see the fighter's advanced weapon training class feature) that the wielder is proficient in. In addition, the whenever the wielder would deal bleed damage due to an attack originating from the blade of the bloodthirsty, the bleed damage increases by the weapon's enhancement bonus . Finally, whenever the blade of the bloodthirsty successfully confirms a critical hit, it repairs 10 HP to itself as the blood of its victims is used to undo wear and imperfections; most blades of the bloodthirsty look impeccably-sharp and in excellent condition regardless of their age or the brutality of their purpose.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bleed, major creation, vampiric touch

items.name: Ice Blade
items.descriptionText: This +1 longsword inspires awe for its artistic vision and mystical ingenuity. The weapon's original creator sculpted the blade from solid ice, and forged its pommel, grip, and cross guard from cold iron. Despite being crafted from solid ice, the blade feels cool, but not cold to the touch. Nonetheless, the ice blade remains frozen even when it is subjected to warm temperatures for a prolonged period or to fire damage from spells and effects. The sword's magical effects manifest only when it strikes specific types of creatures. When the weapon hits a creature with the fire subtype, in addition to the attack's normal damage, the target is also fatigued and sickened for 1 round. If the creature is already fatigued or sickened, it does not become exhausted or nauseated . When the weapon hits a creature with the water subtype, in addition to the attack's normal damage, the target is slowed (as the slow spell) for 1 round.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, wall of ice

items.name: Jarl's Axe
items.descriptionText: The rulers of humanoid settlements plagued by frost giant and troll attacks bequeath this valuable +1 battleaxe to their descendants; thus, many of these weapons have been in the same families for centuries. Weaponsmiths construct the weapon's haft from orca or whalebone and the blade from steel. When the weapon hits a humanoid vulnerable to fire or a humanoid such as a troll with the regeneration extraordinary ability that cannot regenerate when it takes fire damage, the blade instantly ignites and momentarily glows bright orange. The battleaxe's flames deal 2d6 points of fire damage to such humanoids on a successful hit in addition to the weapon's normal damage. Furthermore, the creature struck believes it is on fire, causing it to spend a full-round action on its next turn attempting to douse the imaginary flames unless it succeeds on a DC 16 Will save to disbelieve the illusory effect. Multiple hits in the same round overlap, but do not stack. A creature who successfully disbelieves this illusion is immune to the illusion for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shadow evocation

items.name: Haneken
items.descriptionText: This unnaturally light katana has a length of 51 inches, from sword tip to pommel. Its pommel and collar are gold and its hilt is wrapped with red silk. Fine feathers are etched along the length of the blade. Haneken functions as a +2 katana which, because of its light weight, may be used in conjunction with Weapon Finesse . So long as you grip Haneken's hilt, you gain a +10 bonus to all Acrobatic checks made to jump and are considered to be under the effects of feather fall .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, feather fall

items.name: Kurodeba
items.descriptionText: Kurodeba measures 27 inches long, with a 19- inch, single-edged blade of black steel and a full tang. The sword's collar, guard and buttcap are fashioned from the same black steel as the blade and the wooden handle is wrapped with cords of black silk. Kurodeba functions as a +2 wakizashi which, when gripped, also grants its user a +1 dodge bonus to AC and an additional +2 bonus when confirming critical hits.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace, keen

items.name: Critical Potential [Magic Weapon Special Ability]
items.descriptionText: A critical potential weapon allows its wielder to gain sudden bursts of arcane potential when they land a critical hit . If the weapon's critical modifier is x2 they gain 1 point, if it's x3 they gain 2 points, and if it's x4 they gain 3 points. The wielder can only gain potential from this ability once per round.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, greater magic weapon

items.name: Mirrored Weapons
items.descriptionText: Mirrored is a new type of magic weapon enhancement that does not increase the item's effective magical bonus and only modifies the base price, which is tied to the associated spell-like ability the weapon grants. Mirrored enchantments can only be placed on weapons with an enhancement bonus of +2 or greater, and no weapon may possess more than one Mirrored enchantment. This enchantment can never be placed on an intelligent item. A Mirrored weapon appears as though it were made of an extremely reflective substance and is always cold iron at its core, but does not initially qualify as a cold iron weapon for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. Upon creation the Mirrored weapon has a minimum of 26 charges (a number that goes up by 13 per additional +1 enhancement bonus past +2) and each time the spell-like ability of the weapon is triggered it loses one charge. For every thirteen charges lost by a Mirrored weapon, reduce its enhancement bonus by +1. For determining costs, treat this enchantment as though it were a ring of the ram or similar item incorporated into the weapon itself using the rules for magic item creation in the Pathfinder® Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook™ (PZO1110) . After any reduction in enhancement bonus through this method, the weapon now counts as cold iron for purposes of overcoming damage reduction (as the weapon's core becomes partially revealed). When there are no more charges it ceases to be magical and becomes a plain masterwork cold iron weapon. Any found Mirrored weapon has 17+1d8 charges remaining. When two characters wielding Mirrored weapons strike them against one another (simultaneous swift actions) they may activate their weapon's spell-like abilities without depleting a charge. This is the only way to activate a Mirrored enchantment by command – every Mirrored enchantment has its own unique activation trigger (see the Mirrored Club or Mirrored Spear ), but these are never by command and always deplete a charge. If the related spell-like ability grants a touch attack or other spell effect dependent on a successful to-hit roll, the weapon stores its spell-like ability as though it had the spell-storing weapon enchantment until the spell effect is discharged with a successful hit. Additionally, adjacent characters wielding Mirrored weapons receive a +1 morale bonus to attack and damage for every Mirrored weapon wielded by an ally within 5 feet (this bonus can never exceed a benefactor's base attack bonus). Other products written by Mike Myler: The Clockwork Wonders of Brandlehill, Magical Armament Compendium: Volume I, Web of the Spider Baron (published by Avalon Games), Scepter of Perpetual Sacrifice (published by LPJ Design).

items.name: Mechanical Arm
items.descriptionText: This metallic arm looks as if it was removed from a living construct . It is crafted of many different metals and seems intricately designed. The arm increases strength and agility. You gain an competence bonus to both Strength related and Dexterity related skill checks of +2, +4, or +6. This bonus applies only to skill checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, animate objects, bull's strength, cat's grace, must have at least 5 ranks in Knowledge (engineering)

items.name: Mechanical Legs
items.descriptionText: These sleek metallic legs look something like the lower half of some alien full plate armor. They aid in speed and jumping. The legs increase the wearer's base land speed by 10 feet as an enhancement bonus . In addition, they grant a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, animate objects, longstrider, must have at least 5 ranks in Knowledge (engineering)

items.name: Reaver's Net
items.descriptionText: This magical net is made from supple green cords of specially treated seaweed. The cords are studded with tiny suckers, hooks, and tendrils that constantly seethe and roil as if the net were underwater. A reaver's net functions as a +1 net for all users. Its powers truly awaken when its wielder has the Weapon Specialization (net) feat, at least 7 ranks in Profession (sailor), or at least 1 level of the sea reaver prestige class . In the hands of such a wielder the net takes on a life of its own, functioning as a +1 net of distance . Additionally, any creature entangled by the net must make a Fortitude save ( DC 14) each round the entanglement persists to avoid being paralyzed for 3d6 minutes. The semi-living nature of the net allows the trained user to refold the net for proper throwing as a move action .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, clairaudience/clairvoyance, entangle, hold person

items.name: Tooth of the Narwhal
items.descriptionText: This +3 rapier, when used on the open sea or within 100 feet of the coast, grants its wielder the use of the Combat Expertise feat and deals +1d6 points of bonus damage.
items.constructionRequirementsText: divine power or caster must be druid level 7th+

args.text: caster must be druid level 7th+

items.name: Ring of Corruption
items.descriptionText: This simple silver ring is set with a small ruby at its center. On the inside of the ring is a tiny mark, which can be identified as the mark of corruption in the infernal language with a DC 20 Linguistics check. This ring is a cursed item. The ring provides a +1 deflection bonus to anyone wearing it, but they soon find that the ring cannot be removed. Each day, the wearer must make a DC 15 Will save or suffer terribly dreams that evening. If the wearer every fails three such saves in a row, he finds that he is overcome with a foul mood and dark desires. His alignment shifts one step toward Lawful Evil, first moving from Chaotic to Neutral and then Lawful, followed by Good to Neutral and finally Evil. This shift is permanent so long as the ring is worn. Those who know the wearer can make a DC 20 Sense Motive skill check to notice subtle changes in the wearer's behavior, such as rigid new grooming habits, a desire for order in all things, and a lack of empathy for other living creatures. The ring can only be removed after a successful remove curse or by cutting off the digit that bears the ring. These foul rings are frequently made by the servants of Asmodeus and given as gifts to noble rulers or left to be found by foolish interlopers.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Magic Items Ring of Protection

items.name: Gaki Helm
items.descriptionText: This lavish, red kabuto helmet, when worn, allows the user to command ghouls, as with command undead . However, the helmet is actually inhabited by a malevolent spirit which seeks to control and defile the user. When worn, the user must succeed at a DC 17 Will save to avoid being possessed by the spirit. Success allows the user to utilize the helmet without harm for 24 hours. Failure means that the user is possessed by the spirit and loses his own free will. While possessed, the victim's alignment is CE, gains Scent, Climb 30 ft., Str +2, Dex +4, Int +2, Wis, +4, Cha +2, and can speak Infernal. The possessing spirit has access to all of the character's memories, and uses the victim to murder and eat other individuals. Only one character may be possessed in this way at a time, and if the helmet is possessing an individual, no other character may benefit from the ability to command ghouls . If the victim is slain before being cured, the spirit returns to the helmet, but the victim rises after 1d6 hours as a dread ghoul . CREATION A Gaki Helm is created when a samurai warrior dies after having eaten his own comrades. The spirit of the warrior haunts his own helmet. CURE Protection from evil, cast on the victim, grants the victim a reprieve from the possessing spirit for the length of the spell. To fully cure a victim it is necessary to cast protection from evil, atonement, and remove curse (DC 25) in conjunction with one another. The helmet may be destroyed through the use of break enchantment and remove curse .

items.name: The Golden Omamori of the Bamboo Mountain Spirit
items.descriptionText: A thin rectangle of gold, one inch wide and two inches long, The Golden Omamori of the Bamboo Mountain Spirit is emblazoned with runes of fortune and has a small hole near its top so that it might be hung from a belt, tied to weapon, or even worn about the neck. Any character who carries the omamori upon his person benefits from a +1 bonus to all d20 rolls. However, all characters within 100 feet of the omamori, including the bearer, must succeed at a DC 5 Will save or be compelled, as with suggestion, to engage in an act of violence by making a melee or ranged attack which will, if successful, deal damage against the first individual to insult, slight or harm them. Those who successfully make their save are immune to the effects of the talisman for 24 hours. Those who fail their save and subsequently engage in an act of violence are allowed make a new Will save to be free of the compulsion . Failure indicates that they are compelled to attack the next individual to insult, slight or harm them. This continues until the affected person at last makes his Will save, or he himself is slain. If the wearer of the omamori engages in any violent or greedy activity, the DC of this Will save is increased by 1 for each such act. The bearer of the omamori, once it is worn, will not willingly part with the talisman, and if the talisman is forcefully removed from the bearer, will seek to regain it, using whatever means necessary. If the bearer of the omamori is slain, the DC of the Will save resets to 5. CURE To be free of the talisman, the bearer must submit to an atonement spell, cast in conjunction with a successful remove curse (DC 26). Once the bearer is free of the omamori, the DC of the Will save resets to 5.

items.name: Barbed
items.descriptionText: A suit of armor or shield must have armor spikes (or shield spikes) before it can be given the barbed property. Armor spikes and shield spikes on barbed equipment deal damage as if one size category larger (this stacks with the size bonus shield spikes already give to a shield's damage). In addition, the wearer of barbed armor can add the armor's enhancement bonus to AC as a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the armor spikes as if it were a weapon enhancement bonus . The same applies for adding a shield's enhancement bonus to AC to attack and damage rolls made with the shield as if it were a weapon enhancement bonus.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, spikes

items.name: Donning
items.descriptionText: A donning suit of armor or shield can be teleported to its owner as a swift action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, even if the equipment is in the possession of another creature. A suit of armor equips itself to the owner neatly and properly, while a shield is strapped to the owner's arm. If the owner is already wearing similar equipment, the donning equipment teleports to the owner's feet in his space. This ability has a maximum range of 100 feet, and effects that block teleportation prevent the equipping of donning armor. Donning equipment must be in a creature's possession for at least 24 hours for this ability to function.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, squire's aid

items.name: Resilient
items.descriptionText: Resilient armor and shields slowly repair themselves over time. They regain lost hit points at a rate of 2 hit points per hour (or 1 hit point if the equipment has the broken condition). In addition, once per day when a resilient suit of armor or shield would be reduced to 0 hit points and destroyed (or destroyed outright by effects like disintegrate ), it is instead reduced to only 1 hit point and left with the broken condition.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mending, tempering

items.name: Potential Amplifying [Armor Ability]
items.descriptionText: A wearer with the arcane potential class feature gains a single point of potential at the beginning of each of their turns while in combat. This arcane potential must be spent before the beginning of their next turn or it is lost.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic vestment

items.name: Glacial Shield
items.descriptionText: This +2 light shield is made from compacted ice and snow, giving it a bluish-white hue. The shield weighs less than its steel and wooden counterparts. It still imposes a 5% arcane spell failure chance, but has no armor check penalty. The shield deflects incoming fire-based attacks. Each ranged fire-based attack directed at the shield's wielder for which the attacker must make an attack roll has a 50% miss chance. The wielder must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed, helpless, or otherwise unable to act.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, resist energy

items.name: Musk Ox Hide
items.descriptionText: Coarse, wiry hair gives this +2 hide armor made from musk ox hide its shaggy appearance. The wearer of this armor gains cold resistance 5. On command, the armor emits a pungent musk some creatures find unpleasant. Humanoids ending their movement within 5 feet of the wearer must succeed on a DC 14 Fortitude save or be sickened for 1 round. (The wearer is immune to this effect.) A humanoid who succeeds at his saving throw is immune to the effect from this set of armor for 24 hours. The wearer can suppress and reactivate the musk effect as a standard action . Creatures immune to poison are immune to this effect.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ghoul touch, resist energy

items.name: Walrus Hide
items.descriptionText: This +2 hide armor is made from walrus hide. In addition to granting a +2 enhancement bonus to AC and a –2 armor check penalty attributable to its added bulk, the thick, blubbery skin absorbs blows from bludgeoning weapons and gives its wearer damage reduction of 2/piercing or slashing. Likewise, the wearer takes only half damage from constriction, falling, and being buried as well as similar crushing effects. Furthermore, on command as a standard action, walrus hide merges with the wearer, transforming him into a walrus as if using beast shape II . The wearer can remain in walrus form for 10 minutes. This duration need not be consecutive, but must be used in 1-minute increments.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, beast shape II

items.name: Wolverine Leather
items.descriptionText: Barbarians seek out this set of +2 studded leather made from wolverine skin. Even death and the enchantments used to construct this armor cannot soothe the animal's foul temperament. If the wearer is a barbarian or another class with the rage class feature, the wearer can use the animal fury and scent rage powers whenever he rages. Whenever an enemy confirms a critical hit against the wearer, the wolverine's anger roils to the surface. The wearer involuntarily enters a rage as an immediate action (provided he would normally be able to rage). This consumes 2 rounds of the barbarian's daily allotment of rage rounds, but the wearer maintains the rage each round on his turn normally. Any benefits from the rage apply immediately, so the morale bonus to Constitution grants the wearer additional hit points, which may prevent the wearer from falling unconscious or dying from the critical hit . The barbarian cannot end the rage voluntarily. He continues raging until he or the opponent who confirmed the critical hit dies. If the wearer is already raging when an opponent confirms a critical hit against him, the wearer does not enter a new rage as an immediate action, but must continue raging as previously described.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, rage

items.name: Glamered Plate
items.descriptionText: Woven of a distilled essence made from stories of warriors dodging deadly blows, this cloth tunic protects its wearer as well as +3 full plate, but does not hinder his movements or skills (the wearers movement is not reduced and he suffers no armor check penalties).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, glory of the faithful

items.name: Golem Armor
items.descriptionText: These elite warriors are easily identified by their elaborate golem armor. Members of the guard serve for life, and the articulated plates of dull crystalline mineral are permanently bonded to their flesh with an invasive surgical procedure requiring 48 hours and three consecutive DC 25 Heal checks. If one check fails, the procedure can be started over, but if two consecutive skill checks are failed, the candidate is deemed unfit for service and executed by incineration. Removing the armor requires 24 hours and requires three consecutive DC 25 Heal checks, with each failed check dealing 2d10 points of damage, 1d4 points of Strength and Dexterity damage, and 1d4 points of bleed damage. Each time golem armor is removed, it becomes hard to reapply in the future, increasing the DC of future Heal checks by 2. When properly applied, golem armor provides the wearer with +9 armor bonus to AC and is considered light armor, with no armor check penalty and a maximum Dexterity modifier to AC of +6, and all golem armor has at least a +1 enhancement bonus, and can be further enchanted like any magic armor. The wearer also gains DR 5/ adamantine . In addition to its protective qualities, golem armor is fitted with two evenly balanced foot-long fistblades protruding from each forearm and over the knuckles in a slight arch. These blades grant have a +1 enhancement bonus and are considered light weapons, dealing 1d8 points of piercing damage per hit with a x3 critical multiplier. The wearer can use either or both blades to attack, can attack with one while using the other defensively as a +1 light steel shield; if the wielder uses both blades defensively, the shield bonus to AC provided by the blades is increased by 2. The fist-blades can be separately enchanted with additional enhancement bonuses or weapon properties, and their shield function can be separately enchanted as well. A creature wearing golem armor cannot wear any other armor or wield any other kind of shield or weapon, and its manual dexterity is greatly hampered, resulting in a -10 penalty on Disable Device or Sleight of Hand checks, or any other skill or ability check requiring fine manipulation.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Construct, animate objects, stoneskin

items.name: Magi's Overcoat
items.descriptionText: This +1 potential amplifying armored coat is incredibly light and finely crafted, appearing to casual observation as nothing more than a plain black overcoat. It has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +6, an armor check penalty of 0, and an arcane spell failure chance of 10%. It is considered light armor, and does not hinder its wearer's movement speed. As a full-round action the overcoat can be turned inside out, causing its physical appearance to change to match its wearer's desires; however, the overcoat always resembles a long coat of some type. This ability allows the coat to grant its wearer a +2 circumstance bonus on Disguise checks if the coat is used as part of the disguise, or to Stealth checks made to hide in a crowd if the coat is changed to resemble typical outerwear of other creatures in the crowd.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, magic vestment

items.name: Vambrace of Pain
items.descriptionText: This sleek bracer is made of a dull black metal and is thin enough to be easily and comfortable worn under clothing. Its entire surface is carved with faintly visible necromantic runes. A living creature who wears this vambrace can activate it as a swift action, causing them to be affected by inflict light wounds . The creature wearing the vambrace can choose to forgo the Will saving throw to halve the damage if they wish. At the beginning of each of the wearer's turns, until the vambrace is deactivated using another swift action, the wearer is affected by inflict light wounds . If the wearer is helpless or willing, another creature can activate or deactivate the bracers as a full-round action . The damage dealt by this item cannot be prevented, and it does not affect undead creatures or creatures who would normally be healed by negative energy. The vambrace of pain was originally designed by a cleric who wished to explore positive-energy aligned planes without the risk of dying from overexposure to positive energy, but the design has since been used for more nefarious purposes. Many magi have discovered a more niche use for this intriguing item, allowing them to take continuous magical damage to fuel their arcane potential.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Item, inflict light wounds

items.name: Angelic Brass Breastplate
items.descriptionText: These polished brass and mithral alloy ("orichalcum") breastplates were forged by angels and the secret of their making is known by few. They are beautifully etched, intricate, and exceptionally light, yet incredibly strong. Speed while wearing an angelic brass breastplate is 30 feet for Medium creatures, or 20 feet for Small ones. The armor has an arcane spell failure chance of 20%, a maximum Dexterity bonus of +4, and an armor check penalty of –2. It is considered light armor and weighs 15 pounds. Each breastplate has a unique power that it bestows upon a good-aligned wearer, allowing them to use it once per day as a supernatural ability, as a 7th level caster. These powers include one of the following: bless feather fall protection from evil
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bless, feather fall, protection from evil

items.name: Angelic Brass War Helm
items.descriptionText: Angelic brass war helms resemble polished brass and mithral alloy ("orichalcum") versions of knight helms, crested Spartan helmets, or winged Norse helmets. The helm provides good-aligned wearers with a +1 deflection bonus to armor class and a +2 bonus on saves vs. gaze attacks, blinding and deafening attacks, sonic attacks, and fear effects.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, mage armor (or shield of faith ), remove blindness-deafness, remove fear, resistance

items.name: Armor of Fiery Retribution
items.weight: as masterwork armor of the appropriate type.
items.descriptionText: Whenever the wearer of this armor suffers a critical hit from a metal melee weapon (or metal creature such as an iron golem ), it instantly casts heat metal on the attacker at caster level 9 ( Will DC 18 negates).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, heat metal

items.name: Black Mamba Scale Armor
items.descriptionText: This armor is made from the scales of dire deadly black mambas. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor . As a free action, the wearer can activate the armor's special abilities, allowing him to move faster for up to 10 rounds each day. Activating this ability increases the wearer's base land speed by 5 ft. In addition, when running, the wearer moves five times his normal speed (if wearing Medium, light, or no armor and carrying no more than a Medium load) or four times his speed (if wearing heavy armor or carrying a heavy load).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, expeditious retreat, haste

items.name: Cobra Scale Armor
items.descriptionText: This armor is made from the scales of dire deadly king cobras. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to Stealth and Intimidate checks and the ability to cast cause fear ( caster level 7, Will DC 14) against one opponent within 10 ft, once per day, as a supernatural ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cause fear, invisibility, silence

items.name: Phoenixfire Leather Armor
items.descriptionText: This dull black masterwork leather armor is embossed with the image of a phoenix with its wings flared. The armor provides fire resistance 5. When the wearer suffers a critical hit from an opponent within 5 ft., the armor unleashes a flash of fire at the assailant, inflicting 2d6 points of fire damage ( Reflex DC 15 for half damage). Last, if the wearer of the armor is good aligned and goes below -5 hit points, the armor casts a cure light wounds spell upon him the next round, as if cast by a 4th level cleric (1d8+4 hp). This miraculous healing only functions once, after which the armor permanently loses the ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cure light wounds, fire shield, resist energy

items.name: Python Scale Armor
items.descriptionText: This armor is made from the scales of huge pythons. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and Intimidate checks, and a +2 enhancement bonus to CMB / CMD when grappling .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull's strength, scare

items.name: Rattlesnake Scale Armor
items.descriptionText: This armor is made from the scales of huge rattlesnakes. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus on saves vs. poison, a +2 enhancement bonus on Stealth checks and the ability to cast cause fear ( caster level 7, Will DC 14) against one opponent within 5 ft., once per day, as a supernatural ability.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cause fear, delay poison, invisibility, silence

items.name: Viper Scale Armor
items.descriptionText: This armor is made from the scales of huge vipers. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus on saves vs. poison and a +2 enhancement bonus to Stealth, Intimidate and Perception checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, delay poison, invisibility, silence

items.name: Panchromatic Armor
items.descriptionText: This suit of +5 full plate normally has a shimmering, multicolored surface. The user can concentrate as a standard action to change its color to one of those listed below to gain perfect protection against one energy type or effect, losing the +5 enhancement bonus of the plate armor while it manifests that color. This effect lasts until the armor is removed or the wearer changes the color once more. Color Benefit All +5 enhancement bonus Black Immunity to energy drain White Immunity to petrification and non-harmless polymorph effects Red Immunity to fire Orange Immunity to electricity Yellow Immunity to light-based attacks and prismatic effects Green Immunity to poison Blue Immunity to damage from water-based attacks and wearer does not need to breathe Indigo Immunity to death magic and effects Violet Immunity to cold Many (but not all) suits of panchromatic armor are designed for the use of serpent folk, and thus may not fit other creatures well.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, death ward, prismatic sphere

items.name: Crystal Mote
items.descriptionText: A crystal mote is a moment of time stolen and shaped into a +1 cunning impervious time-displaced warhammer . In the hands of a chronothurge, the crystal mote's enhancement bonus increases by +1 for every 4 chronothurge class levels she possesses, to a maximum of +5. When wielded by a chronothurge, a crystal mote provides spell resistance of 5 + the wielder's total chronothurge class levels to the wielder and anyone adjacent to her. Once per day, the chronothurge can release the crystal mote as a free action to regain 1 aevum.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, time stop

items.name: Time-Displaced Weapon
items.descriptionText: A time-displaced weapon bonds to its wielder after 24 hours. Once bonded, it can be drawn as a free action and released as either a free action, a standard action, or a full-round action. When released, the weapon is immediately drawn by the wielder's future self the next time they would draw it; it ceases to exist in the current time and cannot be grabbed or wielded by another creature except during a time stop . If the weapon is released as a standard action, the wielder also gains the benefit of an augury spell as if it were cast for them, and the next time they draw the weapon, they gain a true strike effect as if the spell were cast for them. The wielder must ask their question of augury as they release the weapon. If the weapon is released as a full-round action, the wielder also gains the benefit of a time stop spell as if it were cast for them. Once the wielder has gained either benefit of releasing their sword, they cannot gain that benefit again until they rest for at least eight hours. A wielder with a temporal pool can spend 2 motes of time as they release the weapon to regain the standard action ability before they rest. A wielder with at least 1 aevum can spend 1 aevum to regain the full-round action ability before they rest.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, augury, time stop, true strike

items.name: Defender's Tower
items.descriptionText: This +2 donning tower shield can be used to create a wall to protect allies. By placing the tower shield upright and speaking a command word, the tower shield transforms into a solid barrier, as a conjure barricade spell (DC 13) adjacent to the user. The effect lasts for 5 minutes or until either the same command word is given or the donning ability is used, at which point it reverts to its normal shape (when using the donning ability, the shield reverts to its normal shape before being equipped to its owner).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, alter weapon, conjure barricade, squire's aid

items.name: Marksman's Bane
items.descriptionText: Created to defend both its wearer and allies from incoming ranged weapons, this +2 arrow catching arrow deflection heavy steel shield intercepts arrows from a wider area; its arrow catching property functions on any ranged attacks made within 10 feet, instead of 5 feet. Once per day as an immediate action the wearer can reflect all ranged weapons back to their sources, as the spell repel projectiles . This effect also repels projectiles that were redirected to the wielder by the shield's arrow catching property.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, shield, repel projectiles

items.name: Penumbral Ward
items.descriptionText: Made by denizens of the night to withstand the light of day, this lightweight, translucent shield appears to be made entirely out of darkness. The penumbral ward functions as a +2 ghost touch gloom light steel shield. A creature bearing the shield gains the effect of a constant protective penumbra spell.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, etherealness, protective penumbra

items.name: Lion Shield
items.descriptionText: A specially crafted +3 heavy wooden shield, the Lion Shield can also be loosed to attack on its own. It fights for 4 rounds using the base attack bonus of the one who loosed it and then drops. For combat purposes, the Lion Shield is treated as having a 2d6 damage bite attack with the grab universal monster ability (its CMB equals the CMB of the wielder). While attacking, it cannot make attacks of opportunity, and the person who activated it is not considered as having the shield equipped. The shield is considered wielded or attended by the creature for all maneuvers and effects that target items. While attacking, the shield shares the same space as the activating character and can attack adjacent foes. The shield accompanies the person who activated it everywhere, whether she moves by physical or magical means. If the wielder who loosed it has an unoccupied hand, she can grasp it while it is attacking on its own as a free action; when so retrieved, the shield can't dance (attack on its own) again for 4 rounds.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, animate objects

items.name: Amaranthine Shield
items.weight: as a masterwork shield of the appropriate type.
items.descriptionText: One time per day, when the bearer of an amaranthine shield is affected by death spells, magical death effects, energy drain, and any negative energy effects, the shield instantly protects him as if he were under the effect of a death ward spell.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, death ward

items.name: Fiery Dragon
items.descriptionText: This tattoo is most often rendered with a red dragon entwined around the chest and shoulders. The tattoo's owner gains the following: 2/day: Breathe a 20 ft. cone of fire, doing 5d6 points of damage (DC 16 Reflex for half).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, fireball

items.name: Hidden Sword
items.descriptionText: This tattoo is most often rendered with the image of a weapon on the inside wrist of the user. To create this tattoo, the spellcaster needs access to an actual weapon, and the weapon is then melded to the tattoo, so that it is carried, weightlessly, in the tattoo. A weapon carried in this way may be "drawn" as a free action and "sheathed" at will within the tattoo. Once the weapon for the tattoo is chosen, it cannot be changed without dispelling the tattoo first, though a different weapon can be "sheathed" in this way on each arm and additional weapons can be added to the same hand for twice the cost of the original tattoo.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, secret chest

items.name: Mistwalker
items.descriptionText: This tattoo is most often rendered with the large image of a woman, the bottom half of which is misty and ghost-like, inked onto the back of the user. The tattoo's owner gains the following: 2/day: Cause their form to shift and waver for 5 minutes (as blur .) 1/day: Assume gaseous form (as gaseous form ) for five minutes.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, blur, gaseous form

items.name: Oni
items.descriptionText: This tattoo is most often rendered with the image of a red-skinned oni on one arm. The tattoo's owner gains the following: Continual: fire resistance 10 2/day: Gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for 5 minutes each time.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, bull's strength, resist energy

items.name: Phoenix
items.descriptionText: This powerful tattoo is most often rendered with the large image of a phoenix, inked onto the back of the user. One time per day when the wearer is brought below 0 hit points, he does not die, but instead, 1 round later, is fully healed (as heal .)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, heal

items.name: Quick Fox
items.descriptionText: This tattoo is most often rendered with a fox, resting on the chest and shoulders. The tattoo's owner gains the following continual benefits: +2 enhancement bonus to Initiative +4 bonus to all Perception checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, cat's grace, owl's wisdom

items.name: Shy Maiden
items.descriptionText: This tattoo is most often rendered with the large image of a woman inked onto the upper back of the user. The tattoo's owner gains the following: Continual: +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma At will: Assume the form of any Small or Medium woman (as alter self .)
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, alter self, eagle's splendor

items.name: Storm
items.descriptionText: This tattoo is most often rendered with the image of a storm cloud and lightning on one arm and shoulder. The tattoo's owner gains the following: Continual: electricity resistance 10 3/day: lightning bolt (5d6 damage, Reflex DC 16).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Craft Wondrous Tattoo, lightning bolt, resist energy

items.name: Ring of Climbing (Flawed Ring)
items.descriptionText: This rough leather cord wraps around the wearer's finger. EFFECTS This ring enhances the wearer's ability to climb, continually granting the wearer +2 competence bonus to Climb checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Ring Apprentice

items.name: Ring of Feather Falling (Flawed Ring)
items.descriptionText: This ring is crafted with a rough approximation of feathers around its edge. EFFECTS Automatically starting the moment the wearer falls more than five feet, this ring slows the wearer's fall, ignoring the first 10 feet fallen, and converting the damage from the second 10 feet to non-lethal damage.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Ring Apprentice, feather fall

items.name: Ring of Jumping (Flawed Ring)
items.descriptionText: This simple ring is roughly made with visible notches. EFFECTS This ring notably improves the wearer's ability to leap, providing a +2 competence bonus on all his Acrobatics checks to perform high or long jumps.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Ring Apprentice

items.name: Ring of Protection (Flawed Ring)
items.descriptionText: This simple metal band is somewhat heavy. EFFECTS This ring provides partial magical protection. Twice per day, the wearer may activate the ring's protection to gain a +1 deflection bonus to AC for one minute.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Ring Apprentice, shield other

items.name: Ring of Spell Knowledge (Flawed Ring)
items.descriptionText: This simple ring possesses arcane etchings. EFFECTS This ring is capable of storing a pair of 0-level arcane spells, allowing the wearer to gain knowledge of them through study. The ring is only a storage space; requiring the wearer to see or be affected by a written, active, or cast version of the spell and succeed at a DC 14 Spellcraft check to teach the spell to the ring. Thereafter, the arcane spellcaster may cast the spell as though she knew it, and it appeared on her class' spell list.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Ring Apprentice

items.name: Ring of Sustenance (Flawed Ring)
items.descriptionText: This plain, roughly hewn ring bears a few flaws and cracks. EFFECTS This ring bolsters the wearer's body's ability to make the best out of any available food and water. The wearer no longer needs the normal amount of food, having to consume only a handful of simple food once per day, and needing only a small amount of water daily to survive. The spell also refreshes the wearer's mind and body reducing the amount of sleep required to 4 hours. This allows a spellcaster that requires rest to prepare spells to do so after only 4 hours, but this does not allow a spellcaster to prepare spells more than once per day. The ring must be worn for a full week before it begins to work. If it is removed, the owner must wear it for another week to re- attune it to himself.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Ring Apprentice, goodberry, create water

items.name: Ring of Swimming (Flawed Ring)
items.descriptionText: Rough outlines of fishlike patterns are etched into this simple silver band. EFFECTS This ring enhances the wearer's swimming ability, continually granting the wearer a +2 competence bonus to Swim checks.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Ring Apprentice

items.name: Brawler's Ring (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This ring seems hewn from a single piece of unpolished granite. EFFECTS A brawler's ring enhances the wearer's ability to deliver devastating blows in combat. Twice per day the ring can be activated, immediately transforming the wearer's hands into living stone. While so affected, the wearer's unarmed strikes do not provoke attacks of opportunity and deal 1d6 points of lethal bludgeoning damage (1d4 if Small). If the wearer possesses the unarmed strike class feature or the Improved Unarmed Strike feat, the damage increases to 1d8 (1d6 if Small), and the wearer's strikes additionally ignore the hardness of any object with a hardness less than 8. This effect last for one minute, each time it is used.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, stone fist

items.name: Hunter's Ring (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This simple ring's green center stone seems to have flecks of blood red within it. EFFECTS When the blood of a creature is dropped on a hunter's ring's gemstone the liquid is quickly absorbed as the red flecks seem to swirl around almost as if tasting it. Once activated, the ring grants the wearer a +1 competence bonus to Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against creatures sharing the same type as the blood's source.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, instant enemy

items.name: Ioun Ring (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: A simple and elegant ring, with an empty mounting spot for a stone. The setting appears to be malleable enough that any small gemstone can be mounted. EFFECTS Placing an ioun stone of any shape into the ring's setting, causes it to slightly alter in shape perfectly accommodating the gem as if made just for it. Any ioun stone mounted within an ioun ring, continues to provide its benefits to the wearer as if orbiting his head, however the ring and stone register to detect spells as non-magical. Once mounted, an Ioun stone cannot be removed without destroying the ioun stone and ring.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, magic

items.name: Lantern Ring (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This highly polished silver ring features a tiny bullseye lantern mounting, with a clear cabochon stone at its center. The stone set within seems to catch the light, glittering in spectacular fashion. EFFECTS As a free action the ring can be commanded to glow as a torch . Three times per day the ring may be commanded to emanate light as a bullseye lantern . This effect lasts for an hour. Once per day, the ring can unleash a brilliant burst of light focused on a single target within 30 feet as a flare spell. The target is dazzled for 1 minute unless it succeeds at a DC 11 Reflex save.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, light, flare

items.name: Purifying Ring (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This clear crystal band has a verdant strand of moss running through its center. EFFECTS This ring provides protection to its wearer. When created, a purifying ring possesses 10 charges. Touching any spoiled, rotten, diseased, poisonous, or otherwise contaminated food or water with the hand wearing this ring, automatically expends a charge, affecting it as if casting purify food and drink, making it fit for consumption. When all 10 charges are consumed, the ring crumbles to dust.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, purify food and drink

items.name: Ring of Desperate Defense (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This heavy ring is made of solid steel and etched with outlines reminiscent of heraldry. EFFECTS Once per day, as an immediate action, the ring can be activated to protect the wearer. Upon activation, the ring immediately creates a shimmering suit of chainmail, perfectly fitted, out of opaque force. This armor acts in all ways as masterwork armor of its type (with all attendant bonuses and penalties) and lasts for 3 minutes, after which it dissipates. The wearer suffers any penalties for wearing armor with which they are not proficient. Because the armor is comprised entirely of force, it has the added bonus of protecting the wearer from the attacks of corporeal opponents.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, instant armor

items.name: Ring of Forceful Strikes (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This ring vibrates slightly, when closely observed. EFFECTS A ring of forceful strikes continually absorbs portions of the kinetic energy generated by the normal movement of its wearer's hand over the course of their daily activities, converting it to raw stored force energy. A ring of forceful strikes has 3 charges. After 8 hours of rest, any expended charges are recovered, resetting the total charges to 3. 1 charge: One unarmed strike the ring wearer makes deals lethal damage instead of non-lethal plus an additional 1d4 + Strength bonus points of force damage. 2 charges: Unarmed strikes the ring wearer makes in one round deal lethal damage instead of non-lethal plus an additional 1d4 + Strength bonus points of force damage for each successful attack. 3 charges: The wearer may make a ranged touch attack vs. a single target within 30 feet. A hit deals 3d4 force damage. If worn by a monk who chooses to use their unarmed strike, the monk can choose (at no charge cost), to do force damage with their attacks, instead of normal bludgeoning damage. Should they choose to do so, however, the damage dealt is reduced, as if the monk was 4 levels lower (minimum 1st level).
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, magic missile

items.name: Ring of the Brotherhood (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This is a normal yet elegant signet ring, made of silver. EFFECTS Rings of the brotherhood emanate a specific arcane sigil, that is both invisible and undetectable to most. The sigil can only be perceived by someone wearing a similarly keyed ring, with each wearer being able to immediately identify any others within line of sight. Associated rings are all keyed to each other at the time of creation, granting any selected wearers the ability to instantly identify their hidden allies. If a Ring of the Brotherhood has identify cast on it or is similarly examined, the caster is able to detect its magical nature and purpose with a successful Will save DC 11. See invisibility, true seeing, a gem of seeing, or a robe of eyes allows the caster to perceive invisible sigil.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, arcane mark, magic

items.name: Ring of the Iron Grip (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This simple, thick band of gray-black iron has a smoothness born of wear, rather than polish. EFFECTS As a move action the wearer can activate a powerful magnetic grip, allowing any metal weapon wielded in that hand to function as if held in a locked gauntlet (+10 bonus to the wearer's Combat Maneuver Defense to resist disarm maneuvers). As with a locked gauntlet, while the ring is active, the hand affected cannot be used to cast spells or to use skills which require free hands. Deactivating the ring requires a move action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity .
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, mage hand

items.name: Ring of the Iron Liver (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: Adorned with a skull and crossbones, this ring smells slightly of rum. EFFECTS A ring of the iron liver provides the wearer a continuous +1 competence bonus to saves against poison and drugs, and a +2 competence bonus to saves against the effects of alcohol.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, remove sickness

items.name: Ring of the Traveling Mage (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This pewter ring has a tiny spellbook as its setting, complete with opening cover. EFFECTS This ring contains an extradimensional space that acts in a manner similar to a bag of holding, allowing the wearer to safely store a full sized spellbook. The spellbook can be conjured forth, or sent back to storage with a spoken command word, chosen by the ring's owner. The ring cannot be used to store any other type of book or object – nor does it have any special interaction with other kinds of extradimensional spaces.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, secret chest

items.name: Scouting Rings (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This pair of bands are identical, down to the sigil etched on the inside of each. EFFECTS The scouting rings allow two way whispered communication between wearers of the rings up to a range of 120 ft. Individuals who are standing within 5 feet of either wearer can hear these messages with a DC 25 Perception check. The whispered messages do not require a line, instead being able to circumvent barriers, as long as there is an open path between subjects, which lies within the range of the rings. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal (or a thin sheet of lead), or 3 feet of wood or dirt block the ability of the rings to communicate.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, message

items.name: Shield Ring (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This plain steel ring bears a small replica of a shield atop it, scuffed and dented almost as if an actual tiny shield had seen years of use. EFFECTS Three times per day, the wearer of the shield ring, as a free action, may utter a command to activate the ring, transforming it into a buckler worn on the same hand as the ring and providing all the standard protections a buckler affords. Each transformation lasts ten minutes, after which the ring resumes its original form. Once per day, the ring can be commanded to take the form of a light steel shield, protecting the wearer as such and allowing the use of such attacks as a shield bash. This transformation persists for 1 minute.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, shield Proficiency (any)

items.name: Spy's Ring (Least Minor Ring)
items.descriptionText: This gold ring appears to be a simple albeit well-made signet ring common to merchants, diplomats and city officials. EFFECTS Once per day the wearer, as a move action, may invoke the power of the ring while pressing it into the wax seal of a document. When so activated, the ring's magic alters the text of the sealed document as a secret page spell. Within the modified text is usually a cipher or other such clue to the secret word that will reveal the hidden text beneath. Anyone wearing a spy's ring is automatically able to perceive the true text within any document sealed by that particular ring.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice, secret page

items.name: Diplomat's Ring
items.descriptionText: This ornate ring is typically made of gold or platinum with one or more gemstones set within the band. The ring continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks. Additionally, upon command the ring will grant the wearer the use of comprehend languages up to 5 times per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, comprehend languages, Diplomacy 5 ranks, masterwork ring of at least 500 gp in value

args.text: masterwork ring of at least 500 gp in value

items.name: Greater Diplomat's Ring
items.descriptionText: This ring appears and functions as a diplomat's ring, except it grants a +10 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks. In addition to the comprehend languages ability 5 times per day, upon command the ring will grant the wearer the use of tongues up to 3 times per day.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, comprehend languages, tongues, Diplomacy 10 ranks, ring of at least 500 gp in value

args.text: ring of at least 500 gp in value

items.name: Ghost Ring
items.descriptionText: This ring is made of silver and crystal. Upon putting on the ring, it becomes translucent and is difficult to spot on the wearer's finger (DC 20 Perception check). On command, and for up to 10 rounds per day, the wearer becomes incorporeal and is able to walk through solid matter. Measures taken which prevent ethereal creatures from passing through an item or area prevent the wearer from passing through them as well. The rounds of use do not need to be consecutive. If the wearer becomes corporeal while passing through solid matter, she is expelled to the closest unoccupied space and suffers 1d6 damage for every 5 feet through which she passes.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, ethereal jaunt

items.name: Marksman's Ring
items.descriptionText: The marksman's ring improves the wearer's accuracy and efficiency when using any type of projectile or thrown missile weapon with which he is proficient, granting a +2 competence bonus to attack and damage rolls for these weapons.
items.constructionRequirementsText: Forge Ring, Throw Anything, cat's grace, caster must be proficient with at least one simple ranged weapon, one martial ranged weapon and one exotic ranged weapon

args.text: one martial ranged weapon and one exotic ranged weapon

items.name: Ring of Battle Frenzy

items.descriptionText: This ring appears to be a ring of djinni calling . When the ring's power is activated, the wearer vanishes and appears in the oasis residence of a djinni noble who will give her a task to complete; a successful DC 15 Will save avoids the compulsion to complete the task and leaves the decision of whether to accept the task or not to the wearer. If the wearer accepts the task, she reappears at her point of origin and has one week to complete the task. Once the task is completed, the wearer reappears in front of the summoning djinni noble and the ring crumbles to dust. The former wearer is given a gift in return for his services (valued at no more than 2,000 GP) and returned to her point of origin. If the task is refused, the djinni noble views the response as an insult and attacks. Additionally, if the task is not completed within the one week window, the wearer appears in front of the summoning djinni noble and the failure at accomplishing the task is viewed as an insult with similar effect. In either case, if the djinni noble is defeated or driven off, the wearer reappears at her point of origin. If the djinni noble is slain, the ring crumbles to dust. If the djinni noble survives the attack, however, the ring remains intact and can only be removed by a wish spell. Additionally, the wearer is then targeted by that djinni noble for revenge until the ring is successfully removed or the djinni noble is killed.

Each day every magic item in the possession of the wearer, beginning with the item with the highest CL, must make a DC 20 Will save as if it had been targeted by a mage's disjunction spell. Each five foot square of the force threads has a hardness of 10 and 20 hit points . Destroyed threads are replaced by new ones within two rounds. This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. This renders the ring non-magical.

Once the ring is worn the wearer is struck with a constant feeling of hunger, giving a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and skill checks. Spell casters must make a successful concentration check (DC 10 + spell level) to cast spells while wearing the ring. The wearer must consume five times the normal amount of food per day to keep the hunger from overwhelming her. Failure to do so results in 1d3 points of Constitution damage and 1d6 points of non-lethal damage. This ring can be removed by casting remove curse followed by restoration upon it. Doing so destroys the ring, turning it to dust.

items.name: Ring of the Cluttered Mind
items.descriptionText: This ring appears to be a ring of wizardry . Once worn, however, the true nature of the ring is shown. The wearer must immediately make a DC 20 Will save or take 1d2 points of permanent Intelligence damage . Additionally, this check must be made each day until the ring is removed or the wearer's Intelligence score reaches zero. Additionally, the ring causes the wearer to lose access to the ability to cast spells of certain levels depending on the type of ring of wizardry it was intended to be. These spell eliminations remain in effect until the ring is removed. A type I ring eliminates 1st-level spells, a type II ring eliminates 2nd-level spells, a type III ring eliminates 3rd-level spells, and a type IV ring eliminates 4th-level spells. Bonus spells from high ability scores or school specialization are not eliminated. This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it followed by a successful casting of dispel magic . Doing so renders the ring non-magical.

items.name: Wizard's Bane
items.descriptionText: This ring appears to be a ring of wizardry . When worn, the wearer's mind becomes muddled. He forgets spell components, mumbles during casting and makes mistakes in the somatic gestures required for many of the spells he tries to cast. The severity of the effects depend on the ring type. A type I ring causes the spell caster to make an arcane spell failure check at a base 40% chance for any spell cast. A type II ring causes the caster to make an arcane spell failure check at a base 50% chance for any spell cast. A type III ring causes the caster to make an arcane spell failure check at a base 60% chance for any spell cast. A type IV ring causes the caster to make an arcane spell failure check at a base 70% chance for any spell cast. The arcane spell failure chance can be further modified by other factors, such as armor worn, etc. This ring can be removed by casting remove curse followed by a successful dispel magic upon it.
